🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Not a single foot of blacktopping done on Amarnath route, PDP-BJP stoking Hindu-Muslim discord: Omar Abdullah

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 02:08:46 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘The BJP and those carrying the symbol of pen and inkpot are again trying to foment Hindu-Muslim discord over the Amarnath route,’ said Omar Abdullah

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Friday (November 27, 2026) said not a single foot of blacktopping was carried out on the Amarnath route, while referring to the Sheshnag controversy, and accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) of “deliberately pitting Hindus and Muslims against each other”. “The BJP and those carrying the symbol of pen and inkpot [referring to the PDP] are again trying to foment Hindu-Muslim discord over the Amarnath route. They are alleging macadamisation. I challenge them to prove a single foot of blacktopping done on the route. I am ready to face an inquiry. There is a court [Supreme Court] direction to have a 12-feet stretch,” said Mr. Abdullah. Mr. Abdullah’s statement came days after local parties, religious leaders, environmentalists and civil society bodies reacted sharply to the presence of an earthmover close functioning to the Sheshnag lake situation at an altitude of 11,780 feet on the way to the Amarnath shrine, which is around 20 km away from the spot. A report prepared by the J&K Forest Department on the viral video, in which an earthmover was seen close to the lake, said, “The activity seen in the video is part of routine annual maintenance operations being undertaken by the Border Roads Organisation [BRO]. No new road construction or fresh alignment is being undertaken. It is further clarified that the Yatra track runs along the right-hand side of the lake and is situated at a considerable distance from the lake. “It said the lake remains protected and the maintenance activity in question “was not intended to alter its character or ecological integrity”. “The matter may, therefore, be viewed in its proper context, keeping in view the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court, the safety requirements of the annual pilgrimage and the longstanding nature of the track maintenance operations,” it added, while underlining that the maintenance and improvement of this track is a longstanding exercise undertaken regularly since 2012 and “not a new activity initiated in 2026”. However, Opposition Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) president Mehbooba Mufti, who was denied permission to visit the spot with police citing security concerns, has asked the government to allow a team of politicians and experts to visit the Sheshnag lake. “If the Union Territory [UT] government is relying on satellite images to claim that no construction is taking place at Sheshnag, why not allow us to visit the site and see for ourselves? The JCBs wreaking havoc there are visible for all to see. To dispel all doubts, let the Chief Minister depute a team of political leaders and environmentalists to inspect the site and establish the truth. What is there to hide?” said Ms. Mufti. Meanwhile, referring to the allegations of irregularities in the Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) examination conducted by the J&K Service Selection Board JKSSB), Mr. Abdullah said, “Political opponents were exploiting the concerns of unemployed youth and creating unnecessary mistrust about the recruitment process. I am always ready to admit if a mistake is committed. But when I dug deep into the matter, I found that instead of there being fraud in the examination, the fact is that the system worked properly. The paper did not leak. The paper was not stolen.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Terming the incident as a case of “attempted cheating but disallowed”, Mr. Abdullah said, “There were people who tried to cheat in the examination. I agree with this. They took out the question paper from the examination hall, used wireless devices and tried to get answers. But they were caught on the spot. They were arrested. The JKSSB should have been praised for it,” said Mr. Abdullah.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Permissibility (Noun)
कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।
✓ Syn: Admissibility, Legality, Allowance  |  ✖ Ant: Prohibition, Ban, Illegality
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Macadamisation (Noun)
मैकडैमाइज़ेशन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Macadamisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Not a single foot of blacktopping done on Amarnath route, PDP-BJP stoking Hindu-Muslim discord: Omar Abdullah", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. ‘The BJP and those carrying the symbol of pen and inkpot are again trying to foment Hindu-Muslim discord over the Amarnath route,’ said Omar Abdullah.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Not a single foot of blacktopping done on Amarna' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Not a single foot of blacktopping done on Ama' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Not a single foot of blacktopping done on Ama' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "‘The BJP and those carrying the symbol of pen and inkpot are again trying to foment Hindu-Muslim discord over the Amarnath route,’ said Omar Abdullah." (Hinglish Arth: उमर अब्दुल्ला ने कहा, 'भाजपा और कलम और स्याही का प्रतीक रखने वाले लोग फिर से अमरनाथ मार्ग पर हिंदू-मुस्लिम विवाद पैदा करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।')
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Not a single foot of blacktopping done on Amarnath route, PDP-BJP stoking Hindu-Muslim discord: Omar Abdullah"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The JKSSB should have been praised for it,” said Mr.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The JKSSB should have been praised for it,” said Mr." (Hinglish Arth: इसके लिए जेकेएसएसबी की प्रशंसा की जानी चाहिए, ”श्री ने कहा।)

articles.title: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh arrested on charges of harassing IAS officer
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The TVK MLA was subsequently brought to the Circuit House in Kallakurichi on the Salem-Ulundurpet highway for questioning, where a large posse of police personnel has been deployed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A case was registered after the Madras High Court recently directed the State Public Prosecutor to get in touch with the officer regarding the allegations after she filed a formal police complaint . Police sources said a team led by Shristi Singh, the Investigating Officer appointed by the Madras High Court , arrested the legislator at his residence in Kallakurichi on Friday evening and took him in a police vehicle. He was subsequently brought to the Circuit House in Kallakurichi on the Salem-Ulundurpet highway for questioning, where a large posse of police personnel has been deployed. The Kallakurichi All Women Police, which had registered a sexual harassment case against the MLA, served summons on Mr. Vignesh on Wednesday directing him to appear for questioning in connection with the case. Speculation over his arrest grew after Inspector Bhuvaneshwari, attached to the All Women Police station, visited the MLA’s house in Kallakurichi on Wednesday (November 25) and handed the summons to him in person . On 23.11.2026, a senior lady officer in Kallakurichi District preferred complaint against Thiru C. Arul Vignesh, MLA, Kallakurichi Constituency regarding alleged harassment and inappropriate conduct. On the same day, a case in Kallakurichi AWPS Cr No. 91/2026 was registered under appropriate sections of law. Initial investigation was done by the local police and on the directions of the Hon'ble High Court of Madras in WP (Crl) No. 3183/2026 dated 24.11.2026, Tmt. Shristi Singh, IPS, Superintendent of Police, Tiruppur District took investigation of this case under the supervision of Tmt. N. Kamini, IPS, Inspector General of Police, Administration, Chennai. During the investigation, the petitioner and other witnesses have been enquired by the Investigation Officer. Consequent to the enquiry, the alleged accused Thiru C. Arul Vignesh, MLA, Kallakurichi Constituency has been arrested and the investigation is under progress. Relating to this incident, 201 social media posts were pulled down by the local police and the Cyber Crime Department of Tamil Nadu Police. However, since the Hon'ble High Court has also ordered against publishing, communicating or making known to the public any of the matters covered under sections PoSH Act, it is requested to avoid posting any post in contravention to the above directions.. The police have booked a case against the MLA invoking provisions of the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and Sections 75, 78 and 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. Tiruppur Superintendent of Police Ms. Singh began preliminary investigation into the incident on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) after receiving the inquiry report from Kallakurichi Superintendent of Police I. Shahnaz at the All Women Police Station. Did his government deliver? | Focus Tamil Nadu
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Inspector General of Police (Administration) N. Kamini also visited Kallakurichi on Thursday (November 26) and supervised the investigation.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh arrested on charges of harassing IAS officer

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 01:56:39 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The TVK MLA was subsequently brought to the Circuit House in Kallakurichi on the Salem-Ulundurpet highway for questioning, where a large posse of police personnel has been deployed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A case was registered after the Madras High Court recently directed the State Public Prosecutor to get in touch with the officer regarding the allegations after she filed a formal police complaint . Police sources said a team led by Shristi Singh, the Investigating Officer appointed by the Madras High Court , arrested the legislator at his residence in Kallakurichi on Friday evening and took him in a police vehicle. He was subsequently brought to the Circuit House in Kallakurichi on the Salem-Ulundurpet highway for questioning, where a large posse of police personnel has been deployed. The Kallakurichi All Women Police, which had registered a sexual harassment case against the MLA, served summons on Mr. Vignesh on Wednesday directing him to appear for questioning in connection with the case. Speculation over his arrest grew after Inspector Bhuvaneshwari, attached to the All Women Police station, visited the MLA’s house in Kallakurichi on Wednesday (November 25) and handed the summons to him in person . On 23.11.2026, a senior lady officer in Kallakurichi District preferred complaint against Thiru C. Arul Vignesh, MLA, Kallakurichi Constituency regarding alleged harassment and inappropriate conduct. On the same day, a case in Kallakurichi AWPS Cr No. 91/2026 was registered under appropriate sections of law. Initial investigation was done by the local police and on the directions of the Hon'ble High Court of Madras in WP (Crl) No. 3183/2026 dated 24.11.2026, Tmt. Shristi Singh, IPS, Superintendent of Police, Tiruppur District took investigation of this case under the supervision of Tmt. N. Kamini, IPS, Inspector General of Police, Administration, Chennai. During the investigation, the petitioner and other witnesses have been enquired by the Investigation Officer. Consequent to the enquiry, the alleged accused Thiru C. Arul Vignesh, MLA, Kallakurichi Constituency has been arrested and the investigation is under progress. Relating to this incident, 201 social media posts were pulled down by the local police and the Cyber Crime Department of Tamil Nadu Police. However, since the Hon'ble High Court has also ordered against publishing, communicating or making known to the public any of the matters covered under sections PoSH Act, it is requested to avoid posting any post in contravention to the above directions.. The police have booked a case against the MLA invoking provisions of the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and Sections 75, 78 and 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. Tiruppur Superintendent of Police Ms. Singh began preliminary investigation into the incident on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) after receiving the inquiry report from Kallakurichi Superintendent of Police I. Shahnaz at the All Women Police Station. 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Inspector General of Police (Administration) N. Kamini also visited Kallakurichi on Thursday (November 26) and supervised the investigation.

articles.title: Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri appointed as J&K’s Advocate General after two year gap
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Faisal is a designated senior advocate with over 20 years of practice; the Omar Abdullah government in April had proposed the names for the post while the appointment came after the J&K High Court heard a PIL plea on November 5 regarding the vacant post

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri was on Friday (November 27, 2026) appointed as the Advocate General of Jammu and Kashmir, eight months after the J&K government forwarded the proposal to Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha for his approval. The J&K government has been without an Advocate General for more than two years. “In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 79 of the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 (Act No. 34 of 2019) and in supersession of notification S.O. No. 07 of 2019 dated 01-11-2019, the Lieutenant Governor of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir is pleased to appoint Mr. Syed Faisal Qadri, Senior Advocate, as Advocate General for the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir,” reads the official order. Mr. Qadri is a designated senior advocate with over 20 years of practice. With over 100 reported judgments, Mr. Faisal earned a name for himself by pleading cases of both private and government institutions in the J&K High Court and in the Supreme Court. The Omar Abdullah government in April this year had proposed the names for the post. The appointment, however, came after the J&K High Court heard a public interest litigation (PIL) petition on November 5 regarding the vacant post. Senior Additional Advocate General Monika Kohli had apprised the Division Bench, comprising Chief Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati and Justice Rajnesh Oswal, that the appointment would be made within a period of one month. It is a major relief for Chief Minister Omar Abdullah whose government was pursuing many pending policy matters before the J&K High Court in the past two years. Mr. Abdullah’s party National Conference (NC) had won the Assembly elections in 2024, but remained without an Advocate General since then.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2019, senior advocate D.C. Raina was appointed as the Advocate General of J&K. He, later, tendered his resignation in October 2024.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri appointed as J&K’s Advocate General after two year gap

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 01:51:31 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Faisal is a designated senior advocate with over 20 years of practice; the Omar Abdullah government in April had proposed the names for the post while the appointment came after the J&K High Court heard a PIL plea on November 5 regarding the vacant post

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri was on Friday (November 27, 2026) appointed as the Advocate General of Jammu and Kashmir, eight months after the J&K government forwarded the proposal to Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha for his approval. The J&K government has been without an Advocate General for more than two years. “In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 79 of the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 (Act No. 34 of 2019) and in supersession of notification S.O. No. 07 of 2019 dated 01-11-2019, the Lieutenant Governor of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir is pleased to appoint Mr. Syed Faisal Qadri, Senior Advocate, as Advocate General for the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir,” reads the official order. Mr. Qadri is a designated senior advocate with over 20 years of practice. With over 100 reported judgments, Mr. Faisal earned a name for himself by pleading cases of both private and government institutions in the J&K High Court and in the Supreme Court. The Omar Abdullah government in April this year had proposed the names for the post. The appointment, however, came after the J&K High Court heard a public interest litigation (PIL) petition on November 5 regarding the vacant post. Senior Additional Advocate General Monika Kohli had apprised the Division Bench, comprising Chief Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati and Justice Rajnesh Oswal, that the appointment would be made within a period of one month. It is a major relief for Chief Minister Omar Abdullah whose government was pursuing many pending policy matters before the J&K High Court in the past two years. Mr. Abdullah’s party National Conference (NC) had won the Assembly elections in 2024, but remained without an Advocate General since then.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2019, senior advocate D.C. Raina was appointed as the Advocate General of J&K. He, later, tendered his resignation in October 2024.

संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Reorganisation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Reorganisation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Supersession (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Supersession' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Notification (Noun)
अधिसूचना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Notification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri appointed as J&K’s Advocate General after two year gap", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Faisal is a designated senior advocate with over 20 years of practice; the Omar Abdullah government in April had proposed the names for the post...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri appointed as J' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri appointed a' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri appointed a' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Faisal is a designated senior advocate with over 20 years of practice; the Omar Abdullah government in April had proposed the names for the post..." (Hinglish Arth: फैसल 20 वर्षों से अधिक प्रैक्टिस के साथ एक नामित वरिष्ठ वकील हैं; उमर अब्दुल्ला सरकार ने अप्रैल में इस पद के लिए नाम प्रस्तावित किए थे, जबकि नियुक्ति जम्मू-कश्मीर उच्च न्यायालय द्वारा नवंबर में एक जनहित याचिका पर सुनवाई के बाद की गई थी।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri appointed as J&K’s Advocate General after two year gap"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He, later, tendered his resignation in October 2024.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He, later, tendered his resignation in October 2024." (Hinglish Arth: बाद में उन्होंने अक्टूबर 2024 में अपना इस्तीफा दे दिया।)

articles.title: Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by 50%; they also bring into force the 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A new Constitutional Amendment Bill approved by the Union Cabinet on Friday (November 27, 2026) proposes an extension of the existing freeze on the inter-State distribution of Lok Sabha seats for another 25 years, until 2051, addressing the core concern of States that feared a loss of their proportionate strength due to the decline in their share of the national population. The 132nd Constitutional Amendment Bill marks a significant turn from the 131st Amendment Bill moved by the Centre in April 2026 that sought to redistribute Lok Sabha seats among States according to the 2011 Census population. The proposed amendment removes the linkage of the existing distribution of Lok Sabha seats to the 1971 Census and links it with provisions related to women’s reservation in Article 334A of the Constitution. The guarantee for a 50% increase in the number of Lok Sabha seats for each State is being written into this, providing that, for the purposes of giving immediate effect to such reservation for women, “the delimitation so undertaken shall provide for an increase of fifty per cent in the number of seats allocated to each State and Union territory in the House of the People.” The total number of seats in the Legislative Assembly of each State and Union territory will also increase similarly, “over and above the number of seats existing immediately before such delimitation”. The new Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by 50%, while the maximum strength of the lower House will rise from the current 550 to 850. If these Bills are passed by Parliament in its special sittings from November 30 to December 3, the path to immediate delimitation will open, which will also bring into force the 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha. ALSO WATCH Cabinet clears delimitation Bill; is a two-thirds majority within reach? | Above the Fold | Nov 27, 2026 Amendments to Articles 81 and 82, which mandate the size and distribution of Lok Sabha seats among the States, propose to extend a sunset clause for the existing proportion until the first Census after 2051. The existing provision in Article 82 that says that “until the relevant figures for the first census taken after the year 2026 have been published, it shall not be necessary to readjust” the distribution of seats is being amended in the Bill and will be changed to read “until the year 2051”. Article 82 currently has two definitions for population: for the purposes of distribution among States, the 1971 population; and for the purposes of delimitation of individual constituencies within the States, the 2001 Census. The proposed amendment will extend the sunset clause to “until the year 2051”, but the reference to the 1971 Census has been dropped. The Bill proposes that the distribution among States will be determined “in accordance with Article 334A”, while the boundaries of individual constituencies will be determined by the “latest published census figures available on the date of the commencement of the Constitution (One Hundred and Thirty-second Amendment) Act, 2026”.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: ALSO WATCH Watch: Cabinet clears Delimitation Bill: 50% seat hike across states, special sitting Nov 30

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q1 • Central Inference & Passage Core
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
options: The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by...
Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proport' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat prop' should be permanently discontinued.
The author contends that 'Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat prop' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by...
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by..." (Hinglish Arth: नए परिसीमन विधेयक के साथ नया संवैधानिक संशोधन विधेयक, प्रत्येक राज्य में लोकसभा सीटों की संख्या 50% बढ़ाने का प्रस्ताव करता है; वे लो में महिलाओं के लिए 33% आरक्षण भी लागू करते हैं)

(Hinglish Arth: यह भी देखें देखें: कैबिनेट ने परिसीमन विधेयक को मंजूरी दी: राज्यों में 50% सीट बढ़ोतरी, 30 नवंबर को विशेष बैठक)

hinglishTracks.en: The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by 50%; they also bring into force the 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नए परिसीमन विधेयक के साथ नया संवैधानिक संशोधन विधेयक, प्रत्येक राज्य में लोकसभा सीटों की संख्या 50% बढ़ाने का प्रस्ताव करता है; वे लोकसभा में महिलाओं के लिए 33% आरक्षण भी लागू करते हैं। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: A new Constitutional Amendment Bill approved by the Union Cabinet on Friday (November 27, 2026) proposes an extension of the existing freeze on the inter-State distribution of Lok Sabha seats for another 25 years, until 2051, addressing the core concern of States that feared a loss of their proportionate strength due to the decline in their share of the national population.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शुक्रवार (नवंबर 27, 2026) को केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा अनुमोदित एक नए संवैधानिक संशोधन विधेयक में लोकसभा सीटों के अंतर-राज्य वितरण पर मौजूदा रोक को अगले 25 वर्षों के लिए 2051 तक बढ़ाने का प्रस्ताव है, जो उन राज्यों की मुख्य चिंता को संबोधित करता है, जिन्हें राष्ट्रीय आबादी के अपने हिस्से में गिरावट के कारण अपनी आनुपातिक ताकत के नुकसान की आशंका थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The 132nd Constitutional Amendment Bill marks a significant turn from the 131st Amendment Bill moved by the Centre in April 2026 that sought to redistribute Lok Sabha seats among States according to the 2011 Census population.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 132वां संवैधानिक संशोधन विधेयक अप्रैल 2026 में केंद्र द्वारा पेश किए गए 131वें संशोधन विधेयक से एक महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव का प्रतीक है, जिसमें 2011 की जनगणना के अनुसार राज्यों के बीच लोकसभा सीटों का पुनर्वितरण करने की मांग की गई थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The proposed amendment removes the linkage of the existing distribution of Lok Sabha seats to the 1971 Census and links it with provisions related to women’s reservation in Article 334A of the Constitution.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्रस्तावित संशोधन लोकसभा सीटों के मौजूदा वितरण का 1971 की जनगणना से जुड़ाव हटाता है और इसे संविधान के अनुच्छेद 334ए में महिला आरक्षण से संबंधित प्रावधानों से जोड़ता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The guarantee for a 50% increase in the number of Lok Sabha seats for each State is being written into this, providing that, for the purposes of giving immediate effect to such reservation for women, “the delimitation so undertaken shall provide for an increase of fifty per cent in the number of seats allocated to each State and Union territory in the House of the People.” The total number of seats in the Legislative Assembly of each State and Union territory will also increase similarly, “over and above the number of seats existing immediately before such delimitation”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसमें प्रत्येक राज्य के लिए लोकसभा सीटों की संख्या में 50% की वृद्धि की गारंटी दी गई है, जिसमें महिलाओं के लिए ऐसे आरक्षण को तत्काल प्रभाव से लागू करने के प्रयोजनों के लिए कहा गया है, "इस प्रकार किए गए परिसीमन से लोक सभा में प्रत्येक राज्य और केंद्र शासित प्रदेश को आवंटित सीटों की संख्या में पचास प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी।" प्रत्येक राज्य और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका की विधान सभा में सीटों की कुल संख्या। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Delimitation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Delimitation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The new Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by 50%, while the maximum strength of the lower House will rise from the current 550 to 850.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नए परिसीमन विधेयक के साथ नए विधेयक में प्रत्येक राज्य में लोकसभा सीटों की संख्या 50% बढ़ाने का प्रस्ताव है, जबकि निचले सदन की अधिकतम ताकत मौजूदा 550 से बढ़कर 850 हो जाएगी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Delimitation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Delimitation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: If these Bills are passed by Parliament in its special sittings from November 30 to December 3, the path to immediate delimitation will open, which will also bring into force the 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यदि ये विधेयक 30 नवंबर से 3 दिसंबर तक होने वाली विशेष बैठकों में संसद द्वारा पारित कर दिए जाते हैं, तो तत्काल परिसीमन का रास्ता खुल जाएगा, जिससे लोकसभा में महिलाओं के लिए 33% आरक्षण भी लागू हो जाएगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Delimitation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Delimitation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: ALSO WATCH Cabinet clears delimitation Bill; is a two-thirds majority within reach?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह भी देखें कैबिनेट ने परिसीमन विधेयक को मंजूरी दी; क्या दो-तिहाई बहुमत पहुंच में है?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Delimitation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Delimitation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: | Above the Fold | Nov 27, 2026
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — | तह के ऊपर | 27 नवंबर, 2026।

hinglishTracks.en: Amendments to Articles 81 and 82, which mandate the size and distribution of Lok Sabha seats among the States, propose to extend a sunset clause for the existing proportion until the first Census after 2051.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अनुच्छेद 81 और 82 में संशोधन, जो राज्यों के बीच लोकसभा सीटों के आकार और वितरण को अनिवार्य करता है, 2051 के बाद पहली जनगणना तक मौजूदा अनुपात के लिए एक सूर्यास्त खंड का विस्तार करने का प्रस्ताव करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Distribution' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Distribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The existing provision in Article 82 that says that “until the relevant figures for the first census taken after the year 2026 have been published, it shall not be necessary to readjust” the distribution of seats is being amended in the Bill and will be changed to read “until the year 2051”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अनुच्छेद 82 में मौजूदा प्रावधान जो कहता है कि "जब तक वर्ष 2026 के बाद की गई पहली जनगणना के प्रासंगिक आंकड़े प्रकाशित नहीं हो जाते, तब तक इसे पुन: समायोजित करना आवश्यक नहीं होगा" सीटों के वितरण को विधेयक में संशोधित किया जा रहा है और इसे "वर्ष 2051 तक" पढ़ने के लिए बदल दिया जाएगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Distribution' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Distribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Article 82 currently has two definitions for population: for the purposes of distribution among States, the 1971 population; and for the purposes of delimitation of individual constituencies within the States, the 2001 Census.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अनुच्छेद 82 में वर्तमान में जनसंख्या के लिए दो परिभाषाएँ हैं: राज्यों के बीच वितरण के प्रयोजनों के लिए, 1971 की जनसंख्या; और राज्यों के भीतर व्यक्तिगत निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों के परिसीमन के प्रयोजनों के लिए, 2001 की जनगणना।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The proposed amendment will extend the sunset clause to “until the year 2051”, but the reference to the 1971 Census has been dropped.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — प्रस्तावित संशोधन सनसेट क्लॉज को "वर्ष 2051 तक" तक बढ़ा देगा, लेकिन 1971 की जनगणना का संदर्भ हटा दिया गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Bill proposes that the distribution among States will be determined “in accordance with Article 334A”, while the boundaries of individual constituencies will be determined by the “latest published census figures available on the date of the commencement of the Constitution (One Hundred and Thirty-second Amendment) Act, 2026”.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 01:43:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by 50%; they also bring into force the 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A new Constitutional Amendment Bill approved by the Union Cabinet on Friday (November 27, 2026) proposes an extension of the existing freeze on the inter-State distribution of Lok Sabha seats for another 25 years, until 2051, addressing the core concern of States that feared a loss of their proportionate strength due to the decline in their share of the national population. The 132nd Constitutional Amendment Bill marks a significant turn from the 131st Amendment Bill moved by the Centre in April 2026 that sought to redistribute Lok Sabha seats among States according to the 2011 Census population. The proposed amendment removes the linkage of the existing distribution of Lok Sabha seats to the 1971 Census and links it with provisions related to women’s reservation in Article 334A of the Constitution. The guarantee for a 50% increase in the number of Lok Sabha seats for each State is being written into this, providing that, for the purposes of giving immediate effect to such reservation for women, “the delimitation so undertaken shall provide for an increase of fifty per cent in the number of seats allocated to each State and Union territory in the House of the People.” The total number of seats in the Legislative Assembly of each State and Union territory will also increase similarly, “over and above the number of seats existing immediately before such delimitation”. The new Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by 50%, while the maximum strength of the lower House will rise from the current 550 to 850. If these Bills are passed by Parliament in its special sittings from November 30 to December 3, the path to immediate delimitation will open, which will also bring into force the 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha. ALSO WATCH Cabinet clears delimitation Bill; is a two-thirds majority within reach? | Above the Fold | Nov 27, 2026 Amendments to Articles 81 and 82, which mandate the size and distribution of Lok Sabha seats among the States, propose to extend a sunset clause for the existing proportion until the first Census after 2051. The existing provision in Article 82 that says that “until the relevant figures for the first census taken after the year 2026 have been published, it shall not be necessary to readjust” the distribution of seats is being amended in the Bill and will be changed to read “until the year 2051”. Article 82 currently has two definitions for population: for the purposes of distribution among States, the 1971 population; and for the purposes of delimitation of individual constituencies within the States, the 2001 Census. The proposed amendment will extend the sunset clause to “until the year 2051”, but the reference to the 1971 Census has been dropped. The Bill proposes that the distribution among States will be determined “in accordance with Article 334A”, while the boundaries of individual constituencies will be determined by the “latest published census figures available on the date of the commencement of the Constitution (One Hundred and Thirty-second Amendment) Act, 2026”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: ALSO WATCH Watch: Cabinet clears Delimitation Bill: 50% seat hike across states, special sitting Nov 30

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proport' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat prop' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat prop' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by..." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. ALSO WATCH Watch: Cabinet clears Delimitation Bill: 50% seat hike across states, special sitting Nov 30.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "ALSO WATCH Watch: Cabinet clears Delimitation Bill: 50% seat hike across states, special sitting Nov 30." (Hinglish Arth: यह भी देखें देखें: कैबिनेट ने परिसीमन विधेयक को मंजूरी दी: राज्यों में 50% सीट बढ़ोतरी, 30 नवंबर को विशेष बैठक)

articles.title: RBI cuts daily CRR maintenance to 90%, to unlock over ₹40,000 crore
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The latest relaxation is expected to improve banks’ liquidity flexibility and support credit deployment.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday eased the minimum daily maintenance requirement for the cash reserve ratio (CRR) from 99% to 90%, a move expected to release more than ₹40,000 crore into the banking system and provide banks with additional funds for lending. “On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation and liquidity conditions, it has been decided to reduce the minimum daily maintenance of the cash reserve ratio (CRR) from 99% of the requirement to 90% effective from the fortnight beginning December 1, 2026,” the RBI said. Under the revised arrangement, scheduled banks will be required to maintain at least 90% of their prescribed CRR on each day of the reporting fortnight. However, the average daily CRR maintained during the fortnight must not fall below the level prescribed by the RBI. With the prescribed CRR currently at 3% of a bank’s net demand and time liabilities (NDTL), banks will now have greater flexibility in managing their daily cash balances, while continuing to meet the overall fortnightly requirement. The latest move reverses the tightening introduced on October 9, shortly after the previous Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting. At the time, the RBI had raised the minimum daily CRR maintenance requirement from 90% to 99%, effective from the fortnight beginning October 16, 2026. The earlier move came when the banking system was flush with liquidity following substantial mobilisation of funds through foreign currency non-resident (FCNR-B) deposits.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy (general) / business (general) / finance (general) / banking / money and monetary policy / Reserve Bank of India

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #13 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 RBI cuts daily CRR maintenance to 90%, to unlock over ₹40,000 crore

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 09:50:17 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The latest relaxation is expected to improve banks’ liquidity flexibility and support credit deployment.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday eased the minimum daily maintenance requirement for the cash reserve ratio (CRR) from 99% to 90%, a move expected to release more than ₹40,000 crore into the banking system and provide banks with additional funds for lending. “On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation and liquidity conditions, it has been decided to reduce the minimum daily maintenance of the cash reserve ratio (CRR) from 99% of the requirement to 90% effective from the fortnight beginning December 1, 2026,” the RBI said. Under the revised arrangement, scheduled banks will be required to maintain at least 90% of their prescribed CRR on each day of the reporting fortnight. However, the average daily CRR maintained during the fortnight must not fall below the level prescribed by the RBI. With the prescribed CRR currently at 3% of a bank’s net demand and time liabilities (NDTL), banks will now have greater flexibility in managing their daily cash balances, while continuing to meet the overall fortnightly requirement. The latest move reverses the tightening introduced on October 9, shortly after the previous Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting. At the time, the RBI had raised the minimum daily CRR maintenance requirement from 90% to 99%, effective from the fortnight beginning October 16, 2026. The earlier move came when the banking system was flush with liquidity following substantial mobilisation of funds through foreign currency non-resident (FCNR-B) deposits.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy (general) / business (general) / finance (general) / banking / money and monetary policy / Reserve Bank of India

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Flexibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.title: The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are perpetual in nature and politically hard to reverse, such continuous commitment of financial resources demands prior evaluation and real-time monitoring to address potential shortcomings

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Business Standard reported on May 13, 2026 that “Cash-transfer promises have moved from the margins of Indian election manifestos to the centre of political competition, with parties across States promising monthly or one-time payments.” Quoting a PRS Legislative Research report, it further said, “12 States are expected to spend nearly ₹1.68 trillion on unconditional cash-transfer schemes for women in 2025-26, … the outgo is roughly equivalent to 0.5 per cent of India’s GDP, compared with less than 0.2 per cent two years ago.” The RBI report ‘State Finance: Study of State Budgets 2025-26’ reported that the total subsidy outlay increased from ₹1.87 trillion in 2018-19 to ₹4.26 trillion in 2025-26. States often implement promises from their election manifestos soon after forming the government and just before the next election, without any serious assessment of needs or financial commitments. Conception and funding of an infrastructure project are guided by a Detailed Project Report (DPR) that specifies objectives, alternatives considered, financial and economic analysis, risk mitigation, baseline data, and success criteria. A social policy, by contrast, is often the outcome of an electoral promise or based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any comparable ex ante appraisal. Social policies affect human capabilities more directly than infrastructure projects. The scarcity of public resources and their alternative uses make ex ante appraisal of social sector schemes essential. Moreover, social policies are vulnerable to electoral clientelism, and should therefore adhere to the same principles of public expenditure as infrastructure projects — evidence, accountability, equity, efficiency and fiscal responsibility as infrastructure. The claim that the benefits of social policies are not quantifiable should not stop ex ante appraisal, as methodologies exist to overcome this barrier. An ex ante appraisal of a social project leaves an audit trail: the legislature, auditors, the media, and citizens can ask whether the project delivered what it promised. Many social schemes are implemented without the assessment of needs, identification of potential beneficiaries, or adequate funding, and a bureaucratic, top-down, target-chasing approach often replaces a democratic, bottom-up planning and implementation process. This article explores the fiscal and economic fallout of cash transfers and universal subsidies. If politics decides the desired social ends of such schemes, public finance and administration should decide the programme’s funding priority, the quantum of funding and the implementation process required to achieve those ends. Prioritising expenditure is the first step in checking the desirability of public expenditure. For example, the Government of Tamil Nadu allocated nearly ₹1,000 crore in 2026-27 to provide scholarships for girls and boys from Government schools to continue higher education. A recent report in a Tamil Magazine ( Ananda Vikatan , November 18, 2026), based on replies it received to RTI applications, found 7,198 vacancies in permanent teaching positions in Government Arts and Science Colleges. If we include teacher vacancies in professional colleges and universities, the number should be nearly 9,000. Filling these vacancies, delayed for over a decade, would cost ₹1,080 crore per annum, rising every year thereafter. With a huge revenue deficit and fiscal deficit, the State budget lacks the revenue cushion to spend an additional ₹1,080 crore per annum. Prioritising is a normative decision: filling vacancies ensures students learn from regular teachers, whereas funding scholarships alone sends them to colleges without regular teachers. Deciding the quantum of funding and the process of execution requires ex ante evaluation. This should be explicitly oriented toward designing programmes that maximise impact for a given cost, using behavioural models and micro-simulations to predict the effects of hypothetical programmes before implementation.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For instance, a universal subsidy scheme is a trade-off between inclusion and exclusion errors. If it is truly universal, the scheme commits the error of including the undeserving and thus reduces the per-capita benefit to people in need. In a target-oriented scheme, it commits the error of excluding the deserving, but it increases the per-capita benefit to people in need. The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes.

(Hinglish Arth: एक सामाजिक नीति अक्सर अपेक्षित चुनावी लाभ पर आधारित होती है, और बिना किसी पूर्व मूल्यांकन के लागू की जाती है; चूंकि नकद हस्तांतरण और सब्सिडी प्रकृति में सतत हैं और राजनीतिक रूप से इन्हें उलटना कठिन है, इसलिए ऐसी निरंतर कॉम)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes." (Hinglish Arth: दोनों के बीच चयन के लिए ऐसी योजनाओं के पूर्व मूल्यांकन की आवश्यकता होती है।)

hinglishTracks.en: A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are perpetual in nature and politically hard to reverse, such continuous commitment of financial resources demands prior evaluation and real-time monitoring to address potential shortcomings
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एक सामाजिक नीति अक्सर अपेक्षित चुनावी लाभ पर आधारित होती है, और बिना किसी पूर्व मूल्यांकन के लागू की जाती है; चूंकि नकद हस्तांतरण और सब्सिडी प्रकृति में स्थायी हैं और राजनीतिक रूप से इन्हें उलटना कठिन है, इसलिए वित्तीय संसाधनों की ऐसी निरंतर प्रतिबद्धता संभावित कमियों को दूर करने के लिए पूर्व मूल्यांकन और वास्तविक समय की निगरानी की मांग करती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: Business Standard reported on May 13, 2026 that “Cash-transfer promises have moved from the margins of Indian election manifestos to the centre of political competition, with parties across States promising monthly or one-time payments.” Quoting a PRS Legislative Research report, it further said, “12 States are expected to spend nearly ₹1.68 trillion on unconditional cash-transfer schemes for women in 2025-26, … the outgo is roughly equivalent to 0.5 per cent of India’s GDP, compared with less than 0.2 per cent two years ago.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बिजनेस स्टैंडर्ड ने 13 मई, 2026 को रिपोर्ट किया कि "नकद-हस्तांतरण के वादे भारतीय चुनाव घोषणापत्रों के हाशिए से हटकर राजनीतिक प्रतिस्पर्धा के केंद्र में आ गए हैं, राज्यों में पार्टियां मासिक या एकमुश्त भुगतान का वादा कर रही हैं।" पीआरएस लेजिस्लेटिव रिसर्च रिपोर्ट का हवाला देते हुए, इसमें आगे कहा गया है, “12 राज्यों को 2025-26 में महिलाओं के लिए बिना शर्त नकद-हस्तांतरण योजनाओं पर लगभग ₹1.68 ट्रिलियन खर्च करने की उम्मीद है, … व्यय लगभग बराबर है।

hinglishTracks.en: The RBI report ‘State Finance: Study of State Budgets 2025-26’ reported that the total subsidy outlay increased from ₹1.87 trillion in 2018-19 to ₹4.26 trillion in 2025-26.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — आरबीआई की रिपोर्ट 'राज्य वित्त: राज्य बजट 2025-26 का अध्ययन' में बताया गया है कि कुल सब्सिडी परिव्यय 2018-19 में ₹1.87 ट्रिलियन से बढ़कर 2025-26 में ₹4.26 ट्रिलियन हो गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: States often implement promises from their election manifestos soon after forming the government and just before the next election, without any serious assessment of needs or financial commitments.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — राज्य अक्सर सरकार बनने के तुरंत बाद और अगले चुनाव से ठीक पहले, जरूरतों या वित्तीय प्रतिबद्धताओं के गंभीर मूल्यांकन के बिना, अपने चुनावी घोषणापत्रों के वादों को लागू करते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: Conception and funding of an infrastructure project are guided by a Detailed Project Report (DPR) that specifies objectives, alternatives considered, financial and economic analysis, risk mitigation, baseline data, and success criteria.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजना की संकल्पना और वित्त पोषण एक विस्तृत परियोजना रिपोर्ट (डीपीआर) द्वारा निर्देशित होती है जो उद्देश्यों, विचार किए गए विकल्पों, वित्तीय और आर्थिक विश्लेषण, जोखिम शमन, आधारभूत डेटा और सफलता मानदंड निर्दिष्ट करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A social policy, by contrast, is often the outcome of an electoral promise or based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any comparable ex ante appraisal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसके विपरीत, एक सामाजिक नीति अक्सर चुनावी वादे का परिणाम होती है या अपेक्षित चुनावी लाभ पर आधारित होती है, और इसे बिना किसी तुलनीय पूर्व मूल्यांकन के लागू किया जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: Social policies affect human capabilities more directly than infrastructure projects.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं की तुलना में सामाजिक नीतियां मानवीय क्षमताओं को अधिक सीधे प्रभावित करती हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The scarcity of public resources and their alternative uses make ex ante appraisal of social sector schemes essential.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सार्वजनिक संसाधनों की कमी और उनके वैकल्पिक उपयोग सामाजिक क्षेत्र की योजनाओं का पूर्व-मूल्यांकन आवश्यक बनाते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Moreover, social policies are vulnerable to electoral clientelism, and should therefore adhere to the same principles of public expenditure as infrastructure projects — evidence, accountability, equity, efficiency and fiscal responsibility as infrastructure.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसके अलावा, सामाजिक नीतियां चुनावी ग्राहकवाद के प्रति संवेदनशील हैं, और इसलिए उन्हें बुनियादी ढांचे की परियोजनाओं के रूप में सार्वजनिक व्यय के समान सिद्धांतों का पालन करना चाहिए - बुनियादी ढांचे के रूप में साक्ष्य, जवाबदेही, इक्विटी, दक्षता और राजकोषीय जिम्मेदारी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The claim that the benefits of social policies are not quantifiable should not stop ex ante appraisal, as methodologies exist to overcome this barrier.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यह दावा कि सामाजिक नीतियों के लाभ मात्रात्मक नहीं हैं, पूर्व-मूल्यांकन को नहीं रोकना चाहिए, क्योंकि इस बाधा को दूर करने के लिए पद्धतियां मौजूद हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Quantitative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: आंकड़ों और संख्या पर आधारित — जिसे ठोस नंबरों और डेटा में मापा जा सके। इसके Synonyms हैं: Measurable, Numerical, Empirical और Antonyms हैं: Qualitative, Subjective, Unmeasurable।

hinglishTracks.en: An ex ante appraisal of a social project leaves an audit trail: the legislature, auditors, the media, and citizens can ask whether the project delivered what it promised.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — किसी सामाजिक परियोजना का पूर्व-मूल्यांकन एक ऑडिट ट्रेल छोड़ता है: विधायिका, लेखा परीक्षक, मीडिया और नागरिक पूछ सकते हैं कि क्या परियोजना ने जो वादा किया था उसे पूरा किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Many social schemes are implemented without the assessment of needs, identification of potential beneficiaries, or adequate funding, and a bureaucratic, top-down, target-chasing approach often replaces a democratic, bottom-up planning and implementation process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कई सामाजिक योजनाएं जरूरतों के मूल्यांकन, संभावित लाभार्थियों की पहचान या पर्याप्त फंडिंग के बिना लागू की जाती हैं, और एक नौकरशाही, ऊपर से नीचे, लक्ष्य का पीछा करने वाला दृष्टिकोण अक्सर लोकतांत्रिक, नीचे से ऊपर की योजना और कार्यान्वयन प्रक्रिया की जगह ले लेता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: This article explores the fiscal and economic fallout of cash transfers and universal subsidies.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह लेख नकद हस्तांतरण और सार्वभौमिक सब्सिडी के राजकोषीय और आर्थिक नतीजों की पड़ताल करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: If politics decides the desired social ends of such schemes, public finance and administration should decide the programme’s funding priority, the quantum of funding and the implementation process required to achieve those ends.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यदि राजनीति ऐसी योजनाओं के वांछित सामाजिक लक्ष्य तय करती है, तो सार्वजनिक वित्त और प्रशासन को कार्यक्रम की फंडिंग प्राथमिकता, फंडिंग की मात्रा और उन लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक कार्यान्वयन प्रक्रिया तय करनी चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: Prioritising expenditure is the first step in checking the desirability of public expenditure.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सार्वजनिक व्यय की वांछनीयता की जाँच करने के लिए व्यय को प्राथमिकता देना पहला कदम है।।

hinglishTracks.en: For example, the Government of Tamil Nadu allocated nearly ₹1,000 crore in 2026-27 to provide scholarships for girls and boys from Government schools to continue higher education.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उदाहरण के लिए, तमिलनाडु सरकार ने सरकारी स्कूलों की लड़कियों और लड़कों को उच्च शिक्षा जारी रखने के लिए छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान करने के लिए 2026-27 में लगभग ₹1,000 करोड़ आवंटित किए।।

hinglishTracks.en: A recent report in a Tamil Magazine ( Ananda Vikatan , November 18, 2026), based on replies it received to RTI applications, found 7,198 vacancies in permanent teaching positions in Government Arts and Science Colleges.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक तमिल पत्रिका (आनंद विकटन, 18 नवंबर, 2026) की हालिया रिपोर्ट में, आरटीआई आवेदनों पर प्राप्त उत्तरों के आधार पर, सरकारी कला और विज्ञान महाविद्यालयों में स्थायी शिक्षण पदों पर 7,198 रिक्तियां पाई गईं।।

hinglishTracks.en: If we include teacher vacancies in professional colleges and universities, the number should be nearly 9,000.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यदि हम पेशेवर कॉलेजों और विश्वविद्यालयों में शिक्षक रिक्तियों को शामिल करें, तो संख्या लगभग 9,000 होनी चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Filling these vacancies, delayed for over a decade, would cost ₹1,080 crore per annum, rising every year thereafter.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एक दशक से अधिक समय से विलंबित इन रिक्तियों को भरने पर प्रति वर्ष ₹1,080 करोड़ की लागत आएगी, जो उसके बाद हर साल बढ़ती जाएगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: With a huge revenue deficit and fiscal deficit, the State budget lacks the revenue cushion to spend an additional ₹1,080 crore per annum.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — भारी राजस्व घाटे और राजकोषीय घाटे के साथ, राज्य के बजट में प्रति वर्ष अतिरिक्त ₹1,080 करोड़ खर्च करने के लिए राजस्व सहायता का अभाव है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Prioritising is a normative decision: filling vacancies ensures students learn from regular teachers, whereas funding scholarships alone sends them to colleges without regular teachers.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #14 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 03:34:27 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are perpetual in nature and politically hard to reverse, such continuous commitment of financial resources demands prior evaluation and real-time monitoring to address potential shortcomings

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Business Standard reported on May 13, 2026 that “Cash-transfer promises have moved from the margins of Indian election manifestos to the centre of political competition, with parties across States promising monthly or one-time payments.” Quoting a PRS Legislative Research report, it further said, “12 States are expected to spend nearly ₹1.68 trillion on unconditional cash-transfer schemes for women in 2025-26, … the outgo is roughly equivalent to 0.5 per cent of India’s GDP, compared with less than 0.2 per cent two years ago.” The RBI report ‘State Finance: Study of State Budgets 2025-26’ reported that the total subsidy outlay increased from ₹1.87 trillion in 2018-19 to ₹4.26 trillion in 2025-26. States often implement promises from their election manifestos soon after forming the government and just before the next election, without any serious assessment of needs or financial commitments. Conception and funding of an infrastructure project are guided by a Detailed Project Report (DPR) that specifies objectives, alternatives considered, financial and economic analysis, risk mitigation, baseline data, and success criteria. A social policy, by contrast, is often the outcome of an electoral promise or based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any comparable ex ante appraisal. Social policies affect human capabilities more directly than infrastructure projects. The scarcity of public resources and their alternative uses make ex ante appraisal of social sector schemes essential. Moreover, social policies are vulnerable to electoral clientelism, and should therefore adhere to the same principles of public expenditure as infrastructure projects — evidence, accountability, equity, efficiency and fiscal responsibility as infrastructure. The claim that the benefits of social policies are not quantifiable should not stop ex ante appraisal, as methodologies exist to overcome this barrier. An ex ante appraisal of a social project leaves an audit trail: the legislature, auditors, the media, and citizens can ask whether the project delivered what it promised. Many social schemes are implemented without the assessment of needs, identification of potential beneficiaries, or adequate funding, and a bureaucratic, top-down, target-chasing approach often replaces a democratic, bottom-up planning and implementation process. This article explores the fiscal and economic fallout of cash transfers and universal subsidies. If politics decides the desired social ends of such schemes, public finance and administration should decide the programme’s funding priority, the quantum of funding and the implementation process required to achieve those ends. Prioritising expenditure is the first step in checking the desirability of public expenditure. For example, the Government of Tamil Nadu allocated nearly ₹1,000 crore in 2026-27 to provide scholarships for girls and boys from Government schools to continue higher education. A recent report in a Tamil Magazine ( Ananda Vikatan , November 18, 2026), based on replies it received to RTI applications, found 7,198 vacancies in permanent teaching positions in Government Arts and Science Colleges. If we include teacher vacancies in professional colleges and universities, the number should be nearly 9,000. Filling these vacancies, delayed for over a decade, would cost ₹1,080 crore per annum, rising every year thereafter. With a huge revenue deficit and fiscal deficit, the State budget lacks the revenue cushion to spend an additional ₹1,080 crore per annum. Prioritising is a normative decision: filling vacancies ensures students learn from regular teachers, whereas funding scholarships alone sends them to colleges without regular teachers. Deciding the quantum of funding and the process of execution requires ex ante evaluation. This should be explicitly oriented toward designing programmes that maximise impact for a given cost, using behavioural models and micro-simulations to predict the effects of hypothetical programmes before implementation.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For instance, a universal subsidy scheme is a trade-off between inclusion and exclusion errors. If it is truly universal, the scheme commits the error of including the undeserving and thus reduces the per-capita benefit to people in need. In a target-oriented scheme, it commits the error of excluding the deserving, but it increases the per-capita benefit to people in need. The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Quantitative (Adjective)
आंकड़ों और संख्या पर आधारित — जिसे ठोस नंबरों और डेटा में मापा जा सके।
✓ Syn: Measurable, Numerical, Empirical  |  ✖ Ant: Qualitative, Subjective, Unmeasurable
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are..." (Hinglish Arth: एक सामाजिक नीति अक्सर अपेक्षित चुनावी लाभ पर आधारित होती है, और बिना किसी पूर्व मूल्यांकन के लागू की जाती है; चूंकि नकद हस्तांतरण और सब्सिडी प्रकृति में सतत हैं और राजनीतिक रूप से इन्हें उलटना कठिन है, इसलिए ऐसी निरंतर कॉम)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes." (Hinglish Arth: दोनों के बीच चयन के लिए ऐसी योजनाओं के पूर्व मूल्यांकन की आवश्यकता होती है।)

articles.title: Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose substantial threat, India should not rush into trade deal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The latest proposal by the USTR takes the tariff framework on India back to what it was at the start of trade deal negotiations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The new 25% tariffs proposed by the U.S. on India do not pose a substantial risk to Indian exports, and India should go ahead with a trade deal only if it is balanced and reciprocal, according to exporters and trade and tariff experts. An analysis of India’s trade relationship with the U.S. over the last two years showed that the latest tariffs announced by the U.S. have returned the tariff relationship to where it was at the start of trade deal negotiations. The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative on Wednesday proposed a net tariff of 25% on goods imported from India, which could be reduced to 17% if a trade deal is signed by the two countries. The proposed 25% tariff is nearly the same as the 26% tariff U.S. President Donald Trump had originally proposed in his ‘Liberation Day’ reciprocal tariff measure in April 2025. A week later, Mr. Trump paused these tariffs in a bid to secure trade deals with other countries. In July 2025, he announced a 25% tariff on India, the same as what the USTR is now proposing. But Mr. Trump soon announced an additional 25% tariff as a penalty for India’s Russian oil imports taking the total tariff on Indian goods to 50%. During that time, Mr. Trump also announced a 50% tariff on the import of steel and aluminium from all countries. The latest tariffs by the USTR are not in addition to those tariffs, meaning Indian steel and aluminium will continue to attract a 50% duty. In February 2026, India and the U.S. issued a joint statement announcing the framework for an interim deal on trade, under which the U.S. would reduce its tariffs on Indian goods to 18%. This is very close to the 17% the U.S. is proposing now, should a deal be signed, nearly 10 months after the joint statement was issued. As such, the pre-deal, post-deal, and steel and aluminium tariffs by the U.S. on India largely remain where they were at the start of negotiations. Exporters and trade experts have said that India should proceed with a trade deal only if it satisfies Indian interests.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “FIEO supports the government’s efforts to conclude the Bilateral Trade Agreement at an early date,” said S.C. Ralhan, president of the Federation of Indian Export Organisations. “The agreement should be balanced and reciprocal, safeguard India’s long-term economic and developmental interests, and ensure that Indian exporters can compete on a level-playing field with suppliers from other countries in the U.S. market.”
