🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s official X handle ‘suspended’ amid anti-board protests over cheating case

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 02:22:42 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on November 25, 2026, apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The official X handle of the J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB) was reportedly suspended on Thursday (November 26, 2026), as protests against the recruitment board continued in the wake of the recent case of cheating during the Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) examination in Jammu. Meanwhile, activists and aspirants, who were seeking postponement of the Sub-Inspector examination, were allegedly detained in Jammu. Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on Wednesday (November 25), apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online. The JKSSB has not issued any statement on the suspension of its X handle. It had around 129.1K followers. Meanwhile, several aspirants held protests in Jammu against the Board and demanded postponement of the upcoming Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) examination scheduled for November 29. Meanwhile, the Board said it put in place fresh measures to check cheating. It has asked the Deputy Commissioners to appoint invigilation staff through a randomisation process, drawing from a pool of staff already identified. “Exam centres will be allotted to candidates at random, but admit cards will now be available for download only three days before the exam instead of seven,” it said. The magistrates have been tasked to supervise the frisking of candidates and exam staff. All staff deployed at a centre, including service providers, will have to hand in their mobile phones and other gadgets, which will be kept locked in the centre’s control room until the exam ends, it added. The Board also increased jammers at exam centres and pressed CCTV for live monitoring. Unsatisfied by the Board’s assurances, scores of aspirants held street protests in Jammu. Vinkal Sharma, an activist, said, “We demand postponement of the SI examination till the Board maintains transparency.” The J&K Students Association (JKSA) alleged that Mr. Sharma and over a dozen other protesters were detained by the police. “The detentions are deeply unfortunate and unjustified. It is an attempt to suppress legitimate democratic dissent. All detained students and aspirants should be released,” said the Association. Former Member of Parliament Aga Syed Ruhullah, in a post on X, said, “Enough of this blame game between the two power centres. They must stop passing responsibility and start acting. Postpone the November 29 JKPSI examination and constitute an independent SIT to probe the alleged JKSSB FAA irregularities. They are demanding justice, transparency and accountability. Their future cannot be held hostage to administrative failures.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On November 15, the J&K Police busted four “cheating modules” in Jammu during the Board’s examination for the FAA posts. Nearly 1.62 lakh aspirants had appeared for around 600 posts across J&K. The Board has faced more than three major allegations of scams during recruitment examinations in the past six years.

✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility

ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

प्रशासनिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administrative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s official X handle ‘suspended’ amid anti-board protests over cheating case", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on November 25, 2026, apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s official X' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s officia' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s officia' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on November 25, 2026, apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The official X handle of the J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB) was reportedly suspended on Thursday (November 26, 2026), as protests against the recruitment board continued in the wake of the recent case of cheating during the Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) examination in Jammu. Meanwhile, activists and aspirants, who were seeking postponement of the Sub-Inspector examination, were allegedly detained in Jammu. Official sources said the official handle of the Board on X was suspended on Wednesday (November 25), apparently due to large-scale reporting by protesting netizens online. The JKSSB has not issued any statement on the suspension of its X handle. It had around 129.1K followers. Meanwhile, several aspirants held protests in Jammu against the Board and demanded postponement of the upcoming Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) examination scheduled for November 29. Meanwhile, the Board said it put in place fresh measures to check cheating. It has asked the Deputy Commissioners to appoint invigilation staff through a randomisation process, drawing from a pool of staff already identified. “Exam centres will be allotted to candidates at random, but admit cards will now be available for download only three days before the exam instead of seven,” it said. The magistrates have been tasked to supervise the frisking of candidates and exam staff. All staff deployed at a centre, including service providers, will have to hand in their mobile phones and other gadgets, which will be kept locked in the centre’s control room until the exam ends, it added. The Board also increased jammers at exam centres and pressed CCTV for live monitoring. Unsatisfied by the Board’s assurances, scores of aspirants held street protests in Jammu. Vinkal Sharma, an activist, said, “We demand postponement of the SI examination till the Board maintains transparency.” The J&K Students Association (JKSA) alleged that Mr. Sharma and over a dozen other protesters were detained by the police. “The detentions are deeply unfortunate and unjustified. It is an attempt to suppress legitimate democratic dissent. All detained students and aspirants should be released,” said the Association. Former Member of Parliament Aga Syed Ruhullah, in a post on X, said, “Enough of this blame game between the two power centres. They must stop passing responsibility and start acting. Postpone the November 29 JKPSI examination and constitute an independent SIT to probe the alleged JKSSB FAA irregularities. They are demanding justice, transparency and accountability. Their future cannot be held hostage to administrative failures.”
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On November 15, the J&K Police busted four “cheating modules” in Jammu during the Board’s examination for the FAA posts. Nearly 1.62 lakh aspirants had appeared for around 600 posts across J&K. The Board has faced more than three major allegations of scams during recruitment examinations in the past six years.

articles.title: Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and Deputy Secretary of State, has died
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as Deputy Secretary of State under President Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday (November 26, 2026). He was 80. His son, Devin Talbott, confirmed he passed away peacefully after a long illness in his East Hampton, New York, home. The elder Talbott was educated at Yale and Oxford, where he bunked with Mr. Clinton. While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev, the former first secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, who was ousted in 1964. Talbott did, and it gave him some notoriety as a young man and a job at the magazine. After 21 years at Time , where he focused on Soviet-American relations and held positions including Washington bureau chief and a foreign-affairs columnist, according to his US State Department biography, he received a call from the newly elected Clinton. Then-Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao in conversation with visiting then-U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Strobe Talbot, in New Delhi on April 08, 1994. | Photo Credit: UNI Talbott joined the U.S. State Department in 1994, swiftly becoming Deputy Secretary of State. In that role, he was the architect of the Clinton administration's approach to Russia and other formerly Soviet countries and conducted negotiations between the US and India after the latter's nuclear tests in 1998. Afterward, he served as the president of Brookings from 2002 to 2017. In that time, he also chaired the U.S. State Department's Foreign Affairs Policy Board. Talbott also authored over a dozen books. His last book was titled “Our Founders' Warning: The Age of Reason Meets the Age of Trump,” which was published in 2020.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He was born in Dayton, Ohio, in 1946, and is survived by two sons, Devin and Adrian; stepdaughter Rebecca Ascher-Walsh; siblings Kirk, Marjo and Page Talbott; and eight grandchildren, according to the New York Times.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and Deputy Secretary of State, has died

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 10:28:12 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as Deputy Secretary of State under President Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday (November 26, 2026). He was 80. His son, Devin Talbott, confirmed he passed away peacefully after a long illness in his East Hampton, New York, home. The elder Talbott was educated at Yale and Oxford, where he bunked with Mr. Clinton. While at the British university, after interning for Time in Moscow, the magazine asked Talbott to help translate the leaked memoirs of Nikita Khrushchev, the former first secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, who was ousted in 1964. Talbott did, and it gave him some notoriety as a young man and a job at the magazine. After 21 years at Time , where he focused on Soviet-American relations and held positions including Washington bureau chief and a foreign-affairs columnist, according to his US State Department biography, he received a call from the newly elected Clinton. Then-Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao in conversation with visiting then-U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Strobe Talbot, in New Delhi on April 08, 1994. | Photo Credit: UNI Talbott joined the U.S. State Department in 1994, swiftly becoming Deputy Secretary of State. In that role, he was the architect of the Clinton administration's approach to Russia and other formerly Soviet countries and conducted negotiations between the US and India after the latter's nuclear tests in 1998. Afterward, he served as the president of Brookings from 2002 to 2017. In that time, he also chaired the U.S. State Department's Foreign Affairs Policy Board. Talbott also authored over a dozen books. His last book was titled “Our Founders' Warning: The Age of Reason Meets the Age of Trump,” which was published in 2020.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He was born in Dayton, Ohio, in 1946, and is survived by two sons, Devin and Adrian; stepdaughter Rebecca Ascher-Walsh; siblings Kirk, Marjo and Page Talbott; and eight grandchildren, according to the New York Times.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Conversation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conversation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
University (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'University' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

D. The author contends that 'Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Constitution is the guiding force for present, future, says Haryana CM Saini; Congress accuses BJP of undermining democracy
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them, said Nayab Singh Saini

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said that the Constitution is the guiding force for our present and future, which has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge, even as the Congress party accused the BJP of undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. “Over the past 77 years, the Constitution has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge. Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them,” said Mr. Saini, addressing the House during the special session of the Haryana State Assembly on the 77th anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution. He said that the true tribute to the framers of the Constitution would be to uphold the democratic path shown by them, maintain its decorum and contribute to building an India where justice is accessible to all, opportunities are available to everyone and the dignity of every citizen is protected. Meanwhile, as part of the party’s nationwide demonstration, Haryana Congress organised a ‘Samvidhan Raksha March’ in Panchkula. Led by AICC In-charge for Haryana Sanjay Dutt, Haryana Pradesh Congress Committee President Rao Narender Singh, and Congress Legislature Party Leader and former Chief Minister Bhupinder Singh Hooda, the march drew senior party leaders. Addressing the gathering, Mr. Dutt said that the country is passing through a decisive phase in which protecting the Constitution and democracy is no longer merely a political issue, but a question concerning the future of the nation. “Intoxicated by its arrogance of power, the BJP government is undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. Elections are the greatest expression of democracy. However, when serious questions are raised about the integrity of electoral rolls, complaints emerge regarding the deletion of voters’ names and doubts arise over the transparency of the electoral process, it signals a grave threat to the entire democratic framework.” Mr. Hooda said that any attack on the Constitution is a direct attack on the country’s democratic framework and the rights of its citizens. “The Congress Party will continue its struggle, both on the streets and inside legislatures, to safeguard the Constitution, the independence of constitutional institutions and free and fair elections,” he said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The HPCC president said “The anti-people policies and the BJP Government’s attitude towards democratic institutions have generated widespread public resentment.”

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Constitution is the guiding force for present, future, says Haryana CM Saini; Congress accuses BJP of undermining democracy

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 04:17:00 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them, said Nayab Singh Saini

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said that the Constitution is the guiding force for our present and future, which has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge, even as the Congress party accused the BJP of undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. “Over the past 77 years, the Constitution has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge. Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them,” said Mr. Saini, addressing the House during the special session of the Haryana State Assembly on the 77th anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution. He said that the true tribute to the framers of the Constitution would be to uphold the democratic path shown by them, maintain its decorum and contribute to building an India where justice is accessible to all, opportunities are available to everyone and the dignity of every citizen is protected. Meanwhile, as part of the party’s nationwide demonstration, Haryana Congress organised a ‘Samvidhan Raksha March’ in Panchkula. Led by AICC In-charge for Haryana Sanjay Dutt, Haryana Pradesh Congress Committee President Rao Narender Singh, and Congress Legislature Party Leader and former Chief Minister Bhupinder Singh Hooda, the march drew senior party leaders. Addressing the gathering, Mr. Dutt said that the country is passing through a decisive phase in which protecting the Constitution and democracy is no longer merely a political issue, but a question concerning the future of the nation. “Intoxicated by its arrogance of power, the BJP government is undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. Elections are the greatest expression of democracy. However, when serious questions are raised about the integrity of electoral rolls, complaints emerge regarding the deletion of voters’ names and doubts arise over the transparency of the electoral process, it signals a grave threat to the entire democratic framework.” Mr. Hooda said that any attack on the Constitution is a direct attack on the country’s democratic framework and the rights of its citizens. “The Congress Party will continue its struggle, both on the streets and inside legislatures, to safeguard the Constitution, the independence of constitutional institutions and free and fair elections,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The HPCC president said “The anti-people policies and the BJP Government’s attitude towards democratic institutions have generated widespread public resentment.”

articles.keyPoints:

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said that the Constitution is the guiding force for our present and future, which has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge, even as the Congress party accused the BJP of undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. “Over the past 77 years, the Constitution has shown the country the right path in overcoming every challenge. Respecting the Constitution is not the responsibility of any one political party or government, but the duty of every individual whom the people have entrusted with the opportunity to serve them,” said Mr. Saini, addressing the House during the special session of the Haryana State Assembly on the 77th anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution. He said that the true tribute to the framers of the Constitution would be to uphold the democratic path shown by them, maintain its decorum and contribute to building an India where justice is accessible to all, opportunities are available to everyone and the dignity of every citizen is protected. Meanwhile, as part of the party’s nationwide demonstration, Haryana Congress organised a ‘Samvidhan Raksha March’ in Panchkula. Led by AICC In-charge for Haryana Sanjay Dutt, Haryana Pradesh Congress Committee President Rao Narender Singh, and Congress Legislature Party Leader and former Chief Minister Bhupinder Singh Hooda, the march drew senior party leaders. Addressing the gathering, Mr. Dutt said that the country is passing through a decisive phase in which protecting the Constitution and democracy is no longer merely a political issue, but a question concerning the future of the nation. “Intoxicated by its arrogance of power, the BJP government is undermining democratic conventions, the independence of constitutional institutions and the voting rights of citizens. Elections are the greatest expression of democracy. However, when serious questions are raised about the integrity of electoral rolls, complaints emerge regarding the deletion of voters’ names and doubts arise over the transparency of the electoral process, it signals a grave threat to the entire democratic framework.” Mr. Hooda said that any attack on the Constitution is a direct attack on the country’s democratic framework and the rights of its citizens. “The Congress Party will continue its struggle, both on the streets and inside legislatures, to safeguard the Constitution, the independence of constitutional institutions and free and fair elections,” he said.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The HPCC president said “The anti-people policies and the BJP Government’s attitude towards democratic institutions have generated widespread public resentment.”

articles.title: Nitin Nabin accuses Congress party of insulting both Constitution and Ambedkar
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: He also alleged that the Congress party turned the Constitution into a tool for attaining power and also misused Article 356 to topple elected State governments 90 times

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) National President Nitin Nabin on Thursday (November 26, 2026) alleged that the Congress party misused the Constitution for the sake of power, whereas Prime Minister Narendra Modi has used for the upliftment of the last person, social justice, and public welfare. He said this while addressing an event titled ‘Samvidhan Gaurav Diwas’ (Constitution Pride Day), organised to mark ‘Constitution Day’ at Patna’s Gyan Bhawan. Paying tribute to the architects of the Constitution, he accused the Congress party of having insulted both the Constitution and Dr. Baba Saheb Bhimrao Ambedkar. He highlighted the government’s constitutional amendments, welfare schemes for the poor, and development initiatives in Bihar. He also called upon all citizens to fulfill their constitutional duties to help build a ‘Developed India’ (Viksit Bharat) by the year 2047. Attacking the opposition party, Mr. Nabin said, “It is essential to understand how the Congress party treated the Constitution once the party came to power. The Congress consistently prioritized its own vested interests and personal ambitions above the Constitution.” He further said, “Baba Saheb expressed hope on August 4, 1949 that Article 356 (President’s Rule) would remain a “dead letter”, a provision that would never actually be invoked. Instead, the Congress turned it into a weapon to crush state governments led by opposition parties.” “From the first imposition of President’s Rule in Punjab on June 20, 1951, to the dismissal of the first elected government in Kerala in 1959, the Congress toppled elected governments more than 90 times throughout its tenure. During the reign of Indira Gandhi alone, this power was politically misused 50 times—including 39 instances within an 11-year span,”Mr. Nabin said. Mr. Nabin accused that the Congress party humiliated the architect of the Constitution, Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar, at every occasion. “Today, Rahul Gandhi carries a copy of the Constitution, but that alone is not enough. He must internalise the Constitution and offer an apology to the nation for how his party treated its architect,”Mr. Nabin said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The BJP National President asserted that Prime Minister Narendra Modi, back in 2010—when he was the Chief Minister of Gujarat had organized a ‘Samvidhan Gaurav Yatra’ (Constitution Pride March) to mark the 60th anniversary of the Constitution.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Nitin Nabin accuses Congress party of insulting both Constitution and Ambedkar

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 02:51:20 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: He also alleged that the Congress party turned the Constitution into a tool for attaining power and also misused Article 356 to topple elected State governments 90 times

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) National President Nitin Nabin on Thursday (November 26, 2026) alleged that the Congress party misused the Constitution for the sake of power, whereas Prime Minister Narendra Modi has used for the upliftment of the last person, social justice, and public welfare. He said this while addressing an event titled ‘Samvidhan Gaurav Diwas’ (Constitution Pride Day), organised to mark ‘Constitution Day’ at Patna’s Gyan Bhawan. Paying tribute to the architects of the Constitution, he accused the Congress party of having insulted both the Constitution and Dr. Baba Saheb Bhimrao Ambedkar. He highlighted the government’s constitutional amendments, welfare schemes for the poor, and development initiatives in Bihar. He also called upon all citizens to fulfill their constitutional duties to help build a ‘Developed India’ (Viksit Bharat) by the year 2047. Attacking the opposition party, Mr. Nabin said, “It is essential to understand how the Congress party treated the Constitution once the party came to power. The Congress consistently prioritized its own vested interests and personal ambitions above the Constitution.” He further said, “Baba Saheb expressed hope on August 4, 1949 that Article 356 (President’s Rule) would remain a “dead letter”, a provision that would never actually be invoked. Instead, the Congress turned it into a weapon to crush state governments led by opposition parties.” “From the first imposition of President’s Rule in Punjab on June 20, 1951, to the dismissal of the first elected government in Kerala in 1959, the Congress toppled elected governments more than 90 times throughout its tenure. During the reign of Indira Gandhi alone, this power was politically misused 50 times—including 39 instances within an 11-year span,”Mr. Nabin said. Mr. Nabin accused that the Congress party humiliated the architect of the Constitution, Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar, at every occasion. “Today, Rahul Gandhi carries a copy of the Constitution, but that alone is not enough. He must internalise the Constitution and offer an apology to the nation for how his party treated its architect,”Mr. Nabin said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The BJP National President asserted that Prime Minister Narendra Modi, back in 2010—when he was the Chief Minister of Gujarat had organized a ‘Samvidhan Gaurav Yatra’ (Constitution Pride March) to mark the 60th anniversary of the Constitution.

Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Development (Adjective)
विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Upliftment (Adjective)
उत्थान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Upliftment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Opposition (Noun)
विरोध — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opposition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Nitin Nabin accuses Congress party of insulting both Constitution and Ambedkar", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. He also alleged that the Congress party turned the Constitution into a tool for attaining power and also misused Article 356 to topple elected State...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Nitin Nabin accuses Congress party of insulting ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Nitin Nabin accuses Congress party of insulti' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Nitin Nabin accuses Congress party of insulti' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "He also alleged that the Congress party turned the Constitution into a tool for attaining power and also misused Article 356 to topple elected State..." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने यह भी आरोप लगाया कि कांग्रेस पार्टी ने संविधान को सत्ता हासिल करने के लिए एक उपकरण में बदल दिया और निर्वाचित राज्य सरकारों को 90 बार गिराने के लिए अनुच्छेद 356 का दुरुपयोग भी किया।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Nitin Nabin accuses Congress party of insulting both Constitution and Ambedkar"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The BJP National President asserted that Prime Minister Narendra Modi, back in 2010—when he was the Chief Minister of Gujarat had organized a...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The BJP National President asserted that Prime Minister Narendra Modi, back in 2010—when he was the Chief Minister of Gujarat had organized a..." (Hinglish Arth: भाजपा के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष ने इस बात पर जोर दिया कि प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने 2010 में, जब वह गुजरात के मुख्यमंत्री थे, 60वीं वर्षगांठ के अवसर पर 'संविधान गौरव यात्रा' (संविधान गौरव मार्च) का आयोजन किया था।)

articles.title: Shocked to see use of heavy equipment at Sheshnag, no need for motorable roads to pilgrimages: Dr. Karan Singh
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘I was shocked to read that heavy earth moving equipment is being used to widen the route to Shri Amarnath ji, and that too at a spot overlooking Sheshnag, which is one of the most beautiful lakes in India,’ said Dr. Karan Singh

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior J&K politician Karan Singh on Thursday expressed shock over the use of heavy earth-moving equipment to widen the route to the Amarnath shrine close to the Sheshnag lake in Kashmir. Meanwhile, Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) president Mehbooba Mufti asked J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah to withdraw the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Border Roads Organisation (BRO) and explain the use of heavy machinery at the high-altitude glacial lake. “I was shocked to read that heavy earth-moving equipment is being used to widen the route to Shri Amarnath ji, and that too at a spot overlooking Sheshnag, which is one of the most beautiful lakes in India. I join my voice with those who are protesting about this, and would urge those concerned not to use heavy equipment on this route,” said Mr. Singh, who also served as the last Dogra Maharaja of J&K. He cautioned that there was no need “to make every pilgrim route into a motorable road just for the convenience of tourists”. “Genuine pilgrims will not mind walking or riding towards this great shrine. For many years I have been raising the disaster being caused to the Himalayas due to avoidable road widening, particularly on the pilgrim routes in Uttarakhand. I see no reason why tourists and pilgrims cannot manage with two-lane roads,” said Mr. Singh. He said in the name of tourists an unnecessary programme of road widening is underway, which involves extensive use of dynamite which severely damages the comparatively young Himalayas. “In fact, several disasters have already occurred, including the one at Kedarnath some years ago,” said Mr. Singh, in a statement. In a post on X, Mr. Singh’s son Vikramaditya Singh termed it “a collective duty to preserve the natural beauty and unique ecology of J&K for future generations”. “The felling and burning of protected Chinar and Chestnut trees in Kashmir, along with BRO road construction in close proximity to the sacred Sheshnag Lake, are deeply concerning developments. The fragile ecosystem of J&K, already under considerable stress, cannot afford such irreversible damage. I urge the J&K Government and the concerned authorities to take serious cognisance of these activities and ensure strict monitoring before it is too late,” said Mr. Singh. Meanwhile, Ms. Mufti of the PDP expressed dissatisfaction over J&K Forest minister Altaf Kalooo’s statement that “all was well at the Sheshnag lake and there was no violation at the site”. Addressing a press conference in Srinagar, Ms. Mufti demanded that the Omar Abdullah government should halt use of heavy machines like JCB and cancel the MoU with the BRO. “The JCB should be removed from Sheshnag and the work stopped till environment specialists visit the site. Also. the MoU signed with the BRO should be made public. The MoU signed by the government should be brought to the public domain. Is the use of JCB part of the MoU?” said Ms. Mufti.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: She also targeted the government on the extension granted to the BRO. “Mr. Abdullah needs to explain why the extension was given,” she added.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Shocked to see use of heavy equipment at Sheshnag, no need for motorable roads to pilgrimages: Dr. Karan Singh

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 02:33:56 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘I was shocked to read that heavy earth moving equipment is being used to widen the route to Shri Amarnath ji, and that too at a spot overlooking Sheshnag, which is one of the most beautiful lakes in India,’ said Dr. Karan Singh

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior J&K politician Karan Singh on Thursday expressed shock over the use of heavy earth-moving equipment to widen the route to the Amarnath shrine close to the Sheshnag lake in Kashmir. Meanwhile, Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) president Mehbooba Mufti asked J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah to withdraw the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Border Roads Organisation (BRO) and explain the use of heavy machinery at the high-altitude glacial lake. “I was shocked to read that heavy earth-moving equipment is being used to widen the route to Shri Amarnath ji, and that too at a spot overlooking Sheshnag, which is one of the most beautiful lakes in India. I join my voice with those who are protesting about this, and would urge those concerned not to use heavy equipment on this route,” said Mr. Singh, who also served as the last Dogra Maharaja of J&K. He cautioned that there was no need “to make every pilgrim route into a motorable road just for the convenience of tourists”. “Genuine pilgrims will not mind walking or riding towards this great shrine. For many years I have been raising the disaster being caused to the Himalayas due to avoidable road widening, particularly on the pilgrim routes in Uttarakhand. I see no reason why tourists and pilgrims cannot manage with two-lane roads,” said Mr. Singh. He said in the name of tourists an unnecessary programme of road widening is underway, which involves extensive use of dynamite which severely damages the comparatively young Himalayas. “In fact, several disasters have already occurred, including the one at Kedarnath some years ago,” said Mr. Singh, in a statement. In a post on X, Mr. Singh’s son Vikramaditya Singh termed it “a collective duty to preserve the natural beauty and unique ecology of J&K for future generations”. “The felling and burning of protected Chinar and Chestnut trees in Kashmir, along with BRO road construction in close proximity to the sacred Sheshnag Lake, are deeply concerning developments. The fragile ecosystem of J&K, already under considerable stress, cannot afford such irreversible damage. I urge the J&K Government and the concerned authorities to take serious cognisance of these activities and ensure strict monitoring before it is too late,” said Mr. Singh. Meanwhile, Ms. Mufti of the PDP expressed dissatisfaction over J&K Forest minister Altaf Kalooo’s statement that “all was well at the Sheshnag lake and there was no violation at the site”. Addressing a press conference in Srinagar, Ms. Mufti demanded that the Omar Abdullah government should halt use of heavy machines like JCB and cancel the MoU with the BRO. “The JCB should be removed from Sheshnag and the work stopped till environment specialists visit the site. Also. the MoU signed with the BRO should be made public. The MoU signed by the government should be brought to the public domain. Is the use of JCB part of the MoU?” said Ms. Mufti.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: She also targeted the government on the extension granted to the BRO. “Mr. Abdullah needs to explain why the extension was given,” she added.

articles.title: Mercury in cosmetics: What does the Keralam case reveal about health risks of skin-lightening creams | Explained
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: What does the recent case in Keralam reveal about mercury poisoning from cosmetics? How does exposure affect the kidneys, and what safeguards are in place to regulate unsafe products?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The quest for beauty and the enduring appeal for fair and blemishfree skin goes back to ages and across cultures. However, in recent years, this has been landing people in hospitals with serious health issues, as it happened in the case of the 17-year-old girl from Areekode in Malappuram district in Keralam. Persuaded by many social influencers who raved about a face cream which gave them fair, blemishfree skin, she had also been using the same for over a year. The product with the brand name F-TUNES - claimed to contain turmeric and other “natural ingredients” and cited Dubai as the place of manufacture. She was hospitalised after she developed severe symptoms like fainting spells, swelling on legs and fall in blood pressure and was diagnosed with Membranous nephropathy, a condition wherein the immune system gets dysregulated, triggering nephrotic syndrome (heavy loss of protein through urine). Doctors traced her condition to the heavy mercury content in the face cream she was using. Lab analysis of a sample of the skin lightning cream obtained from the patient revealed that the product contained 12,500 ppm of mercury, way over the legal limit of 1 ppm After prolonged treatment, the girl is now recovering. The police and drug regulatory authorities have begun a crackdown on the dubious cosmetic products in the market . The Health Minister has also threatened action against social influencers who are peddling dubious cosmetics online Mercury is a highly toxic heavy metal and it can inhibit tyrosinase, a key enzyme produced by skin cells to produce melanin, the natural pigment that gives colour to skin and hair. The mercury in the face cream stops the production of new melanin and thins out the skin, giving it a lightening effect. 📰 Mercury in cosmetics: What does the Keralam case reveal about health risks of skin-lightening creams | Explained

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 11:34:41 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: What does the recent case in Keralam reveal about mercury poisoning from cosmetics? How does exposure affect the kidneys, and what safeguards are in place to regulate unsafe products?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The quest for beauty and the enduring appeal for fair and blemishfree skin goes back to ages and across cultures. However, in recent years, this has been landing people in hospitals with serious health issues, as it happened in the case of the 17-year-old girl from Areekode in Malappuram district in Keralam. Persuaded by many social influencers who raved about a face cream which gave them fair, blemishfree skin, she had also been using the same for over a year. The product with the brand name F-TUNES - claimed to contain turmeric and other “natural ingredients” and cited Dubai as the place of manufacture. She was hospitalised after she developed severe symptoms like fainting spells, swelling on legs and fall in blood pressure and was diagnosed with Membranous nephropathy, a condition wherein the immune system gets dysregulated, triggering nephrotic syndrome (heavy loss of protein through urine). Doctors traced her condition to the heavy mercury content in the face cream she was using. Lab analysis of a sample of the skin lightning cream obtained from the patient revealed that the product contained 12,500 ppm of mercury, way over the legal limit of 1 ppm After prolonged treatment, the girl is now recovering. The police and drug regulatory authorities have begun a crackdown on the dubious cosmetic products in the market . The Health Minister has also threatened action against social influencers who are peddling dubious cosmetics online Mercury is a highly toxic heavy metal and it can inhibit tyrosinase, a key enzyme produced by skin cells to produce melanin, the natural pigment that gives colour to skin and hair. The mercury in the face cream stops the production of new melanin and thins out the skin, giving it a lightening effect. The higher the content of mercury, the more spectacular the lightening effect, which consumers perceive as the product’s effectiveness.

articles.title: Kallakurichi MLA-woman IAS officer harassment case in Tamil Nadu: a timeline
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Here’s a timeline of how the Kallakurichi MLA-IAS officer row in Tamil Nadu unfolded, the Opposition’s charges and more

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tamil Nadu’s Kallakurichi MLA C. Arul Vignesh has been at the centre of a political storm after he was accused of and booked on charges of misbehaving with a woman IAS officer. However, Mr. Vignesh, an MLA of the ruling Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) in Tamil Nadu , denied the charges earlier this month (November 2026). It is alleged that the TVK MLA Arul Vignesh sent an inappropriate message to the woman IAS officer and behaved in an indecent manner under the influence of alcohol at her official residence. The issue first surfaced on social media. Here’s a timeline of how the Kallakurichi MLA-woman IAS officer row unfolded, the allegations against the TVK legislator, the Opposition’s charges and more about the case that has stirred controversy in a major embarrassment for Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay-led TVK government that has come to power for the first time. November 9, 2026 — DMK Parliamentary Party leader Kanimozhi Karunanidhi puts up a post on X, pointing out claims on social media that the TVK MLA had sent an inappropriate message to the officer and had visited her residence in an inebriated state. She demands a response from the TVK president and Chief Minister Mr. Vijay on the issue. November 10, 2026 — Kallakurichi MLA Arul Vignesh denies the charges and insists that the allegations made against him on social media were part of the “dirty politics” played by the Opposition. “I have always maintained high respect for government officers. False messages are being spread against me on social media,” he said. November 12, 2026 — The DMK submits a petition to the Director-General of Police (DGP), demanding action against Mr. Arul Vignesh over the allegations. DMK president M.K. Stalin says Mr. Vijay should take ‘real action’ against the erring MLA. November 12, 2026 — Tamil Nadu Minister for Law and Energy Resources C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar denies the allegations against the TVK MLA. Responding to allegations made by Kanimozhi, he said it was condemnable and inappropriate on her part to make a statement based on the rumour she had come across on social media. November 13, 2026 — Tamil Nadu Social Justice Minister Vanni Arasu, who is the Minister in-charge for Kallakurichi district , says there is a responsibility to protect women entering public life and those working in government service. Arasu, who belongs to VCK, an ally of the TVK, says, “The VCK has always stood with victims and on the side of justice.” November 15, 2026 — The National Commission for Women takes suo moto cognisance of the allegations and asks the DGP to conduct an impartial inquiry. The Commission calls for a detailed Action Taken Report (ATR) within seven days.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: November 23, 2026 — State Public Prosecutor (SPP) R. John Sathyan submits before the Madras High Court that neither Chief Secretary M. Sai Kumar nor the police had received any representation/complaint from the woman IAS officer while it was earlier alleged that the woman IAS officer submitted a complaint to the Chief Secretary on July 31. The submission was made during the hearing of a writ petition (criminal) filed by advocate R. Thrishuli, who had sought a direction to the police to register a case.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Kallakurichi MLA-woman IAS officer harassment case in Tamil Nadu: a timeline

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 09:17:46 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Here’s a timeline of how the Kallakurichi MLA-IAS officer row in Tamil Nadu unfolded, the Opposition’s charges and more

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tamil Nadu’s Kallakurichi MLA C. Arul Vignesh has been at the centre of a political storm after he was accused of and booked on charges of misbehaving with a woman IAS officer. However, Mr. Vignesh, an MLA of the ruling Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) in Tamil Nadu , denied the charges earlier this month (November 2026). It is alleged that the TVK MLA Arul Vignesh sent an inappropriate message to the woman IAS officer and behaved in an indecent manner under the influence of alcohol at her official residence. The issue first surfaced on social media. Here’s a timeline of how the Kallakurichi MLA-woman IAS officer row unfolded, the allegations against the TVK legislator, the Opposition’s charges and more about the case that has stirred controversy in a major embarrassment for Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay-led TVK government that has come to power for the first time. November 9, 2026 — DMK Parliamentary Party leader Kanimozhi Karunanidhi puts up a post on X, pointing out claims on social media that the TVK MLA had sent an inappropriate message to the officer and had visited her residence in an inebriated state. She demands a response from the TVK president and Chief Minister Mr. Vijay on the issue. November 10, 2026 — Kallakurichi MLA Arul Vignesh denies the charges and insists that the allegations made against him on social media were part of the “dirty politics” played by the Opposition. “I have always maintained high respect for government officers. False messages are being spread against me on social media,” he said. November 12, 2026 — The DMK submits a petition to the Director-General of Police (DGP), demanding action against Mr. Arul Vignesh over the allegations. DMK president M.K. Stalin says Mr. Vijay should take ‘real action’ against the erring MLA. November 12, 2026 — Tamil Nadu Minister for Law and Energy Resources C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar denies the allegations against the TVK MLA. Responding to allegations made by Kanimozhi, he said it was condemnable and inappropriate on her part to make a statement based on the rumour she had come across on social media. November 13, 2026 — Tamil Nadu Social Justice Minister Vanni Arasu, who is the Minister in-charge for Kallakurichi district , says there is a responsibility to protect women entering public life and those working in government service. Arasu, who belongs to VCK, an ally of the TVK, says, “The VCK has always stood with victims and on the side of justice.” November 15, 2026 — The National Commission for Women takes suo moto cognisance of the allegations and asks the DGP to conduct an impartial inquiry. The Commission calls for a detailed Action Taken Report (ATR) within seven days.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: November 23, 2026 — State Public Prosecutor (SPP) R. John Sathyan submits before the Madras High Court that neither Chief Secretary M. Sai Kumar nor the police had received any representation/complaint from the woman IAS officer while it was earlier alleged that the woman IAS officer submitted a complaint to the Chief Secretary on July 31. The submission was made during the hearing of a writ petition (criminal) filed by advocate R. Thrishuli, who had sought a direction to the police to register a case.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tamil Nadu’s Kallakurichi MLA C. Arul Vignesh has been at the centre of a political storm after he was accused of and booked on charges of misbehaving with a woman IAS officer. However, Mr. Vignesh, an MLA of the ruling Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) in Tamil Nadu , denied the charges earlier this month (November 2026). It is alleged that the TVK MLA Arul Vignesh sent an inappropriate message to the woman IAS officer and behaved in an indecent manner under the influence of alcohol at her official residence. The issue first surfaced on social media. Here’s a timeline of how the Kallakurichi MLA-woman IAS officer row unfolded, the allegations against the TVK legislator, the Opposition’s charges and more about the case that has stirred controversy in a major embarrassment for Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay-led TVK government that has come to power for the first time. November 9, 2026 — DMK Parliamentary Party leader Kanimozhi Karunanidhi puts up a post on X, pointing out claims on social media that the TVK MLA had sent an inappropriate message to the officer and had visited her residence in an inebriated state. She demands a response from the TVK president and Chief Minister Mr. Vijay on the issue. November 10, 2026 — Kallakurichi MLA Arul Vignesh denies the charges and insists that the allegations made against him on social media were part of the “dirty politics” played by the Opposition. “I have always maintained high respect for government officers. False messages are being spread against me on social media,” he said. November 12, 2026 — The DMK submits a petition to the Director-General of Police (DGP), demanding action against Mr. Arul Vignesh over the allegations. DMK president M.K. Stalin says Mr. Vijay should take ‘real action’ against the erring MLA. November 12, 2026 — Tamil Nadu Minister for Law and Energy Resources C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar denies the allegations against the TVK MLA. Responding to allegations made by Kanimozhi, he said it was condemnable and inappropriate on her part to make a statement based on the rumour she had come across on social media. November 13, 2026 — Tamil Nadu Social Justice Minister Vanni Arasu, who is the Minister in-charge for Kallakurichi district , says there is a responsibility to protect women entering public life and those working in government service. Arasu, who belongs to VCK, an ally of the TVK, says, “The VCK has always stood with victims and on the side of justice.” November 15, 2026 — The National Commission for Women takes suo moto cognisance of the allegations and asks the DGP to conduct an impartial inquiry. The Commission calls for a detailed Action Taken Report (ATR) within seven days.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: November 23, 2026 — State Public Prosecutor (SPP) R. John Sathyan submits before the Madras High Court that neither Chief Secretary M. Sai Kumar nor the police had received any representation/complaint from the woman IAS officer while it was earlier alleged that the woman IAS officer submitted a complaint to the Chief Secretary on July 31. The submission was made during the hearing of a writ petition (criminal) filed by advocate R. Thrishuli, who had sought a direction to the police to register a case.

articles.title: J&K Congress leader Peerzada Mohammad Sayeed dies at 73
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Sayeed, a four-time MLA, was also a Minister in PDP-Congress and NC-Congress coalition governments from 2002 to 2014

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior Congress leader and sitting legislator from Anantnag, Peerzada Mohammad Sayeed, 73, passed away on Thursday (November 26, 2026) evening, according to the family. Mr. Sayeed has been unwell recently. The last rites will be performed at his native place Damhal Achabal in south Kashmir’s Anantnag. Mr. Sayeed won the 2024 Assembly elections on a Congress ticket from the Anantnag constituency by a thin margin of 1600 votes. He was elected for the first time from the Kokernag constituency in 1987 and managed to win the seat again in 2002 and 2008. A law graduate, Mr. Sayeed also served as president of the Jammu and Kashmir Pradesh Congress Committee (JKPCC). Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi and Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge expressed deep grief over the demise of veteran Congress leader. In a post on X, Mr. Gandhi said, “The news of Syed’s passing was deeply saddening. I express my deepest condolences to his family, friends and supporters at this time of grief. His loyalty to the party and his contribution to public service will always be remembered.” Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge also recalled “his unwavering commitment to the Congress and dedicated service to the people”. Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Friday (November 27, 2026) expressed grief over the death of veteran Congress leader and Anantnag MLA Peerzada Mohammad Sayeed. “Chief Minister has expressed deep grief over the passing away of Peerzada Mohammad Syed, MLA Anantnag and former Minister,” said a post on X by the official handle of Office of Chief Minister, J&K.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Paying rich tributes to Sayeed, Mr. Abdullah recalled his long and distinguished career in public service and his invaluable contributions to the welfare of the people of Jammu and Kashmir, it said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 J&K Congress leader Peerzada Mohammad Sayeed dies at 73

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 12:21:59 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Sayeed, a four-time MLA, was also a Minister in PDP-Congress and NC-Congress coalition governments from 2002 to 2014

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior Congress leader and sitting legislator from Anantnag, Peerzada Mohammad Sayeed, 73, passed away on Thursday (November 26, 2026) evening, according to the family. Mr. Sayeed has been unwell recently. The last rites will be performed at his native place Damhal Achabal in south Kashmir’s Anantnag. Mr. Sayeed won the 2024 Assembly elections on a Congress ticket from the Anantnag constituency by a thin margin of 1600 votes. He was elected for the first time from the Kokernag constituency in 1987 and managed to win the seat again in 2002 and 2008. A law graduate, Mr. Sayeed also served as president of the Jammu and Kashmir Pradesh Congress Committee (JKPCC). Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi and Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge expressed deep grief over the demise of veteran Congress leader. In a post on X, Mr. Gandhi said, “The news of Syed’s passing was deeply saddening. I express my deepest condolences to his family, friends and supporters at this time of grief. His loyalty to the party and his contribution to public service will always be remembered.” Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge also recalled “his unwavering commitment to the Congress and dedicated service to the people”. Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Friday (November 27, 2026) expressed grief over the death of veteran Congress leader and Anantnag MLA Peerzada Mohammad Sayeed. “Chief Minister has expressed deep grief over the passing away of Peerzada Mohammad Syed, MLA Anantnag and former Minister,” said a post on X by the official handle of Office of Chief Minister, J&K.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Paying rich tributes to Sayeed, Mr. Abdullah recalled his long and distinguished career in public service and his invaluable contributions to the welfare of the people of Jammu and Kashmir, it said.

संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।

विरोध — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opposition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Commitment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Commitment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

A. Sayeed, a four-time MLA, was also a Minister in PDP-Congress and NC-Congress coalition governments from 2002 to 2014.

articles.title: No need for CBI probe in Kallakurichi TVK MLA case: Thirumavalavan
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Tamil Nadu government is taking appropriate legal action, says VCK leader

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK) founder Thol. Thirumavalavan on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said there was no need for a CBI probe into the allegations that the Kallakurichi TVK MLA had sent inappropriate messages to a District Collector. He said the Tamil Nadu government was taking appropriate legal action. Speaking to journalists at Chennai, he said the VCK had consistently maintained that strict action should be taken against the MLA if he had sent messages to the Collector in a manner that caused mental distress. “We have now received confirmation that a District Collector has formally lodged a complaint. Following this, the government has acted swiftly, registered a case against the particular MLA and initiated an investigation . We do not see any need for the CBI to intervene at this stage,” he said. Responding to questions about the alleged delay in taking action, with 116 days having elapsed since the incident, Mr. Thirumavalavan said it was important to distinguish between the date of the alleged incident and the date on which the formal complaint was lodged. “The incident came to light through the media and social media. The information available to us is that the Collector lodged a formal complaint only recently . We also learnt through social media reports that, when the incident occurred, she had not submitted a written complaint but had sought that the MLA be called and warned,” he contended. He was responding to allegations that the Collector had earlier brought the matter to the attention of the Chief Secretary, who had allegedly attempted to persuade her to seek a transfer to another district. Opposition parties have cited the alleged delay and the handling of the complaint as reasons for seeking a CBI probe. “Now that she has come forward and lodged a complaint, I believe the government is acting swiftly. A case has been registered under the appropriate sections, and I am confident that legal action will follow,” Mr. Thirumavalavan said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi / Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 No need for CBI probe in Kallakurichi TVK MLA case: Thirumavalavan

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 09:16:28 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Tamil Nadu government is taking appropriate legal action, says VCK leader

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK) founder Thol. Thirumavalavan on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said there was no need for a CBI probe into the allegations that the Kallakurichi TVK MLA had sent inappropriate messages to a District Collector. He said the Tamil Nadu government was taking appropriate legal action. Speaking to journalists at Chennai, he said the VCK had consistently maintained that strict action should be taken against the MLA if he had sent messages to the Collector in a manner that caused mental distress. “We have now received confirmation that a District Collector has formally lodged a complaint. Following this, the government has acted swiftly, registered a case against the particular MLA and initiated an investigation . We do not see any need for the CBI to intervene at this stage,” he said. Responding to questions about the alleged delay in taking action, with 116 days having elapsed since the incident, Mr. Thirumavalavan said it was important to distinguish between the date of the alleged incident and the date on which the formal complaint was lodged. “The incident came to light through the media and social media. The information available to us is that the Collector lodged a formal complaint only recently . We also learnt through social media reports that, when the incident occurred, she had not submitted a written complaint but had sought that the MLA be called and warned,” he contended. He was responding to allegations that the Collector had earlier brought the matter to the attention of the Chief Secretary, who had allegedly attempted to persuade her to seek a transfer to another district. Opposition parties have cited the alleged delay and the handling of the complaint as reasons for seeking a CBI probe. “Now that she has come forward and lodged a complaint, I believe the government is acting swiftly. A case has been registered under the appropriate sections, and I am confident that legal action will follow,” Mr. Thirumavalavan said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi / Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Investigation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Chiruthaigal (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Chiruthaigal' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Confirmation (Noun)
इसकी सूचना देने वाला — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Confirmation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Information (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Information' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "No need for CBI probe in Kallakurichi TVK MLA case: Thirumavalavan", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Tamil Nadu government is taking appropriate legal action, says VCK leader.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'No need for CBI probe in Kallakurichi TVK MLA ca' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'No need for CBI probe in Kallakurichi TVK MLA' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'No need for CBI probe in Kallakurichi TVK MLA' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Tamil Nadu government is taking appropriate legal action, says VCK leader." (Hinglish Arth: वीसीके नेता का कहना है कि तमिलनाडु सरकार उचित कानूनी कार्रवाई कर रही है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "No need for CBI probe in Kallakurichi TVK MLA case: Thirumavalavan"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Tamil Nadu / Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi / Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Tamil Nadu / Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi / Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam." (Hinglish Arth: तमिलनाडु / विदुथलाई चिरुथिगल काची / तमिलगा वेट्ट्री कज़गम)

articles.title: Several people of Kotia villages asked to appear before Koraput Sub Collector’s office
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The police cases and hefty surety amount shocked people living in Ganjaibhadra, Pagaluchennuru and Pattuchennuru villages

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Hundreds of villagers living in Kotia group of villages are eagerly waiting for the Andhra Pradesh government’s response with regard to arrests and bind over cases filed against the people who wanted to be under the administrative jurisdiction of AP. Ahead of AP’s scheduled panchayat elections on December 2 , 2026, the Odisha government has put notices on walls of the houses of villagers, asking them to attend for the hearing of cases at Koraput sub collector’s office on November 27, 2026 (Friday). According to locals, the villagers including Bachhala Prasada Rao, Tadangi Rajesh, Gemmala Bheeshu, Tadangi Sannam, Chodipilli Raju, Gemmala Somulu, B. Adilakshmi, G. Lakshmi, Chinta Ramulu and others received notices and were asked to deposit Rs.1.5 lakh surety amount to get bails. The police cases and hefty surety amount shocked people living in Ganjaibhadra, Pagaluchennuru and Pattuchennuru villages where the panchayat elections would be held on December 2, 2026. Recently, the locals had a heated argument with Odisha police and revenue officials during the ZPTC/MPTC elections while clearly mentioning that they would like to be with AP government. It is said that this was the main reason for the Odisha police to give notices ahead of Panchayat elections. The villagers who are happy with AP government’s welfare schemes are keen to take part in panchayat elections. They alleged that the Odisha government was trying to disrupt the election process and make people remain indoors on the day of elections. Former Deputy Chief Minister Peedika Rajanna Dora alleged that AP government’s inaction and silence over the harassment had given an opportunity for the Odisha to file false cases against the innocent villagers. While speaking to The Hindu over telephone, he said that NDA government’s are in power both in AP and Odisha and were supposed to resolve the issue instead of causing mental agony to local people. “The Center should resolve the jurisdiction issue to put an end to the controversy that has been in existence almost since Independence. Otherwise, the people will continue to face many troubles,” said Mr. Rajanna Dora who is former MLA of Salur.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The present Salur MLA and Minister for Tribal Welfare Gummadi Sandhya Rani expressed displeasure over the filing of cases against the villagers. Meanwhile, Parvatipuram-Manyam district hoped that the elections would be conducted in spite of the strong objection from the Odisha government while referring to good response for MPTC/ZPTC elections in Kotia group of villages on November 5, 2026.

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Several people of Kotia villages asked to appear before Koraput Sub Collector’s office

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 09:04:46 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The police cases and hefty surety amount shocked people living in Ganjaibhadra, Pagaluchennuru and Pattuchennuru villages

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Hundreds of villagers living in Kotia group of villages are eagerly waiting for the Andhra Pradesh government’s response with regard to arrests and bind over cases filed against the people who wanted to be under the administrative jurisdiction of AP. Ahead of AP’s scheduled panchayat elections on December 2 , 2026, the Odisha government has put notices on walls of the houses of villagers, asking them to attend for the hearing of cases at Koraput sub collector’s office on November 27, 2026 (Friday). According to locals, the villagers including Bachhala Prasada Rao, Tadangi Rajesh, Gemmala Bheeshu, Tadangi Sannam, Chodipilli Raju, Gemmala Somulu, B. Adilakshmi, G. Lakshmi, Chinta Ramulu and others received notices and were asked to deposit Rs.1.5 lakh surety amount to get bails. The police cases and hefty surety amount shocked people living in Ganjaibhadra, Pagaluchennuru and Pattuchennuru villages where the panchayat elections would be held on December 2, 2026. Recently, the locals had a heated argument with Odisha police and revenue officials during the ZPTC/MPTC elections while clearly mentioning that they would like to be with AP government. It is said that this was the main reason for the Odisha police to give notices ahead of Panchayat elections. The villagers who are happy with AP government’s welfare schemes are keen to take part in panchayat elections. They alleged that the Odisha government was trying to disrupt the election process and make people remain indoors on the day of elections. Former Deputy Chief Minister Peedika Rajanna Dora alleged that AP government’s inaction and silence over the harassment had given an opportunity for the Odisha to file false cases against the innocent villagers. While speaking to The Hindu over telephone, he said that NDA government’s are in power both in AP and Odisha and were supposed to resolve the issue instead of causing mental agony to local people. “The Center should resolve the jurisdiction issue to put an end to the controversy that has been in existence almost since Independence. Otherwise, the people will continue to face many troubles,” said Mr. Rajanna Dora who is former MLA of Salur.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The present Salur MLA and Minister for Tribal Welfare Gummadi Sandhya Rani expressed displeasure over the filing of cases against the villagers. Meanwhile, Parvatipuram-Manyam district hoped that the elections would be conducted in spite of the strong objection from the Odisha government while referring to good response for MPTC/ZPTC elections in Kotia group of villages on November 5, 2026.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Jurisdiction (Noun)
अधिकार क्षेत्र — न्यायालय या किसी संस्था की वह कानूनी सीमा जहाँ तक वह आदेश दे सके।
✓ Syn: Authority, Sovereignty, Cognizance  |  ✖ Ant: Powerlessness, Subordination, Incompetence
Administrative (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administrative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Independence (Adjective / Verb)
आज़ादी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Independence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Opportunity (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Opportunity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Several people of Kotia villages asked to appear before Koraput Sub Collector’s office", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The police cases and hefty surety amount shocked people living in Ganjaibhadra, Pagaluchennuru and Pattuchennuru villages.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Several people of Kotia villages asked to appear' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Several people of Kotia villages asked to app' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Several people of Kotia villages asked to app' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The police cases and hefty surety amount shocked people living in Ganjaibhadra, Pagaluchennuru and Pattuchennuru villages
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Hundreds of villagers living in Kotia group of villages are eagerly waiting for the Andhra Pradesh government’s response with regard to arrests and bind over cases filed against the people who wanted to be under the administrative jurisdiction of AP. Ahead of AP’s scheduled panchayat elections on December 2 , 2026, the Odisha government has put notices on walls of the houses of villagers, asking them to attend for the hearing of cases at Koraput sub collector’s office on November 27, 2026 (Friday). According to locals, the villagers including Bachhala Prasada Rao, Tadangi Rajesh, Gemmala Bheeshu, Tadangi Sannam, Chodipilli Raju, Gemmala Somulu, B. Adilakshmi, G. Lakshmi, Chinta Ramulu and others received notices and were asked to deposit Rs.1.5 lakh surety amount to get bails. The police cases and hefty surety amount shocked people living in Ganjaibhadra, Pagaluchennuru and Pattuchennuru villages where the panchayat elections would be held on December 2, 2026. Recently, the locals had a heated argument with Odisha police and revenue officials during the ZPTC/MPTC elections while clearly mentioning that they would like to be with AP government. It is said that this was the main reason for the Odisha police to give notices ahead of Panchayat elections. The villagers who are happy with AP government’s welfare schemes are keen to take part in panchayat elections. They alleged that the Odisha government was trying to disrupt the election process and make people remain indoors on the day of elections. Former Deputy Chief Minister Peedika Rajanna Dora alleged that AP government’s inaction and silence over the harassment had given an opportunity for the Odisha to file false cases against the innocent villagers. While speaking to The Hindu over telephone, he said that NDA government’s are in power both in AP and Odisha and were supposed to resolve the issue instead of causing mental agony to local people. “The Center should resolve the jurisdiction issue to put an end to the controversy that has been in existence almost since Independence. Otherwise, the people will continue to face many troubles,” said Mr. Rajanna Dora who is former MLA of Salur.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The present Salur MLA and Minister for Tribal Welfare Gummadi Sandhya Rani expressed displeasure over the filing of cases against the villagers. Meanwhile, Parvatipuram-Manyam district hoped that the elections would be conducted in spite of the strong objection from the Odisha government while referring to good response for MPTC/ZPTC elections in Kotia group of villages on November 5, 2026.
