articles.title: Bangladesh’s Opposition party blasts Australian media reports over leader’s visit
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The party said the legal notice sent to The Australian newspaper pointed out ‘seven defamatory imputations and demands corrections, retraction of the report, an apology and the preservation of relevant documents’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh’s main Opposition party, Jamaat-e-Islami, has sent a legal notice to a major Australian newspaper for publishing a report against its party chief, who has returned from the country, cutting short his overseas tour amid a controversy over his visit. In a statement, the party late on Thursday (November 28, 2026) said the legal notice sent to The Australian newspaper pointed out “seven defamatory imputations and demands corrections, retraction of the report, an apology and the preservation of relevant documents” involving Jamaat Ameer Shafiqur Rahman’s tour. “The publisher has been asked to provide a written response within 48 hours,” the statement said but did not explain what measure the party would take if the news outlet did not comply with the demand. The report by The Australian described Mr. Rahman as a "Hamas-praising Bangladesh Islamist leader" and criticised the Australian government for allowing him into the country without stricter visa screening. The Jamaat firmly rejected the report and said Mr. Rahman's early return was due to pressing organisational commitments in Bangladesh. The Jamaat chief reached Sydney on November 20 as part of a weeklong overseas tour to Australia and Malaysia. In Australia, he was scheduled to hold meetings with senior Australian government officials in Canberra and join receptions and community gatherings. But a major media and diplomatic controversy erupted on November 23 when The Australian published a report titled “Sinwar was a hero': Fury as Hamas-praising Bangladesh Islamist leader arrives. Other Australian Jewish and Hindu advocacy groups alleged that he has in the past made statements comparing working women to prostitutes and eulogising former Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar. Jamaat secretary general Mia Golam Porwar called the report "false, misleading and defamatory". His foreign affairs advisor and lawmaker Barrister Mir Ahmad Bin Quasem sent the formal legal notice to the publisher of The Australian .

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Porwar said the entire report was based on the application seeking the cancellation of Mr. Rahman’s visa by an immigration representative and “it is understood that the individual in question is the writer and director of Baba, a film glorifying (Bangladesh’s founder) Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and his family”.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Bangladesh’s Opposition party blasts Australian media reports over leader’s visit

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 08:59:18 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The party said the legal notice sent to The Australian newspaper pointed out ‘seven defamatory imputations and demands corrections, retraction of the report, an apology and the preservation of relevant documents’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh’s main Opposition party, Jamaat-e-Islami, has sent a legal notice to a major Australian newspaper for publishing a report against its party chief, who has returned from the country, cutting short his overseas tour amid a controversy over his visit. In a statement, the party late on Thursday (November 28, 2026) said the legal notice sent to The Australian newspaper pointed out “seven defamatory imputations and demands corrections, retraction of the report, an apology and the preservation of relevant documents” involving Jamaat Ameer Shafiqur Rahman’s tour. “The publisher has been asked to provide a written response within 48 hours,” the statement said but did not explain what measure the party would take if the news outlet did not comply with the demand. The report by The Australian described Mr. Rahman as a "Hamas-praising Bangladesh Islamist leader" and criticised the Australian government for allowing him into the country without stricter visa screening. The Jamaat firmly rejected the report and said Mr. Rahman's early return was due to pressing organisational commitments in Bangladesh. The Jamaat chief reached Sydney on November 20 as part of a weeklong overseas tour to Australia and Malaysia. In Australia, he was scheduled to hold meetings with senior Australian government officials in Canberra and join receptions and community gatherings. But a major media and diplomatic controversy erupted on November 23 when The Australian published a report titled “Sinwar was a hero': Fury as Hamas-praising Bangladesh Islamist leader arrives. Other Australian Jewish and Hindu advocacy groups alleged that he has in the past made statements comparing working women to prostitutes and eulogising former Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar. Jamaat secretary general Mia Golam Porwar called the report "false, misleading and defamatory". His foreign affairs advisor and lawmaker Barrister Mir Ahmad Bin Quasem sent the formal legal notice to the publisher of The Australian .

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Porwar said the entire report was based on the application seeking the cancellation of Mr. Rahman’s visa by an immigration representative and “it is understood that the individual in question is the writer and director of Baba, a film glorifying (Bangladesh’s founder) Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and his family”.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The party said the legal notice sent to The Australian newspaper pointed out ‘seven defamatory imputations and demands corrections, retraction of the report, an apology and the preservation of relevant documents’
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh’s main Opposition party, Jamaat-e-Islami, has sent a legal notice to a major Australian newspaper for publishing a report against its party chief, who has returned from the country, cutting short his overseas tour amid a controversy over his visit. In a statement, the party late on Thursday (November 28, 2026) said the legal notice sent to The Australian newspaper pointed out “seven defamatory imputations and demands corrections, retraction of the report, an apology and the preservation of relevant documents” involving Jamaat Ameer Shafiqur Rahman’s tour. “The publisher has been asked to provide a written response within 48 hours,” the statement said but did not explain what measure the party would take if the news outlet did not comply with the demand. The report by The Australian described Mr. Rahman as a "Hamas-praising Bangladesh Islamist leader" and criticised the Australian government for allowing him into the country without stricter visa screening. The Jamaat firmly rejected the report and said Mr. Rahman's early return was due to pressing organisational commitments in Bangladesh. The Jamaat chief reached Sydney on November 20 as part of a weeklong overseas tour to Australia and Malaysia. In Australia, he was scheduled to hold meetings with senior Australian government officials in Canberra and join receptions and community gatherings. But a major media and diplomatic controversy erupted on November 23 when The Australian published a report titled “Sinwar was a hero': Fury as Hamas-praising Bangladesh Islamist leader arrives. Other Australian Jewish and Hindu advocacy groups alleged that he has in the past made statements comparing working women to prostitutes and eulogising former Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar. Jamaat secretary general Mia Golam Porwar called the report "false, misleading and defamatory". His foreign affairs advisor and lawmaker Barrister Mir Ahmad Bin Quasem sent the formal legal notice to the publisher of The Australian .
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Porwar said the entire report was based on the application seeking the cancellation of Mr. Rahman’s visa by an immigration representative and “it is understood that the individual in question is the writer and director of Baba, a film glorifying (Bangladesh’s founder) Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and his family”.

articles.title: Major storm batters U.S. on Thanksgiving holiday; 400 flights cancelled
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: New York’s famed Macy’s parade was postponed for the first time in its 100-year history

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A powerful storm disrupted Thanksgiving celebrations for millions of Americans on Thursday (November 26, 2026), as New York’s famed Macy’s parade was postponed for the first time in its 100-year history. Heavy rain and strong winds from the “Nor’easter” battered the central and eastern United States, creating treacherous travel conditions during one of the country’s busiest holiday periods. As families were gathering for traditional holiday feasts, more than 900,000 homes and businesses were without power, with Pennsylvania, Maryland and Virginia particularly hard hit, according to tracking website PowerOutage. At airports, nearly 400 flights were canceled and over 2,000 were delayed in the United States, mostly in the East, figures from FlightAware showed. New York’s famed parade, which sees brightly colored balloons travel through the heart of Manhattan, was pushed back to Saturday (November 28, 2026) due to what organizers said was an “abundance of caution.” Millions of people typically gather to catch a glimpse of the festivities. The only other time the parade was not held on Thanksgiving Thursday was when it was canceled for three years during World War II. Organizers would have been only too aware of the gusting winds that wrecked the parade back in 1997 when a careening 18-foot figure of the “Cat in the Hat” toppled a lamppost, knocking one bystander unconscious. “While we are heartbroken that our parade was postponed, the safety of our partners, the safety of our participants — and spectators — is and always will be our top priority,” said Macy’s parade executive producer Will Coss. While flooding was reported up and down the East Coast, impacts were also felt inland, with powerful gusts and inundated soil leading to trees tumbling over onto power lines and homes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Authorities in the Maryland suburbs of the US capital, worried about the impact of power outages on the water treatment network, asked nearly two million customers to conserve tap water consumption.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Major storm batters U.S. on Thanksgiving holiday; 400 flights cancelled

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 12:52:02 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: New York’s famed Macy’s parade was postponed for the first time in its 100-year history

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A powerful storm disrupted Thanksgiving celebrations for millions of Americans on Thursday (November 26, 2026), as New York’s famed Macy’s parade was postponed for the first time in its 100-year history. Heavy rain and strong winds from the “Nor’easter” battered the central and eastern United States, creating treacherous travel conditions during one of the country’s busiest holiday periods. As families were gathering for traditional holiday feasts, more than 900,000 homes and businesses were without power, with Pennsylvania, Maryland and Virginia particularly hard hit, according to tracking website PowerOutage. At airports, nearly 400 flights were canceled and over 2,000 were delayed in the United States, mostly in the East, figures from FlightAware showed. New York’s famed parade, which sees brightly colored balloons travel through the heart of Manhattan, was pushed back to Saturday (November 28, 2026) due to what organizers said was an “abundance of caution.” Millions of people typically gather to catch a glimpse of the festivities. The only other time the parade was not held on Thanksgiving Thursday was when it was canceled for three years during World War II. Organizers would have been only too aware of the gusting winds that wrecked the parade back in 1997 when a careening 18-foot figure of the “Cat in the Hat” toppled a lamppost, knocking one bystander unconscious. “While we are heartbroken that our parade was postponed, the safety of our partners, the safety of our participants — and spectators — is and always will be our top priority,” said Macy’s parade executive producer Will Coss. While flooding was reported up and down the East Coast, impacts were also felt inland, with powerful gusts and inundated soil leading to trees tumbling over onto power lines and homes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Authorities in the Maryland suburbs of the US capital, worried about the impact of power outages on the water treatment network, asked nearly two million customers to conserve tap water consumption.

articles.title: New Zealand PM Luxon loses majority, centrists now kingmakers
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: If Christopher Luxon doesn’t strike a deal with centrist newcomers Opportunity, the country could be headed for another election

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon’s right-wing coalition lost its parliamentary majority, final results from this month’s election showed on Friday (November 27, 2026), plunging the country into political uncertainty with an insurgent centrist party set to play kingmaker. Preliminary results of the November 7 poll had Mr. Luxon’s National Party-led coalition clinging onto power. But margins were so tight that his party lost two seats in the final results announced Friday -- leaving his coalition with the populist New Zealand First and the libertarian ACT one seat short of a majority. Mr. Luxon declared he had a mandate to form the country’s next government in the wake of this month’s vote, bitterly fought and dominated by spiralling costs of living in the South Pacific country. He has run a caretaker government since the November 7 poll. But he will now need the backing of the centrist newcomers Opportunity, led by Qiulae Wong, if he wants to govern. And if a deal isn’t struck, the country could be headed for another election. Pledging a kinder, gentler politics as well as action on climate change, her party became the first in decades to make parliament without a former cabinet minister leader. Wong has vowed to work with whichever party has the largest number of seats.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: But she has insisted that her party’s “bottom lines” on climate change action, cost of living and cleaning up politics are non-negotiable.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 New Zealand PM Luxon loses majority, centrists now kingmakers

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 10:17:30 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: If Christopher Luxon doesn’t strike a deal with centrist newcomers Opportunity, the country could be headed for another election

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon’s right-wing coalition lost its parliamentary majority, final results from this month’s election showed on Friday (November 27, 2026), plunging the country into political uncertainty with an insurgent centrist party set to play kingmaker. Preliminary results of the November 7 poll had Mr. Luxon’s National Party-led coalition clinging onto power. But margins were so tight that his party lost two seats in the final results announced Friday -- leaving his coalition with the populist New Zealand First and the libertarian ACT one seat short of a majority. Mr. Luxon declared he had a mandate to form the country’s next government in the wake of this month’s vote, bitterly fought and dominated by spiralling costs of living in the South Pacific country. He has run a caretaker government since the November 7 poll. But he will now need the backing of the centrist newcomers Opportunity, led by Qiulae Wong, if he wants to govern. And if a deal isn’t struck, the country could be headed for another election. Pledging a kinder, gentler politics as well as action on climate change, her party became the first in decades to make parliament without a former cabinet minister leader. Wong has vowed to work with whichever party has the largest number of seats.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: But she has insisted that her party’s “bottom lines” on climate change action, cost of living and cleaning up politics are non-negotiable.

Coalition (Noun)
गठबंधन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Coalition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "New Zealand PM Luxon loses majority, centrists now kingmakers", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. If Christopher Luxon doesn’t strike a deal with centrist newcomers Opportunity, the country could be headed for another election.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'New Zealand PM Luxon loses majority, centrists n' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'New Zealand PM Luxon loses majority, centrist' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "But she has insisted that her party’s “bottom lines” on climate change action, cost of living and cleaning up politics are non-negotiable." articles.title: President Donald Trump insists Nvidia CEO not a security threat
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Jensen Huang sudden resignation saw the stock price of Nvidia plummet, before a shock decision by the board to reinstate him saw a partial rebound

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday (November 26, 2026) that he had seen sufficient information that Nvidia’s Jensen Huang was not a security threat, while touting his administration’s intervention to save the scandal-plagued CEO’s job as “a great thing” for the world. “I think he’s absolutely fine,” Mr. Trump told reporters at his Mar-a-Lago estate. Asked by AFP how he could be sure when the Justice Department would not confirm it had conducted a thorough investigation into Mr. Huang, Mr. Trump said his belief was based on “information I have, which is a lot of information.” Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return brings open-weight AI debate to forefront in Washington Jensen Huang won’t need a pardon, says U.S. Vice President, as scrutiny of Nvidia scandal builds in Washington How Jensen Huang’s affair puts Nvidia and American AI at risk? (Recorded before his resignation) | In Focus Podcast Mr. Huang, a key figure in the AI revolution, was forced to resign earlier this month after revelations that he had an affair with a business executive who reportedly has ties to Chinese intelligence and whose company may have helped China obtain advanced chips in violation of U.S. export controls. His sudden resignation saw the stock price of Nvidia plummet , before a shock decision by the board to reinstate him saw a partial rebound . Mr. Trump revealed that he and other officials in his administration have worked behind the scenes to push for Huang to be reinstated, in a highly unusual intervention by the government into a top company’s decision making.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “I just thought, I saw that what was happening with the company, what was happening with the stock, and I think it’s a great thing that he’s going back,” Mr. Trump said.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 President Donald Trump insists Nvidia CEO not a security threat

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 07:01:35 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Jensen Huang sudden resignation saw the stock price of Nvidia plummet, before a shock decision by the board to reinstate him saw a partial rebound

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday (November 26, 2026) that he had seen sufficient information that Nvidia’s Jensen Huang was not a security threat, while touting his administration’s intervention to save the scandal-plagued CEO’s job as “a great thing” for the world. “I think he’s absolutely fine,” Mr. Trump told reporters at his Mar-a-Lago estate. Asked by AFP how he could be sure when the Justice Department would not confirm it had conducted a thorough investigation into Mr. Huang, Mr. Trump said his belief was based on “information I have, which is a lot of information.” Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return brings open-weight AI debate to forefront in Washington Jensen Huang won’t need a pardon, says U.S. Vice President, as scrutiny of Nvidia scandal builds in Washington How Jensen Huang’s affair puts Nvidia and American AI at risk? (Recorded before his resignation) | In Focus Podcast Mr. Huang, a key figure in the AI revolution, was forced to resign earlier this month after revelations that he had an affair with a business executive who reportedly has ties to Chinese intelligence and whose company may have helped China obtain advanced chips in violation of U.S. export controls. His sudden resignation saw the stock price of Nvidia plummet , before a shock decision by the board to reinstate him saw a partial rebound . Mr. Trump revealed that he and other officials in his administration have worked behind the scenes to push for Huang to be reinstated, in a highly unusual intervention by the government into a top company’s decision making.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “I just thought, I saw that what was happening with the company, what was happening with the stock, and I think it’s a great thing that he’s going back,” Mr. Trump said.

A. Jensen Huang sudden resignation saw the stock price of Nvidia plummet, before a shock decision by the board to reinstate him saw a partial rebound.

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: Brazil’s Lula appoints private banker as Finance Minister
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Lula’s shock election win in October sent stock markets tumbling while the national currency, the real, weakened significantly

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has appointed private banking executive Luiz Carlos Trabuco as Finance Minister for his next term, the presidency said on Thursday (November 26, 2026). Mr. Lula’s shock election win in October sent stock markets tumbling while the national currency, the real, weakened significantly. The appointment of Mr. Trabuco, chairman of the board of Bradesco bank, aims to reassure the business community in Latin America’s largest economy. “Luiz Carlos Trabuco has accepted President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva’s invitation to take the helm of the finance ministry,” the presidency stated, specifying that the banker agreed to take the job during an afternoon meeting with the Brazilian leader. Mr. Lula will begin his fourth non-consecutive term in office in January and has so far only named one minister for that mandate. Bradesco is one of Brazil’s largest private banks. Ahead of the official announcement, rumors circulating about Mr. Trabuco’s new job appeared to restore market confidence. The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange was up 6% at closing on Thursday (November 26, 2026).
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The national currency meanwhile regained strength after briefly crossing the symbolic threshold of six reais to the dollar on Monday.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Brazil’s Lula appoints private banker as Finance Minister

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 10:34:00 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Lula’s shock election win in October sent stock markets tumbling while the national currency, the real, weakened significantly

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has appointed private banking executive Luiz Carlos Trabuco as Finance Minister for his next term, the presidency said on Thursday (November 26, 2026). Mr. Lula’s shock election win in October sent stock markets tumbling while the national currency, the real, weakened significantly. The appointment of Mr. Trabuco, chairman of the board of Bradesco bank, aims to reassure the business community in Latin America’s largest economy. “Luiz Carlos Trabuco has accepted President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva’s invitation to take the helm of the finance ministry,” the presidency stated, specifying that the banker agreed to take the job during an afternoon meeting with the Brazilian leader. Mr. Lula will begin his fourth non-consecutive term in office in January and has so far only named one minister for that mandate. Bradesco is one of Brazil’s largest private banks. Ahead of the official announcement, rumors circulating about Mr. Trabuco’s new job appeared to restore market confidence. The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange was up 6% at closing on Thursday (November 26, 2026).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The national currency meanwhile regained strength after briefly crossing the symbolic threshold of six reais to the dollar on Monday.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Announcement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

A. Lula’s shock election win in October sent stock markets tumbling while the national currency, the real, weakened significantly.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Returning to Nvidia’s Santa Clara headquarters in California on Monday (November 23, 2026), and standing on the ground floor of the atrium, Jensen Huang apologised to employees and vowed to be a better CEO

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Within two weeks, Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s co-founder, went from being an AI rainmaker, whose chips and business ingenuity kick-started the AI revolution, to a sex-and-spy scandal-hit CEO, who quit the company he built from scratch and helmed for over three decades, and then returned as its boss once again after a band of tech billionaires intensely lobbied the Trump administration for his reinstatement.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Returning to Nvidia’s Santa Clara headquarters in California on Monday (November 23, 2026), and standing on the ground floor of the atrium, Mr. Huang apologised to employees and vowed to be a better CEO as staff cheered to see their chief back, whose exit wiped out close to a quarter of the company’s market value. Mr. Huang’s return buoyed the market as Nvidia’s stock soared, adding nearly a trillion dollars in market value the day he was back at Nvidia.

articles.title: Apple pulls MiniMax AI chatbot from App Store over child safety concerns
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: China cracked down on domestic AI companion apps including Xingye, banning intimate ⁠relationships for minors and ordering platforms to develop strict guardrails

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Apple this ‌week removed MiniMax’s popular chatbot app Talkie from its App Store worldwide ​after media reports alleged that the product’s AI-generated characters sent ⁠sexualised messages to minors. Launched in 2023, Talkie offers a wide array of companions for users to chat with, often with romantic undertones. Shanghai-based MiniMax also has a Chinese version ‌called Xingye. ABC News and the Bureau of Investigative Journalism on Wednesday reported the app’s characters had sent sexually inappropriate and abusive ‌messages to children. The app has an 18+ rating on both the ‌Apple ⁠App Store and Google Play Store and depending on the ⁠country, the app says children aged under 14 or under 16 cannot sign up. But child safety advocates have criticised its lax verification safeguards, which allow users to self-report their age. MiniMax ​and Apple did not immediately ‌respond to requests for comment. Talkie is offered in a range of languages and is particularly popular in the U.S., the Philippines and Mexico according to research firm Sensor Tower. Unlike AI assistants commonly found on large language ‌models like ChatGPT or Gemini, AI companions are designed for sustained emotional ​engagement and human-like interactions with users, some with immersive storylines. Talkie and Xingye have been big revenue drivers for MiniMax, contributing ⁠over 60% of its income in 2024. The company stopped breaking out chatbot-related revenue shares this year. Talkie had roughly 11 million monthly active users across its ‌app and website as of October 2026, according to Chinese research firm Unique.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: MiniMax has shifted its focus to enterprise coding and multimodal AI models such as MiniMax M1 and Hailuo-02, especially after its Hong Kong IPO in January.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Apple pulls MiniMax AI chatbot from App Store over child safety concerns

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 09:26:25 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: China cracked down on domestic AI companion apps including Xingye, banning intimate ⁠relationships for minors and ordering platforms to develop strict guardrails

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Apple this ‌week removed MiniMax’s popular chatbot app Talkie from its App Store worldwide ​after media reports alleged that the product’s AI-generated characters sent ⁠sexualised messages to minors. Launched in 2023, Talkie offers a wide array of companions for users to chat with, often with romantic undertones. Shanghai-based MiniMax also has a Chinese version ‌called Xingye. ABC News and the Bureau of Investigative Journalism on Wednesday reported the app’s characters had sent sexually inappropriate and abusive ‌messages to children. The app has an 18+ rating on both the ‌Apple ⁠App Store and Google Play Store and depending on the ⁠country, the app says children aged under 14 or under 16 cannot sign up. But child safety advocates have criticised its lax verification safeguards, which allow users to self-report their age. MiniMax ​and Apple did not immediately ‌respond to requests for comment. Talkie is offered in a range of languages and is particularly popular in the U.S., the Philippines and Mexico according to research firm Sensor Tower. Unlike AI assistants commonly found on large language ‌models like ChatGPT or Gemini, AI companions are designed for sustained emotional ​engagement and human-like interactions with users, some with immersive storylines. Talkie and Xingye have been big revenue drivers for MiniMax, contributing ⁠over 60% of its income in 2024. The company stopped breaking out chatbot-related revenue shares this year. Talkie had roughly 11 million monthly active users across its ‌app and website as of October 2026, according to Chinese research firm Unique.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: MiniMax has shifted its focus to enterprise coding and multimodal AI models such as MiniMax M1 and Hailuo-02, especially after its Hong Kong IPO in January.

सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।

Verification (Noun)
सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Apple pulls MiniMax AI chatbot from App Store over child safety concerns", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. China cracked down on domestic AI companion apps including Xingye, banning intimate ⁠relationships for minors and ordering platforms to develop...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Apple pulls MiniMax AI chatbot from App Store ov' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

hinglishTracks.en: The story so far: In the Harry Potter fandom, the house of Gryffindor is associated with courage, valour, and virtue.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अब तक की कहानी: हैरी पॉटर प्रशंसकों में, ग्रिफ़िंडोर का घर साहस, वीरता और सदाचार से जुड़ा हुआ है।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, Meta’s ‘Project Gryffindor’ — the internal name for the social media company’s School Partnership Programme — is sparking safety concerns and backlash from experts, according to a report by news outlet NPR.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हालाँकि, समाचार आउटलेट एनपीआर की एक रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, मेटा का 'प्रोजेक्ट ग्रिफिंडर' - सोशल मीडिया कंपनी के स्कूल पार्टनरशिप प्रोग्राम का आंतरिक नाम - सुरक्षा चिंताओं और विशेषज्ञों की प्रतिक्रिया को जन्म दे रहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Internal' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Internal' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Meta’s School Partnership Programme, introduced in March 2025, was pitched as a way to help educators and parents report teen safety issues and bullying directly to the company.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मेटा का स्कूल पार्टनरशिप प्रोग्राम, मार्च 2025 में शुरू किया गया था, जिसे शिक्षकों और अभिभावकों को किशोर सुरक्षा मुद्दों और सीधे कंपनी को धमकाने की रिपोर्ट करने में मदद करने के तरीके के रूप में पेश किया गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: A ‘School Partner’ feature allowed academic institutions to link themselves with Instagram and get prioritised reviews for their reports.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक 'स्कूल पार्टनर' सुविधा ने शैक्षणिक संस्थानों को खुद को इंस्टाग्राम से जोड़ने और अपनी रिपोर्ट के लिए प्राथमिकता वाली समीक्षा प्राप्त करने की अनुमति दी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

articles.title: Prototype of Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX rover unveiled
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Chandrayaan-5/LuPEX mission is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series of lunar missions; JAXA, the Japanese space agency, unveiled the rover in Japan on November 25

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Japanese Space Agency, JAXA, has unveiled the prototype of the rover for the Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX (LUnar Polar EXploration) mission. The Chandrayaan-5/LuPEX mission is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series of lunar missions to study the lunar volatile materials, including lunar water, in the vicinity of a Permanently Shadowed Region in the lunar South pole. The JAXA unveiled the rover at the Chofu Aerospace Centre in Japan on November 25 and conducted a test demonstration. The mission, which is scheduled to be launched in 2028 by the Japanese H3-24L launch vehicle, is a joint collaboration between the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and the JAXA. 🌕️JAXA調布航空宇宙センターでの走行試験映像をたっぷりお届けします！ こちらの動画をご利用の際には以下のJDAのご利用方法を参照ください☺️ https://t.co/iKvpw12FrY https://t.co/Lb4x45zNA0 While the rover will be developed by the JAXA, the ISRO will be developing the lunar lander and will also be developing a few scientific instruments for the mission. “The scientific instruments for this mission would be contributed by the ISRO, JAXA, European Space Agency (ESA) and National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), all thematically connected with the exploration and in-situ analysis of the volatiles reserved in the lunar polar region,” the ISRO had earlier said. The NASA’s Neutron Spectrometer (NS) will also be onboard the rover, and according to the Japanese space agency, it is a neutron detector designed to search for water beneath the lunar surface. Similarly, the ESA’s Exploration Mass Spectrometer for LUPEX (EMS-L) will also be part of the mission.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The ESA said that the EMS-L would investigate the moon’s extremely thin exosphere, a tenuous mist of atoms and molecules surrounding the lunar surface.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Prototype of Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX rover unveiled

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 11:56:59 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Chandrayaan-5/LuPEX mission is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series of lunar missions; JAXA, the Japanese space agency, unveiled the rover in Japan on November 25

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Japanese Space Agency, JAXA, has unveiled the prototype of the rover for the Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX (LUnar Polar EXploration) mission. The Chandrayaan-5/LuPEX mission is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series of lunar missions to study the lunar volatile materials, including lunar water, in the vicinity of a Permanently Shadowed Region in the lunar South pole. The JAXA unveiled the rover at the Chofu Aerospace Centre in Japan on November 25 and conducted a test demonstration. The mission, which is scheduled to be launched in 2028 by the Japanese H3-24L launch vehicle, is a joint collaboration between the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and the JAXA. 🌕️JAXA調布航空宇宙センターでの走行試験映像をたっぷりお届けします！ こちらの動画をご利用の際には以下のJDAのご利用方法を参照ください☺️ https://t.co/iKvpw12FrY https://t.co/Lb4x45zNA0 While the rover will be developed by the JAXA, the ISRO will be developing the lunar lander and will also be developing a few scientific instruments for the mission. “The scientific instruments for this mission would be contributed by the ISRO, JAXA, European Space Agency (ESA) and National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), all thematically connected with the exploration and in-situ analysis of the volatiles reserved in the lunar polar region,” the ISRO had earlier said. The NASA’s Neutron Spectrometer (NS) will also be onboard the rover, and according to the Japanese space agency, it is a neutron detector designed to search for water beneath the lunar surface. Similarly, the ESA’s Exploration Mass Spectrometer for LUPEX (EMS-L) will also be part of the mission.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The ESA said that the EMS-L would investigate the moon’s extremely thin exosphere, a tenuous mist of atoms and molecules surrounding the lunar surface.

Core Context & Background: Parties agreed to arrangements for the Adaptation Fund to serve the Paris Agreement exclusively once the first share of proceeds under Article 6.4 (the Paris Agreement’s carbon-market mechanism) turns into revenue, though this fund is practically underfunded

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: STORY SO FAR: Countries at the 31st UN climate conference (COP31) in Antalya, Turkiye, failed to reach consensus on the ‘cover text,’ called the Antalya Pact. This was after a standoff over phasing out fossil fuels pushed the talks a record 48 hours past its scheduled end of Friday (November 20, 2026) The immediate trigger was a “cover text” put forward by COP 31 president Murat Kurum, Turkiye’s Environment Minister. This is an overarching political decision that frames the outcome of a conference and is usually finalised last. Like every outcome, it needs the agreement of all parties. No country or bloc holds a veto but every clause must be accepted by all 190-plus delegations.

hinglishTracks.en: Parties agreed to arrangements for the Adaptation Fund to serve the Paris Agreement exclusively once the first share of proceeds under Article 6.4 (the Paris Agreement’s carbon-market mechanism) turns into revenue, though this fund is practically underfunded
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अनुच्छेद 6.4 (पेरिस समझौते का कार्बन-बाज़ार तंत्र) के तहत आय का पहला हिस्सा राजस्व में बदल जाने के बाद पार्टियाँ विशेष रूप से पेरिस समझौते की सेवा के लिए अनुकूलन निधि की व्यवस्था करने पर सहमत हुईं, हालाँकि यह निधि व्यावहारिक रूप से कम है। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Adaptation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अनुकूलन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Adaptation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: STORY SO FAR: Countries at the 31st UN climate conference (COP31) in Antalya, Turkiye, failed to reach consensus on the ‘cover text,’ called the Antalya Pact.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अब तक की कहानी: अंताल्या, तुर्किये में 31वें संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु सम्मेलन (COP31) में देश, अंताल्या संधि नामक 'कवर टेक्स्ट' पर आम सहमति तक पहुंचने में विफल रहे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Conference' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conference' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: This was after a standoff over phasing out fossil fuels pushed the talks a record 48 hours past its scheduled end of Friday (November 20, 2026)
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ऐसा तब हुआ जब जीवाश्म ईंधन को चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त करने पर गतिरोध के कारण वार्ता शुक्रवार (नवंबर 20, 2026) के निर्धारित समय से 48 घंटे पहले रिकॉर्ड स्तर पर पहुंच गई।।

hinglishTracks.en: The immediate trigger was a “cover text” put forward by COP 31 president Murat Kurum, Turkiye’s Environment Minister.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — तत्काल ट्रिगर सीओपी 31 के अध्यक्ष मूरत कुरुम, तुर्किये के पर्यावरण मंत्री द्वारा प्रस्तुत किया गया एक "कवर टेक्स्ट" था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: This is an overarching political decision that frames the outcome of a conference and is usually finalised last.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यह एक व्यापक राजनीतिक निर्णय है जो एक सम्मेलन के परिणाम को तैयार करता है और आमतौर पर इसे सबसे अंत में अंतिम रूप दिया जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Conference' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conference' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Like every outcome, it needs the agreement of all parties.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हर नतीजे की तरह इसमें भी सभी पक्षों की सहमति की जरूरत होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: No country or bloc holds a veto but every clause must be accepted by all 190-plus delegations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — किसी भी देश या गुट के पास वीटो नहीं है लेकिन प्रत्येक खंड को सभी 190 से अधिक प्रतिनिधिमंडलों द्वारा स्वीकार किया जाना चाहिए।।

articles.title: Meet Plavu Jayan, the man creating jackfruit villages across Keralam
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Jackfruit evangelist KR Jayan, winner of the 29th PV Thampy Memorial Award, reflects on his journey in conservation and his deep bond with the tree

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: KR Jayan’s days literally begin and end under the jackfruit tree. Having devoted 27 years of his life to its conservation, Jayan says it is only fitting that he spends all his waking hours under his beloved tree. “If you observe closely enough, you will see that the tree never sleeps — its leaves remain crisp like pappads through day and night. A seed-grown tree can live for 150 to 200 years. It is indeed very special,” he says. Jayan, better known as Plavu Jayan (plavu is jackfruit in Malayalam), from Irinjalakkuda, Thrissur, is the recipient of the 29th PV Thampy Memorial Award 2026 for his tireless contribution to the conservation of jackfruit through the traditional method of planting. It is a bond that goes back to his childhood, says the 61-year-old Jayan. “The jackfruit was an integral part of agrarian economy in our villages. The jackfruit was everywhere, it was an inevitable part of our lives. My mother’s family had a farming background, so my interest in jackfruit grew,” says Jayan. The moniker Plavu Jayan came much ahead of his tree planting days. “I was 13 years old when, during Service Week in school, we were asked to get saplings. While everyone brought flowering plants, I brought a jackfruit sapling. From that day, everyone started calling me Plavu Jayan. The name stuck and I am proud of it,” he says. Plavu Jayan at Avittathoor in Irinjalakkuda | Photo Credit: THULASI KAKKAT In the mid nineties, as Jayan’s interest in the tree grew, he began looking for different varieties, understanding the methods of pollination and experimenting with planting. He didn’t have land of his own, so he started planting along the roadside in Irinjalakkuda. Today, they are fully grown, massive jackfruit trees, which offer fruit and shade. The people of his village did not fully understand what Jayan was doing and often scoffed at him, but Jayan continued his effort — picking the right seeds, preparing them, sprouting and planting them. “My environmental activism has always been through my daily work,” he adds. He has created nine plavu gramam (jackfruit villages) in Keralam — in Ernakulam, Kottayam, Palakkad and Thrissur districts. The first jackfruit village Jayan created was at Mundaya near Shoranur Railway Station. “It was a nine-and-a-half acre barren land, which is today a lush jackfruit forest on the banks of the Bharathapuzha.” Environmental enthusiasts began seeking him out. An NRI, who had a three-and-a-half acre plot in Irinjalakkuda, approached him to create a jackfruit forest. Jayan planted 500 jackfruit saplings in 18 varieties and today, it is a thriving forest.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Plavu Jayan at the PV Thampy Memorial Award distribution ceremony in Kochi | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement

He didn’t have land of his own, so he started planting along the roadside in Irinjalakkuda. Today, they are fully grown, massive jackfruit trees, which offer fruit and shade. The people of his village did not fully understand what Jayan was doing and often scoffed at him, but Jayan continued his effort — picking the right seeds, preparing them, sprouting and planting them. “My environmental activism has always been through my daily work,” he adds. He has created nine plavu gramam (jackfruit villages) in Keralam — in Ernakulam, Kottayam, Palakkad and Thrissur districts. The first jackfruit village Jayan created was at Mundaya near Shoranur Railway Station. “It was a nine-and-a-half acre barren land, which is today a lush jackfruit forest on the banks of the Bharathapuzha.” Environmental enthusiasts began seeking him out. An NRI, who had a three-and-a-half acre plot in Irinjalakkuda, approached him to create a jackfruit forest. Jayan planted 500 jackfruit saplings in 18 varieties and today, it is a thriving forest.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Meet Plavu Jayan, the man creating jackfruit villages across Keralam

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 12:18:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Jackfruit evangelist KR Jayan, winner of the 29th PV Thampy Memorial Award, reflects on his journey in conservation and his deep bond with the tree

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: KR Jayan’s days literally begin and end under the jackfruit tree. Having devoted 27 years of his life to its conservation, Jayan says it is only fitting that he spends all his waking hours under his beloved tree. “If you observe closely enough, you will see that the tree never sleeps — its leaves remain crisp like pappads through day and night. A seed-grown tree can live for 150 to 200 years. It is indeed very special,” he says. Jayan, better known as Plavu Jayan (plavu is jackfruit in Malayalam), from Irinjalakkuda, Thrissur, is the recipient of the 29th PV Thampy Memorial Award 2026 for his tireless contribution to the conservation of jackfruit through the traditional method of planting. It is a bond that goes back to his childhood, says the 61-year-old Jayan. “The jackfruit was an integral part of agrarian economy in our villages. The jackfruit was everywhere, it was an inevitable part of our lives. My mother’s family had a farming background, so my interest in jackfruit grew,” says Jayan. The moniker Plavu Jayan came much ahead of his tree planting days. “I was 13 years old when, during Service Week in school, we were asked to get saplings. While everyone brought flowering plants, I brought a jackfruit sapling. From that day, everyone started calling me Plavu Jayan. The name stuck and I am proud of it,” he says. Plavu Jayan at Avittathoor in Irinjalakkuda | Photo Credit: THULASI KAKKAT In the mid nineties, as Jayan’s interest in the tree grew, he began looking for different varieties, understanding the methods of pollination and experimenting with planting. He didn’t have land of his own, so he started planting along the roadside in Irinjalakkuda. Today, they are fully grown, massive jackfruit trees, which offer fruit and shade. The people of his village did not fully understand what Jayan was doing and often scoffed at him, but Jayan continued his effort — picking the right seeds, preparing them, sprouting and planting them. “My environmental activism has always been through my daily work,” he adds. He has created nine plavu gramam (jackfruit villages) in Keralam — in Ernakulam, Kottayam, Palakkad and Thrissur districts. The first jackfruit village Jayan created was at Mundaya near Shoranur Railway Station. “It was a nine-and-a-half acre barren land, which is today a lush jackfruit forest on the banks of the Bharathapuzha.” Environmental enthusiasts began seeking him out. An NRI, who had a three-and-a-half acre plot in Irinjalakkuda, approached him to create a jackfruit forest. Jayan planted 500 jackfruit saplings in 18 varieties and today, it is a thriving forest.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Plavu Jayan at the PV Thampy Memorial Award distribution ceremony in Kochi | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Contribution (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Contribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Distribution (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Distribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Meet Plavu Jayan, the man creating jackfruit villages across Keralam", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Jackfruit evangelist KR Jayan, winner of the 29th PV Thampy Memorial Award, reflects on his journey in conservation and his deep bond with the tree.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Meet Plavu Jayan, the man creating jackfruit vil' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Meet Plavu Jayan, the man creating jackfruit ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Meet Plavu Jayan, the man creating jackfruit ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Jackfruit evangelist KR Jayan, winner of the 29th PV Thampy Memorial Award, reflects on his journey in conservation and his deep bond with the tree." B. Plavu Jayan at the PV Thampy Memorial Award distribution ceremony in Kochi | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Plavu Jayan at the PV Thampy Memorial Award distribution ceremony in Kochi | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement." articles.title: Pint of View Kochi lectures explore Keralam’s unique socio-cultural identity
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The lecture series brings the State’s historical, cultural and environmental narratives into an informal bar setting

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A lecture is in progress on the warmly lit terrace bar of Niko Hotels in Kadavathra. The audience, sipping on drinks, listens in rapt attention to accomplished herpetologist Sandeep Das as he talks about a very special amphibian — the Indian purple frog. Research Associate, Department of Biotechnology, Government of India and Member of Kerala State Wildlife Board, Sandeep has been studying the ancient frog species for 15 years and shares his insights on its peculiar life and behaviour. At the end of the session, a number of questions emerge from the audience and a lively discussion ensues. This is the Kochi chapter of Pint of View, a lecture movement that has taken over bars and pubs across the country, converting them into temporary learning hubs. A Pint of View lecture | Photo Credit: Akkshay Lawrence A movement that was launched in Bengaluru in 2025 by Harsh Snehanshu, Shruti Sah, and Meghna Chaudhary, it caught on in India, with a presence in over 16 cities now. The Kochi chapter, launched in September, has hosted six lectures to enthusiastic crowds. Kochi curators Krupa Anilkumar and Kurien Philip are delighted with the response from the people and say the idea is to make knowledge accessible to the public in a fun way. “Many of us stop learning after we leave college. Though the desire to learn is present, we may still be carrying the trauma of competitive classroom environments. And that is where these lectures change the game. Hosted at bars and pubs, people are easily relaxed and therefore more receptive to new information and ways of thinking,” she says. A Pint of View session in progress | Photo Credit: Akkshay Lawrence The lectures so far reflect the historical, socio-cultural and environmental uniqueness of Keralam. The inaugural lecture was on 50 years of Kochi, by Johanne Binny Kuruvilla, founder of the Kochi Heritage Project, where he spoke about the unique modernity of Kochi — how it emerged and existed as a revolutionary space. “Intended for adults, the audience that we find here are largely working professionals, who are driven by the curiosity to learn. We have many regular attendees,” says Kurien. The speakers are often senior academicians. But that does not exclude those with expertise in a subject. Musician, composer and co-founder of the performance collective, Oorali, Saji Oorali’s session explored the connection between spice trade and the music of Keralam. From the maappila paattu, which has traces of Arab influence, owing to the traders who visited the Malabar coast to European church music that introduced new instruments and traditions to South India and Malayalam hip-hop finding audiences around the world, the session was a glimpse into the history of Keralam’s music. The session also included live musical demonstrations. Urban and ecological anthropologist, Mathew A Varghese, who is an assistant professor, School of International Relations and Politics, Mahatma Gandhi University, in his lecture, ‘The City Unfolding’ reflected on how Keralam’s urban spaces are designed, how they have transformed and how people experience and make sense of the places their inhabit.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For now, the lectures are hosted at Niko, Rocks and Brews and Vasco’s Corner.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पेय पदार्थ पीते हुए दर्शक निपुण सरीसृपविज्ञानी संदीप दास को ध्यान से सुनते हैं क्योंकि वह एक बहुत ही विशेष उभयचर - भारतीय बैंगनी मेंढक के बारे में बात करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Research Associate, Department of Biotechnology, Government of India and Member of Kerala State Wildlife Board, Sandeep has been studying the ancient frog species for 15 years and shares his insights on its peculiar life and behaviour.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — भारत सरकार के जैव प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग के अनुसंधान सहयोगी और केरल राज्य वन्यजीव बोर्ड के सदस्य, संदीप 15 वर्षों से प्राचीन मेंढक प्रजातियों का अध्ययन कर रहे हैं और इसके अजीब जीवन और व्यवहार पर अपनी अंतर्दृष्टि साझा करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: At the end of the session, a number of questions emerge from the audience and a lively discussion ensues.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सत्र के अंत में, दर्शकों के बीच से कई प्रश्न सामने आते हैं और एक जीवंत चर्चा शुरू होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: This is the Kochi chapter of Pint of View, a lecture movement that has taken over bars and pubs across the country, converting them into temporary learning hubs.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह पिंट ऑफ व्यू का कोच्चि चैप्टर है, एक व्याख्यान आंदोलन जिसने देश भर में बार और पबों पर कब्जा कर लिया है, उन्हें अस्थायी शिक्षण केंद्रों में बदल दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A Pint of View lecture | Photo Credit: Akkshay Lawrence
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक पिंट ऑफ व्यू व्याख्यान | फोटो साभार: अक्षय लॉरेंस।

hinglishTracks.en: A movement that was launched in Bengaluru in 2025 by Harsh Snehanshu, Shruti Sah, and Meghna Chaudhary, it caught on in India, with a presence in over 16 cities now.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हर्ष स्नेहांशु, श्रुति साह और मेघना चौधरी द्वारा 2025 में बेंगलुरु में शुरू किया गया एक आंदोलन, अब 16 से अधिक शहरों में उपस्थिति के साथ, भारत में फैल गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Kochi chapter, launched in September, has hosted six lectures to enthusiastic crowds.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सितंबर में लॉन्च किए गए कोच्चि चैप्टर ने उत्साही भीड़ के लिए छह व्याख्यानों की मेजबानी की है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enthusiastic' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Enthusiastic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Kochi curators Krupa Anilkumar and Kurien Philip are delighted with the response from the people and say the idea is to make knowledge accessible to the public in a fun way.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — कोच्चि के क्यूरेटर कृपा अनिलकुमार और कुरियन फिलिप लोगों की प्रतिक्रिया से खुश हैं और कहते हैं कि इसका उद्देश्य ज्ञान को मनोरंजक तरीके से जनता तक पहुंचाना है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Many of us stop learning after we leave college.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — “हममें से कई लोग कॉलेज छोड़ने के बाद सीखना बंद कर देते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Though the desire to learn is present, we may still be carrying the trauma of competitive classroom environments.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हालाँकि सीखने की इच्छा मौजूद है, फिर भी हम प्रतिस्पर्धी कक्षा के माहौल का आघात सह रहे होंगे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: And that is where these lectures change the game.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — और यहीं ये व्याख्यान खेल बदल देते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Hosted at bars and pubs, people are easily relaxed and therefore more receptive to new information and ways of thinking,” she says.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बार और पब में मेजबानी करने पर लोग आसानी से तनावमुक्त हो जाते हैं और इसलिए नई जानकारी और सोचने के तरीकों के प्रति अधिक ग्रहणशील हो जाते हैं,'' वह कहती हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: A Pint of View session in progress | Photo Credit: Akkshay Lawrence
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक पिंट ऑफ व्यू सत्र प्रगति पर है | फोटो साभार: अक्षय लॉरेंस।

hinglishTracks.en: The lectures so far reflect the historical, socio-cultural and environmental uniqueness of Keralam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अब तक के व्याख्यान केरलम की ऐतिहासिक, सामाजिक-सांस्कृतिक और पर्यावरणीय विशिष्टता को दर्शाते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: The inaugural lecture was on 50 years of Kochi, by Johanne Binny Kuruvilla, founder of the Kochi Heritage Project, where he spoke about the unique modernity of Kochi — how it emerged and existed as a revolutionary space.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उद्घाटन व्याख्यान कोच्चि हेरिटेज प्रोजेक्ट के संस्थापक जोहान बिन्नी कुरुविला द्वारा कोच्चि के 50 वर्षों पर था, जहां उन्होंने कोच्चि की अनूठी आधुनिकता के बारे में बात की - यह कैसे उभरा और एक क्रांतिकारी स्थान के रूप में अस्तित्व में रहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Intended for adults, the audience that we find here are largely working professionals, who are driven by the curiosity to learn.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “वयस्कों के लिए लक्षित, यहां हमें जो दर्शक मिलते हैं वे बड़े पैमाने पर कामकाजी पेशेवर हैं, जो सीखने की जिज्ञासा से प्रेरित होते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: We have many regular attendees,” says Kurien.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — कुरियन कहते हैं, ''हमारे पास कई नियमित उपस्थित लोग हैं।''।

hinglishTracks.en: The speakers are often senior academicians.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वक्ता अक्सर वरिष्ठ शिक्षाविद होते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: But that does not exclude those with expertise in a subject.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — लेकिन यह किसी विषय में विशेषज्ञता रखने वालों को बाहर नहीं करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Musician, composer and co-founder of the performance collective, Oorali, Saji Oorali’s session explored the connection between spice trade and the music of Keralam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — संगीतकार, संगीतकार और प्रदर्शन समूह, ओराली के सह-संस्थापक, साजी ओराली के सत्र ने मसाला व्यापार और केरलम के संगीत के बीच संबंध का पता लगाया।।

hinglishTracks.en: From the maappila paattu, which has traces of Arab influence, owing to the traders who visited the Malabar coast to European church music that introduced new instruments and traditions to South India and Malayalam hip-hop finding audiences around the world, the session was a glimpse into the history of Keralam’s music.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — मप्पिला पट्टू से, जिसमें अरब प्रभाव के निशान हैं, मालाबार तट पर आने वाले व्यापारियों के कारण, यूरोपीय चर्च संगीत जिसने दक्षिण भारत में नए वाद्ययंत्रों और परंपराओं को पेश किया और मलयालम हिप-हॉप ने दुनिया भर के दर्शकों को आकर्षित किया, यह सत्र केरलम के संगीत के इतिहास की एक झलक था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The session also included live musical demonstrations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सत्र में लाइव संगीत प्रदर्शन भी शामिल था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Urban and ecological anthropologist, Mathew A Varghese, who is an assistant professor, School of International Relations and Politics, Mahatma Gandhi University, in his lecture, ‘The City Unfolding’ reflected on how Keralam’s urban spaces are designed, how they have transformed and how people experience and make sense of the places their inhabit.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — शहरी और पारिस्थितिक मानवविज्ञानी, मैथ्यू ए वर्गीस, जो महात्मा गांधी विश्वविद्यालय के स्कूल ऑफ इंटरनेशनल रिलेशंस एंड पॉलिटिक्स में सहायक प्रोफेसर हैं, ने अपने व्याख्यान 'द सिटी अनफोल्डिंग' में इस बात पर विचार किया कि केरल के शहरी स्थान कैसे डिजाइन किए गए हैं, वे कैसे बदल गए हैं और लोग कैसे अनुभव करते हैं और उन स्थानों को समझते हैं जहां वे रहते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: For now, the lectures are hosted at Niko, Rocks and Brews and Vasco’s Corner.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अभी के लिए, व्याख्यान निको, रॉक्स एंड ब्रूज़ और वास्को कॉर्नर में आयोजित किए जाते हैं।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Pint of View Kochi lectures explore Keralam’s unique socio-cultural identity

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 12:17:08 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The lecture series brings the State’s historical, cultural and environmental narratives into an informal bar setting

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A lecture is in progress on the warmly lit terrace bar of Niko Hotels in Kadavathra. The audience, sipping on drinks, listens in rapt attention to accomplished herpetologist Sandeep Das as he talks about a very special amphibian — the Indian purple frog. Research Associate, Department of Biotechnology, Government of India and Member of Kerala State Wildlife Board, Sandeep has been studying the ancient frog species for 15 years and shares his insights on its peculiar life and behaviour. At the end of the session, a number of questions emerge from the audience and a lively discussion ensues. This is the Kochi chapter of Pint of View, a lecture movement that has taken over bars and pubs across the country, converting them into temporary learning hubs. A Pint of View lecture | Photo Credit: Akkshay Lawrence A movement that was launched in Bengaluru in 2025 by Harsh Snehanshu, Shruti Sah, and Meghna Chaudhary, it caught on in India, with a presence in over 16 cities now. The Kochi chapter, launched in September, has hosted six lectures to enthusiastic crowds. Kochi curators Krupa Anilkumar and Kurien Philip are delighted with the response from the people and say the idea is to make knowledge accessible to the public in a fun way. “Many of us stop learning after we leave college. Though the desire to learn is present, we may still be carrying the trauma of competitive classroom environments. And that is where these lectures change the game. Hosted at bars and pubs, people are easily relaxed and therefore more receptive to new information and ways of thinking,” she says. A Pint of View session in progress | Photo Credit: Akkshay Lawrence The lectures so far reflect the historical, socio-cultural and environmental uniqueness of Keralam. The inaugural lecture was on 50 years of Kochi, by Johanne Binny Kuruvilla, founder of the Kochi Heritage Project, where he spoke about the unique modernity of Kochi — how it emerged and existed as a revolutionary space. “Intended for adults, the audience that we find here are largely working professionals, who are driven by the curiosity to learn. We have many regular attendees,” says Kurien. The speakers are often senior academicians. But that does not exclude those with expertise in a subject. Musician, composer and co-founder of the performance collective, Oorali, Saji Oorali’s session explored the connection between spice trade and the music of Keralam. From the maappila paattu, which has traces of Arab influence, owing to the traders who visited the Malabar coast to European church music that introduced new instruments and traditions to South India and Malayalam hip-hop finding audiences around the world, the session was a glimpse into the history of Keralam’s music. The session also included live musical demonstrations. Urban and ecological anthropologist, Mathew A Varghese, who is an assistant professor, School of International Relations and Politics, Mahatma Gandhi University, in his lecture, ‘The City Unfolding’ reflected on how Keralam’s urban spaces are designed, how they have transformed and how people experience and make sense of the places their inhabit.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For now, the lectures are hosted at Niko, Rocks and Brews and Vasco’s Corner.

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Pint of View Kochi lectures explore Keralam’s unique socio-cultural identity", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The lecture series brings the State’s historical, cultural and environmental narratives into an informal bar setting.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Pint of View Kochi lectures explore Keralam’s un' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Pint of View Kochi lectures explore Keralam’s' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Pint of View Kochi lectures explore Keralam’s' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The lecture series brings the State’s historical, cultural and environmental narratives into an informal bar setting
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A lecture is in progress on the warmly lit terrace bar of Niko Hotels in Kadavathra. The audience, sipping on drinks, listens in rapt attention to accomplished herpetologist Sandeep Das as he talks about a very special amphibian — the Indian purple frog. Research Associate, Department of Biotechnology, Government of India and Member of Kerala State Wildlife Board, Sandeep has been studying the ancient frog species for 15 years and shares his insights on its peculiar life and behaviour. At the end of the session, a number of questions emerge from the audience and a lively discussion ensues. This is the Kochi chapter of Pint of View, a lecture movement that has taken over bars and pubs across the country, converting them into temporary learning hubs. A Pint of View lecture | Photo Credit: Akkshay Lawrence A movement that was launched in Bengaluru in 2025 by Harsh Snehanshu, Shruti Sah, and Meghna Chaudhary, it caught on in India, with a presence in over 16 cities now. The Kochi chapter, launched in September, has hosted six lectures to enthusiastic crowds. Kochi curators Krupa Anilkumar and Kurien Philip are delighted with the response from the people and say the idea is to make knowledge accessible to the public in a fun way. “Many of us stop learning after we leave college. Though the desire to learn is present, we may still be carrying the trauma of competitive classroom environments. And that is where these lectures change the game. Hosted at bars and pubs, people are easily relaxed and therefore more receptive to new information and ways of thinking,” she says. A Pint of View session in progress | Photo Credit: Akkshay Lawrence The lectures so far reflect the historical, socio-cultural and environmental uniqueness of Keralam. The inaugural lecture was on 50 years of Kochi, by Johanne Binny Kuruvilla, founder of the Kochi Heritage Project, where he spoke about the unique modernity of Kochi — how it emerged and existed as a revolutionary space. “Intended for adults, the audience that we find here are largely working professionals, who are driven by the curiosity to learn. We have many regular attendees,” says Kurien. The speakers are often senior academicians. But that does not exclude those with expertise in a subject. Musician, composer and co-founder of the performance collective, Oorali, Saji Oorali’s session explored the connection between spice trade and the music of Keralam. From the maappila paattu, which has traces of Arab influence, owing to the traders who visited the Malabar coast to European church music that introduced new instruments and traditions to South India and Malayalam hip-hop finding audiences around the world, the session was a glimpse into the history of Keralam’s music. The session also included live musical demonstrations. Urban and ecological anthropologist, Mathew A Varghese, who is an assistant professor, School of International Relations and Politics, Mahatma Gandhi University, in his lecture, ‘The City Unfolding’ reflected on how Keralam’s urban spaces are designed, how they have transformed and how people experience and make sense of the places their inhabit.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For now, the lectures are hosted at Niko, Rocks and Brews and Vasco’s Corner.

articles.title: The Age of Crime: Why there is a call to lower juvenile age threshold following rise in crimes by minors in Keralam

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Back-to-back incidents of heinous crimes involving juveniles have given rise to a public demand for amending the Juvenile Justice Act to lower the age threshold. Child rights campaigners, however, caution against lowering the age limit and say such changes shall be considered only after wide consultations. K.S. Sudhi takes a look at opposing view points.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Sitting peevishly at the visitors’ lounge of the Child Protection Officer of a central Keralam district, Smitha*, a 13-year-old accused in a murder case, threw a casual look at the visitors. The reclusive girl, who sported a fringe haircut, looked quite nervous. She never made any attempt to hide her discomfiture as a group of lawyers tried to strike up a conversation with her. The lawyers were on a mission to provide her with the required psychological and legal support and discuss a rehabilitation plan for her. “No one helped me to see my mother even when I was sick,” she muttered under her breath.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The fact that she was an accused in a murder case hung heavily in the minds of the volunteers, though none showed it. Instead, they persuaded her to open up. She became amiable after much cajoling and facilitating a telephone call with her mother, for the first time since the alleged commission of the crime.
