articles.title: Malayalam director Martin Prakkat, two others booked over displaying man’s phone number in film
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Kochi City Cyber Crime Police have registered a case against the producers of the Malayalam film Officer on Duty , including director-producer Martin Prakkat, on a man’s complaint that his active mobile number was used in the movie without his permission or masking.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The movie, directed by Jithu Ashraf and starring Kunchacko Boban, was released in theatres in February 2025 and has since been streaming on an OTT platform in multiple languages. The court had earlier sought a report from the Central Station House Officer under Section 175(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita. Reportedly, the mobile number has been in use since 2014 and remains linked to the complainant’s key documents, including Aadhaar Card, PAN Card and bank accounts. He allegedly began receiving unsolicited calls, including from abroad, causing considerable distress and disruption to his daily life.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The case has been registered under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita Section 351(2) (criminal intimidation), Section 356 (defamation), and Section 3(5) (common intention); Informational Technology Act Section 66C (identity theft), and Section 66D (cheating by personation using a computer resource); Section 67 (publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form), and Section 67A (publishing or transmitting sexually explicit material in electronic form); and the Kerala Police Act Section 120(o) (causing nuisance through communication).

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Malayalam director Martin Prakkat, two others booked over displaying man’s phone number in film

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 12:22:29 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Kochi City Cyber Crime Police have registered a case against the producers of the Malayalam film Officer on Duty , including director-producer Martin Prakkat, on a man’s complaint that his active mobile number was used in the movie without his permission or masking.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The movie, directed by Jithu Ashraf and starring Kunchacko Boban, was released in theatres in February 2025 and has since been streaming on an OTT platform in multiple languages. The court had earlier sought a report from the Central Station House Officer under Section 175(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita. Reportedly, the mobile number has been in use since 2014 and remains linked to the complainant’s key documents, including Aadhaar Card, PAN Card and bank accounts. He allegedly began receiving unsolicited calls, including from abroad, causing considerable distress and disruption to his daily life.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The case has been registered under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita Section 351(2) (criminal intimidation), Section 356 (defamation), and Section 3(5) (common intention); Informational Technology Act Section 66C (identity theft), and Section 66D (cheating by personation using a computer resource); Section 67 (publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form), and Section 67A (publishing or transmitting sexually explicit material in electronic form); and the Kerala Police Act Section 120(o) (causing nuisance through communication).

articles.title: Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Supreme Court hears contempt pleas over failure to light Karthigai Deepam lamp
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The hearing follows the Tamil Nadu government's apology to the Supreme Court over the non-compliance with its November 20 order permitting the lamp to be lit at 'Deepathoon' on November 24 as a one-time measure.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “Sthanikars had expressed their deep sorrow for the temple administration, including their names. This Board cannot be allowed to continue. They must forthwith be not allowed to continue,” Mr. Krishnakumar said, representing the contempt petitioners. “Shift the sacred flame from the Deepa Mandapam to the Deepathoon -- before they answer this contempt, they must purge themselves by doing this first.” He also demanded the temple by transferred to the Archeological Survey of India. This would not happened without State Executive’s intervention. Mr. Krishnakumar, for the petitioners, further alleged that the collector report was a “tell-tale of passing the buck”. “Executive Officer counter-signs. Sthanikar have come out with a statement that the resolution brought about by the Board of Trustees to light the lamp on the Deepa Mandapam was not backed by them,” he said. Guru Krishnakumar, for the contempt petitioner, said that there is nothing on record to show when the Board of Trustees passed the resolution. “How did the State, which had oversight over the Board of Trustees, later claim that they could not do anything because the Board did not authorise the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at the Deepathoon as per the November 20 order of the Supreme Court,” he asked. He said that the State had already decided to not comply with the Supreme Court’s order. “The Board was chosen as the vehicle and refuge to hide behind. It was the weakest link in the administrative and political chain to justify an action,” he said. Mr. Krishnakumar, for the contempt petitioner, said that the Collector’s report is “like a confession”. It says that the Board of Trustees of the temple wanted the lighting on the Deepa Mandapam.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Krishnakumar said that the Collector wants the court to believe that the trustees have “come from nowhere and passed the resolution”. He alleged that the trustees were political appointees.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Supreme Court hears contempt pleas over failure to light Karthigai Deepam lamp

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 12:22:01 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The hearing follows the Tamil Nadu government's apology to the Supreme Court over the non-compliance with its November 20 order permitting the lamp to be lit at 'Deepathoon' on November 24 as a one-time measure.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “Sthanikars had expressed their deep sorrow for the temple administration, including their names. This Board cannot be allowed to continue. They must forthwith be not allowed to continue,” Mr. Krishnakumar said, representing the contempt petitioners. “Shift the sacred flame from the Deepa Mandapam to the Deepathoon -- before they answer this contempt, they must purge themselves by doing this first.” He also demanded the temple by transferred to the Archeological Survey of India. This would not happened without State Executive’s intervention. Mr. Krishnakumar, for the petitioners, further alleged that the collector report was a “tell-tale of passing the buck”. “Executive Officer counter-signs. Sthanikar have come out with a statement that the resolution brought about by the Board of Trustees to light the lamp on the Deepa Mandapam was not backed by them,” he said. Guru Krishnakumar, for the contempt petitioner, said that there is nothing on record to show when the Board of Trustees passed the resolution. “How did the State, which had oversight over the Board of Trustees, later claim that they could not do anything because the Board did not authorise the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at the Deepathoon as per the November 20 order of the Supreme Court,” he asked. He said that the State had already decided to not comply with the Supreme Court’s order. “The Board was chosen as the vehicle and refuge to hide behind. It was the weakest link in the administrative and political chain to justify an action,” he said. Mr. Krishnakumar, for the contempt petitioner, said that the Collector’s report is “like a confession”. It says that the Board of Trustees of the temple wanted the lighting on the Deepa Mandapam.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Krishnakumar said that the Collector wants the court to believe that the trustees have “come from nowhere and passed the resolution”. He alleged that the trustees were political appointees.

articles.title: Supreme Court grants bail to former AAP MLA Naresh Balyan in MCOCA case
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh passed the order while hearing Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging a Delhi High Court order denying him bail in the case

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Friday (November 27, 2026) granted bail to former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) MLA Naresh Balyan in a case registered under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA). A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh passed the order while hearing Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging a Delhi High Court order denying him bail in the case. The bench asked Mr. Balyan to cooperate in the trial. On August 3, the Delhi High Court denied bail to Mr. Balyan, accused of being a facilitator in a crime syndicate allegedly run by gangster Kapil Sangwan. It said that a conversation between Mr. Balyan and the gangster demonstrated an “active criminal nexus” between them. During the hearing on Friday (November 27), senior advocate Vikas Singh, appearing for Mr. Balyan, told the Supreme Court that his client was a former AAP MLA and a victim of “political vendetta”. Mr. Singh said Mr. Balyan had been in jail for almost two years. Opposing the submissions, the counsel appearing for the Delhi Police argued that Mr. Balyan was part of an organised crime syndicate and that there were over 15 cases against the syndicate. The Supreme Court had agreed in August to hear Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging the denial of bail. 1. Core Context & Background: A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh passed the order while hearing Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging a Delhi High Court order denying him bail in the case

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Friday (November 27, 2026) granted bail to former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) MLA Naresh Balyan in a case registered under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA). A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh passed the order while hearing Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging a Delhi High Court order denying him bail in the case. The bench asked Mr. Balyan to cooperate in the trial. On August 3, the Delhi High Court denied bail to Mr. Balyan, accused of being a facilitator in a crime syndicate allegedly run by gangster Kapil Sangwan. It said that a conversation between Mr. Balyan and the gangster demonstrated an “active criminal nexus” between them. During the hearing on Friday (November 27), senior advocate Vikas Singh, appearing for Mr. Balyan, told the Supreme Court that his client was a former AAP MLA and a victim of “political vendetta”. Mr. Singh said Mr. Balyan had been in jail for almost two years. Opposing the submissions, the counsel appearing for the Delhi Police argued that Mr. Balyan was part of an organised crime syndicate and that there were over 15 cases against the syndicate. The Supreme Court had agreed in August to hear Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging the denial of bail. Mr. Balyan was arrested in the MCOCA case on December 4, 2024, the same day a trial court granted him bail in an extortion case. Before the High Court, Mr. Balyan had contended that there was “no shred of evidence” against him and that the case was “completely frivolous”.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh passed the order while hearing Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging a Delhi High Court order denying him bail in the case
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Friday (November 27, 2026) granted bail to former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) MLA Naresh Balyan in a case registered under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA). A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh passed the order while hearing Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging a Delhi High Court order denying him bail in the case. The bench asked Mr. Balyan to cooperate in the trial. On August 3, the Delhi High Court denied bail to Mr. Balyan, accused of being a facilitator in a crime syndicate allegedly run by gangster Kapil Sangwan. It said that a conversation between Mr. Balyan and the gangster demonstrated an “active criminal nexus” between them. During the hearing on Friday (November 27), senior advocate Vikas Singh, appearing for Mr. Balyan, told the Supreme Court that his client was a former AAP MLA and a victim of “political vendetta”. Mr. Singh said Mr. Balyan had been in jail for almost two years. Opposing the submissions, the counsel appearing for the Delhi Police argued that Mr. Balyan was part of an organised crime syndicate and that there were over 15 cases against the syndicate. The Supreme Court had agreed in August to hear Mr. Balyan’s plea challenging the denial of bail. Mr. Balyan was arrested in the MCOCA case on December 4, 2024, the same day a trial court granted him bail in an extortion case. Before the High Court, Mr. Balyan had contended that there was “no shred of evidence” against him and that the case was “completely frivolous”.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The High Court had rejected his contention that he was himself a victim, had lodged complaints against Sangwan and was being projected as the gangster’s close associate due to political vendetta.

articles.title: President Droupadi Murmu arrives in Keralam on two-day visit
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Murmu set to attend various events and visit religious places

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: President Droupadi Murmu arrived in Kochi on Friday for a two-day visit to Keralam during which she will attend various events and visit religious places, officials said. Ernakulam District Administration officials said that the President arrived at Cochin International Airport at Nedumbassery at 10.41 am on a special aircraft and left for the Sree Sankaracharya Temple at Kalady at 10.45 am. Governor Om Prakash Mathur, Chief Minister V D Satheesan, Higher Education Minister Roji M John, MPs Benny Behanan and Haris Beeran, and MLA Anwar Sadath received the President at the airport. Chief Secretary Biswanath Sinha, DGP and State Police Chief Ravada A Chandrasekhar, Southern Naval Command Rear Admiral Prakash Gopalan, Ernakulam District Collector G Priyanka and Ernakulam Rural District Police Chief K S Sudarshan were also present to receive her, they said. Later in the day, she will attend the valedictory ceremony of the golden jubilee celebrations of Vaidyaratnam Ayurveda College in Thrissur, officials said. She will then proceed to the Sree Krishna Temple at Guruvayur for darshan. The President will also attend the Passing Out Parade (POP) for Autumn Term 2026 at the Indian Naval Academy in Ezhimala, Kannur, on Saturday, officials said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: High-security arrangements and traffic diversions have been announced in Ernakulam, Thrissur, and Kannur districts in view of the President’s visit.

articles.title: Telangana’s traditional martial art ‘Karra samu’ to take centre stage at Khelo India; CM Revanth keen to give it a push
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: For the first time, the traditional stick-fighting art to be showcased at national event; demonstrations at Hakimpet Sports School

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A bamboo stick in hand, concentration in the eyes and lightning-fast movements, the skilful manoeuvres of ‘Karra samu’, Telangana’s traditional martial art, are set to captivate audiences at the national level with the discipline making its debut at the Khelo India Youth Games. Just as Bathukamma and Bonalu have brought national attention to Telangana’s cultural identity, ‘Karra samu’ (stick fighting) practitioners now have an opportunity to showcase the State’s sporting heritage. The traditional stick-fighting art, that once drew crowds at village festivals and religious processions across Telangana, is now preparing to find an audience on a national sporting platform. Khelo India would be held in Telangana from December 11 to 22 | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT The art will be showcased for the first time at the Khelo India Youth Games to be held in the State from December 11 to 22. Demonstrations will be organised at the State Sports School in Hakimpet to introduce the indigenous art to young athletes, coaches and sports administrators from across the country. The inclusion of ‘Karra samu’ is significant at a time when several traditional rural sports and physical disciplines are gradually fading with the growing popularity of modern competitive sports. The national platform is expected to bring renewed attention to this art, which has been passed down through generations. ‘Karra samu’ has deep roots in Telangana’s rural culture. Traditionally learnt as a means of self-defence, it gradually became an integral part of village festivities and processions. Mastering the art requires more than physical strength. Agility, concentration, presence of mind and coordination between the movements of the hands and legs are essential. Practitioners need to maintain balance while executing swift and intricate movements with the stick, with regular practice being key to developing proficiency. Unlike several modern sports, ‘Karra samu’ does not require expensive equipment or elaborate infrastructure. Training can be imparted even in villages, making it accessible to children. Early exposure to the discipline can help improve physical fitness, confidence and discipline among both boys and girls.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: ‘Karrasamu’ demonstrations broadly feature two forms: Alankaram and Yuddham. In Alankaram, an individual performer displays a range of movements and manoeuvres with the stick, showcasing speed, dexterity and coordination. Yuddham involves two practitioners engaging in a contest, demonstrating their skills within prescribed rules.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Telangana’s traditional martial art ‘Karra samu’ to take centre stage at Khelo India; CM Revanth keen to give it a push

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 12:19:43 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: For the first time, the traditional stick-fighting art to be showcased at national event; demonstrations at Hakimpet Sports School

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A bamboo stick in hand, concentration in the eyes and lightning-fast movements, the skilful manoeuvres of ‘Karra samu’, Telangana’s traditional martial art, are set to captivate audiences at the national level with the discipline making its debut at the Khelo India Youth Games. Just as Bathukamma and Bonalu have brought national attention to Telangana’s cultural identity, ‘Karra samu’ (stick fighting) practitioners now have an opportunity to showcase the State’s sporting heritage. The traditional stick-fighting art, that once drew crowds at village festivals and religious processions across Telangana, is now preparing to find an audience on a national sporting platform. Khelo India would be held in Telangana from December 11 to 22 | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT The art will be showcased for the first time at the Khelo India Youth Games to be held in the State from December 11 to 22. Demonstrations will be organised at the State Sports School in Hakimpet to introduce the indigenous art to young athletes, coaches and sports administrators from across the country. The inclusion of ‘Karra samu’ is significant at a time when several traditional rural sports and physical disciplines are gradually fading with the growing popularity of modern competitive sports. The national platform is expected to bring renewed attention to this art, which has been passed down through generations. ‘Karra samu’ has deep roots in Telangana’s rural culture. Traditionally learnt as a means of self-defence, it gradually became an integral part of village festivities and processions. Mastering the art requires more than physical strength. Agility, concentration, presence of mind and coordination between the movements of the hands and legs are essential. Practitioners need to maintain balance while executing swift and intricate movements with the stick, with regular practice being key to developing proficiency. Unlike several modern sports, ‘Karra samu’ does not require expensive equipment or elaborate infrastructure. Training can be imparted even in villages, making it accessible to children. Early exposure to the discipline can help improve physical fitness, confidence and discipline among both boys and girls.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: ‘Karrasamu’ demonstrations broadly feature two forms: Alankaram and Yuddham. In Alankaram, an individual performer displays a range of movements and manoeuvres with the stick, showcasing speed, dexterity and coordination. Yuddham involves two practitioners engaging in a contest, demonstrating their skills within prescribed rules.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Inclusive (Adjective)
समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing  |  ✖ Ant: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow
Indigenous (Adjective)
स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया।
✓ Syn: Domestic, Home-grown, Native  |  ✖ Ant: Imported, Foreign, Exotic
Concentration (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Concentration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Coordination (Noun)
समन्वय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Coordination' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Telangana’s traditional martial art ‘Karra samu’ to take centre stage at Khelo India; CM Revanth keen to give it a push", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. For the first time, the traditional stick-fighting art to be showcased at national event; demonstrations at Hakimpet Sports School.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Telangana’s traditional martial art ‘Karra samu’' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Telangana’s traditional martial art ‘Karra sa' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Telangana’s traditional martial art ‘Karra sa' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "For the first time, the traditional stick-fighting art to be showcased at national event; demonstrations at Hakimpet Sports School." (Hinglish Arth: पहली बार, पारंपरिक छड़ी-युद्ध कला को राष्ट्रीय कार्यक्रम में प्रदर्शित किया जाएगा; हकीमपेट स्पोर्ट्स स्कूल में प्रदर्शन)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Telangana’s traditional martial art ‘Karra samu’ to take centre stage at Khelo India; CM Revanth keen to give it a push"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Yuddham involves two practitioners engaging in a contest, demonstrating their skills within prescribed rules.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Yuddham involves two practitioners engaging in a contest, demonstrating their skills within prescribed rules." (Hinglish Arth: युद्धम में दो अभ्यासकर्ता एक प्रतियोगिता में शामिल होते हैं, जो निर्धारित नियमों के भीतर अपने कौशल का प्रदर्शन करते हैं।)

articles.title: AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end of month, internal email shows
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Salary payments during the five-month period would be made on the 30th of each month ‌or the last day of February, the notice said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: AirAsia has ‌told employees it will delay salary payments to the end of each month ​from November through March, according to an internal email seen by Reuters , as ⁠the airline takes measures to conserve cash and its Philippine unit cuts jobs. The email, sent to Malaysia-based staff late last week by Chief People Officer Muhammad Khurram Zia, cited the need for a “temporary operational adjustment” at ‌Southeast Asia’s largest budget airline, which like its peers faces higher jet fuel costs. Salary payments during the five-month period would be made on the 30th of each month ‌or the last day of February, the email said. It cited a “challenging environment” and asked employees ‌for “patience ⁠and flexibility.” The email’s contents were confirmed by two people familiar with the matter. ⁠One of the people said AirAsia had previously paid salaries earlier in the second half of each month. The Iran war has sent jet fuel prices soaring, putting airlines worldwide under their ​worst financial strain since the COVID-19 pandemic. U.S. low-cost ‌carrier Spirit Airlines collapsed in May, Latvia’s airBaltic sought bankruptcy protection in September and Norway’s Norse Atlantic suspended flights on Thursday as it looks for urgent short-term financing. Shares in AirAsia, which employs about 26,000 people predominantly in Asia, have declined more than 70% ‌this year as elevated fuel prices and foreign exchange losses squeezed its operations. AirAsia Philippines said ​on Thursday (November 26, 2026) it would reduce its workforce following sustained pressure on its operating costs, without specifying how many staff would be affected.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The airline said on Friday (November 27) it ⁠remained fully operational and committed to serving the Philippine market. The planned workforce adjustment will not affect passenger flights, bookings, or other services, AirAsia Philippines General Manager and President Anna Victoria Lu said in a ‌statement.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end of month, internal email shows

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 01:53:29 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Salary payments during the five-month period would be made on the 30th of each month ‌or the last day of February, the notice said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: AirAsia has ‌told employees it will delay salary payments to the end of each month ​from November through March, according to an internal email seen by Reuters , as ⁠the airline takes measures to conserve cash and its Philippine unit cuts jobs. The email, sent to Malaysia-based staff late last week by Chief People Officer Muhammad Khurram Zia, cited the need for a “temporary operational adjustment” at ‌Southeast Asia’s largest budget airline, which like its peers faces higher jet fuel costs. Salary payments during the five-month period would be made on the 30th of each month ‌or the last day of February, the email said. It cited a “challenging environment” and asked employees ‌for “patience ⁠and flexibility.” The email’s contents were confirmed by two people familiar with the matter. ⁠One of the people said AirAsia had previously paid salaries earlier in the second half of each month. The Iran war has sent jet fuel prices soaring, putting airlines worldwide under their ​worst financial strain since the COVID-19 pandemic. U.S. low-cost ‌carrier Spirit Airlines collapsed in May, Latvia’s airBaltic sought bankruptcy protection in September and Norway’s Norse Atlantic suspended flights on Thursday as it looks for urgent short-term financing. Shares in AirAsia, which employs about 26,000 people predominantly in Asia, have declined more than 70% ‌this year as elevated fuel prices and foreign exchange losses squeezed its operations. AirAsia Philippines said ​on Thursday (November 26, 2026) it would reduce its workforce following sustained pressure on its operating costs, without specifying how many staff would be affected.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The airline said on Friday (November 27) it ⁠remained fully operational and committed to serving the Philippine market. The planned workforce adjustment will not affect passenger flights, bookings, or other services, AirAsia Philippines General Manager and President Anna Victoria Lu said in a ‌statement.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Operational (Adjective)
आपरेशनल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Operational' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Flexibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Flexibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end of month, internal email shows", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Salary payments during the five-month period would be made on the 30th of each month ‌or the last day of February, the notice said.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end of m' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end o' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end o' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Salary payments during the five-month period would be made on the 30th of each month ‌or the last day of February, the notice said." (Hinglish Arth: नोटिस में कहा गया है कि पांच महीने की अवधि के दौरान वेतन भुगतान प्रत्येक महीने की 30 तारीख या फरवरी के आखिरी दिन किया जाएगा।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end of month, internal email shows"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The planned workforce adjustment will not affect passenger flights, bookings, or other services, AirAsia Philippines General Manager and President...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The planned workforce adjustment will not affect passenger flights, bookings, or other services, AirAsia Philippines General Manager and President..." (Hinglish Arth: एयरएशिया फिलीपींस के महाप्रबंधक और अध्यक्ष अन्ना विक्टोरिया लू ने एक बयान में कहा, नियोजित कार्यबल समायोजन यात्री उड़ानों, बुकिंग या अन्य सेवाओं को प्रभावित नहीं करेगा।)

articles.title: WhatsApp to let users buy travel eSIMs in app; Jio, Verizon among partners
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: WhatsApp Head Kunal Shah described the effort as the company's early explorations around eSIMs in a post on X

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: WhatsApp will soon let users buy and install a data eSIM for international travel without leaving the app, so they can keep using it on their existing phone number abroad, the Meta-owned company said in a blog post on Thursday (November 26, 2026), naming Jio among its partners. The company said it was working with eSIM providers and telecom partners, including Jio, Smart Axiata, Smart Communications and Verizon, and would begin rolling out the feature in select countries soon. It did not name the countries or give pricing details. "...We’re announcing a new way to buy and install a data e-SIM when travelling internationally in just a few taps without leaving the app. It’ll be as effortless as sending a message. That way, when you land, you can keep using WhatsApp on your same phone number as you normally would without having to find the closest airport kiosk to buy a local SIM card, hunt for a cafe with Wi-Fi or rack up roaming charges,” WhatsApp said. WhatsApp Head Kunal Shah described the effort as the company's early explorations around eSIMs in a post on X.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "What if WhatsApp could work anywhere you go in the world without any struggle," Shah wrote, adding, "Inviting partners everywhere to join us in this important mission." WhatsApp has more than 3 billion users worldwide, according to Meta.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 WhatsApp to let users buy travel eSIMs in app; Jio, Verizon among partners

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 02:16:15 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: WhatsApp Head Kunal Shah described the effort as the company's early explorations around eSIMs in a post on X

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: WhatsApp will soon let users buy and install a data eSIM for international travel without leaving the app, so they can keep using it on their existing phone number abroad, the Meta-owned company said in a blog post on Thursday (November 26, 2026), naming Jio among its partners. The company said it was working with eSIM providers and telecom partners, including Jio, Smart Axiata, Smart Communications and Verizon, and would begin rolling out the feature in select countries soon. It did not name the countries or give pricing details. "...We’re announcing a new way to buy and install a data e-SIM when travelling internationally in just a few taps without leaving the app. It’ll be as effortless as sending a message. That way, when you land, you can keep using WhatsApp on your same phone number as you normally would without having to find the closest airport kiosk to buy a local SIM card, hunt for a cafe with Wi-Fi or rack up roaming charges,” WhatsApp said. WhatsApp Head Kunal Shah described the effort as the company's early explorations around eSIMs in a post on X.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "What if WhatsApp could work anywhere you go in the world without any struggle," Shah wrote, adding, "Inviting partners everywhere to join us in this important mission." WhatsApp has more than 3 billion users worldwide, according to Meta.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Reducing sugar exposure during the first 1,000 days of life is associated with a substantially lower cancer risk decades later, and a slower biological ageing process, the results of a U.K.-based study have shown. articles.title: Motorola pivots to premiumisation, aims for third spot in India
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: According to the latest IDC report, Motorola has already climbed to become the fifth-largest smartphone brand in India, capturing an 8.8% market share during the third quarter of this year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Motorola is aiming for the third spot in India’s competitive smartphone market as the Lenovo-owned brand aggressively pivots to premiumisation and seamless connected experiences. The company’s executives outlined their strategic vision during a media visit at their contract partner Dixon (Padget Electronics) facility in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. India’s smartphone market is currently being dominated by Samsung followed by two Chinese players (Vivo and Oppo). If Motorola continues its aggressive push and mix of products, it would be able to replace Oppo to become the third largest smartphone brand in the country. According to the latest IDC report, Motorola has already climbed to become the fifth-largest smartphone brand in India, capturing an 8.8% market share during the third quarter of this year. This growth is heavily anchored in its premium portfolio, which includes the Edge, Razr, and Signature series. Motorola reports that its revenue has surged 20-fold since FY19-20, with nearly 60% now driven entirely by these high-end devices. Fueling this momentum is robust local manufacturing. Motorola’s upcoming premium flagship smartphone, the Motorola Signature 27, will be made at the Noida facility. Alongside Dixon, the brand maintains a strategic manufacturing partnership with Neolync in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh. Together, these facilities not only fulfill domestic demand but also handle exports to Latin and North American markets. Motorola’s manufacturing expansion has generated a substantial economic footprint, providing direct employment to nearly 8,000 people and creating over 56,000 indirect opportunities spanning manufacturing, sales, and servicing. To support its expanding market presence, Motorola has established an extensive service network across the country. The brand currently covers 716 PIN codes across 620 cities in India, supported by over 846 touch points and 685 dedicated repair centres. Looking ahead, Motorola is doubling down on artificial intelligence, prioritising practical, day-to-day use cases. The company has partnered with Google to integrate Gemini Intelligence into its upcoming Signature 27.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Motorola continues to evolve its proprietary AI assistant, Qira, which is designed to enhance cross-device connectivity and deliver advanced productivity tools for users.

Alongside Dixon, the brand maintains a strategic manufacturing partnership with Neolync in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh. Together, these facilities not only fulfill domestic demand but also handle exports to Latin and North American markets. The brand currently covers 716 PIN codes across 620 cities in India, supported by over 846 touch points and 685 dedicated repair centres. Looking ahead, Motorola is doubling down on artificial intelligence, prioritising practical, day-to-day use cases. The company has partnered with Google to integrate Gemini Intelligence into its upcoming Signature 27.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Motorola continues to evolve its proprietary AI assistant, Qira, which is designed to enhance cross-device connectivity and deliver advanced productivity tools for users.

📰 Motorola pivots to premiumisation, aims for third spot in India

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 11:57:52 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: According to the latest IDC report, Motorola has already climbed to become the fifth-largest smartphone brand in India, capturing an 8.8% market share during the third quarter of this year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Motorola is aiming for the third spot in India’s competitive smartphone market as the Lenovo-owned brand aggressively pivots to premiumisation and seamless connected experiences. The company’s executives outlined their strategic vision during a media visit at their contract partner Dixon (Padget Electronics) facility in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. India’s smartphone market is currently being dominated by Samsung followed by two Chinese players (Vivo and Oppo). If Motorola continues its aggressive push and mix of products, it would be able to replace Oppo to become the third largest smartphone brand in the country. According to the latest IDC report, Motorola has already climbed to become the fifth-largest smartphone brand in India, capturing an 8.8% market share during the third quarter of this year. This growth is heavily anchored in its premium portfolio, which includes the Edge, Razr, and Signature series. Motorola reports that its revenue has surged 20-fold since FY19-20, with nearly 60% now driven entirely by these high-end devices. Fueling this momentum is robust local manufacturing. Motorola’s upcoming premium flagship smartphone, the Motorola Signature 27, will be made at the Noida facility. Alongside Dixon, the brand maintains a strategic manufacturing partnership with Neolync in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh. Together, these facilities not only fulfill domestic demand but also handle exports to Latin and North American markets. Motorola’s manufacturing expansion has generated a substantial economic footprint, providing direct employment to nearly 8,000 people and creating over 56,000 indirect opportunities spanning manufacturing, sales, and servicing. To support its expanding market presence, Motorola has established an extensive service network across the country. The brand currently covers 716 PIN codes across 620 cities in India, supported by over 846 touch points and 685 dedicated repair centres. Looking ahead, Motorola is doubling down on artificial intelligence, prioritising practical, day-to-day use cases. The company has partnered with Google to integrate Gemini Intelligence into its upcoming Signature 27.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Motorola continues to evolve its proprietary AI assistant, Qira, which is designed to enhance cross-device connectivity and deliver advanced productivity tools for users.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Motorola pivots to premiumisation, aims for third spot in India", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. According to the latest IDC report, Motorola has already climbed to become the fifth-largest smartphone brand in India, capturing an 8.8% market...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Motorola pivots to premiumisation, aims for thir' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Motorola pivots to premiumisation, aims for t' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Motorola pivots to premiumisation, aims for t' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "According to the latest IDC report, Motorola has already climbed to become the fifth-largest smartphone brand in India, capturing an 8.8% market..." (Hinglish Arth: नवीनतम आईडीसी रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, मोटोरोला पहले ही भारत में पांचवां सबसे बड़ा स्मार्टफोन ब्रांड बन गया है, जिसने इस साल की तीसरी तिमाही के दौरान 8.8% बाजार हिस्सेदारी हासिल की है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Motorola pivots to premiumisation, aims for third spot in India"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Motorola continues to evolve its proprietary AI assistant, Qira, which is designed to enhance cross-device connectivity and deliver advanced...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Motorola continues to evolve its proprietary AI assistant, Qira, which is designed to enhance cross-device connectivity and deliver advanced..." (Hinglish Arth: मोटोरोला अपने मालिकाना एआई सहायक, क्यूरा को विकसित करना जारी रखता है, जिसे क्रॉस-डिवाइस कनेक्टिविटी बढ़ाने और उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए उन्नत उत्पादकता उपकरण प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।)

articles.title: Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Supreme Court to pass interim orders over failure to light Karthigai Deepam lamp
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Contempt petitioners allege at the apex court that the State had already decided to not comply with the order

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan read the November 20 order to argue that the Collector was only directed to make all the arrangements, facilities for the lighting of the lamp on November 24. He said that the Collector could not have done the religious act of lighting the lamp. The Supreme Court said non-compliance of an Supreme Court order would lead to constitutional chaos. “Hearing must be first held on whether there was prima facie contempt at all. Then the question of purging arises. We have done all that is necessary to comply,” Senior advocate Sankaranarayanan, for the Collector, said. The Supreme Court asked who is the Director General of Police (DGP) of Tamil Nadu. Senior advocate Sankaranarayanan asked the Supreme Court to let them place the report. Reliance may be placed on it, he said. The Supreme Court said that it will pass some interim orders today. Senior advocate P. Valliappan said that Ministers had made statements even before November 24 that lamp would not be lit at the stone pillar, establishing the intention clearly. “We have time till December 15, let them light the lamp on any day,” he said. Senior advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan, for the Collector, countered that the final report would answer all their contentions. The Solicitor General intervened, asking how can they be heard.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Solicitor General said that the Supreme Court can even ask for the light to be re-lit. “Till they purge, they have no right to be heard,” he said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Supreme Court to pass interim orders over failure to light Karthigai Deepam lamp

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 01:29:16 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Contempt petitioners allege at the apex court that the State had already decided to not comply with the order

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan read the November 20 order to argue that the Collector was only directed to make all the arrangements, facilities for the lighting of the lamp on November 24. He said that the Collector could not have done the religious act of lighting the lamp. The Supreme Court said non-compliance of an Supreme Court order would lead to constitutional chaos. “Hearing must be first held on whether there was prima facie contempt at all. Then the question of purging arises. We have done all that is necessary to comply,” Senior advocate Sankaranarayanan, for the Collector, said. The Supreme Court asked who is the Director General of Police (DGP) of Tamil Nadu. Senior advocate Sankaranarayanan asked the Supreme Court to let them place the report. Reliance may be placed on it, he said. The Supreme Court said that it will pass some interim orders today. Senior advocate P. Valliappan said that Ministers had made statements even before November 24 that lamp would not be lit at the stone pillar, establishing the intention clearly. “We have time till December 15, let them light the lamp on any day,” he said. Senior advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan, for the Collector, countered that the final report would answer all their contentions. The Solicitor General intervened, asking how can they be heard.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Solicitor General said that the Supreme Court can even ask for the light to be re-lit. “Till they purge, they have no right to be heard,” he said.

Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।

Compliance (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Compliance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Religious (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Religious' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Intention (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intention' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Supreme Court to pass interim orders over failure to light Karthigai Deepam lamp", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Contempt petitioners allege at the apex court that the State had already decided to not comply with the order.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Suprem' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Sup' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Sup' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Contempt petitioners allege at the apex court that the State had already decided to not comply with the order." (Hinglish Arth: अवमानना ​​याचिकाकर्ताओं ने शीर्ष अदालत में आरोप लगाया कि राज्य ने पहले ही आदेश का पालन नहीं करने का फैसला कर लिया था)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Supreme Court to pass interim orders over failure to light Karthigai Deepam lamp"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “Till they purge, they have no right to be heard,” he said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“Till they purge, they have no right to be heard,” he said." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने कहा, ''जब तक वे शुद्ध नहीं हो जाते, उन्हें सुनने का कोई अधिकार नहीं है।'')

articles.title: KTR condemns Congress supporters’ attack on BRS leaders at hotel in Hyderabad’s RTC X roads
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: BRS working president sought to know how arranging a dinner to commemorate Rahul Gandhi’s promise was a crime

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Working president of the Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) K.T. Rama Rao has condemned the attack on party leaders Manne Krishank, M. Jaisimha, Jagan Patimeedi, Dinesh Chowdary, Vishnuvardhan Reddy and Harish Reddy, allegedly by the Congress “goons”. In a statement, he said resorting to physical attacks on questioning about jobs was the height of tyranny by the Congress Government and stifling voices of questioning. It was irony that the attack and youth leaders of BRS had taken place on the constitutional day itself, rekindling the days of emergency during Indira Gandhi’s rule in the country. It was heinous to attack BRS leaders led by Mr. Krishank who were holding a protest programme in a hotel at RTC crossroads, which was visited by AICC leader Rahul Gandhi in 2023, had a meeting with youth and promised them 2 lakh jobs a year in Telangana. Mr. Rama Rao sought to know how arranging a dinner to commemorate Rahul Gandhi’s promise was a crime. Further, he asked the Congress leaders whether the opposition parties had no freedom to question the government failures and whether physical attacks were its response for asking about promised jobs. It was unfortunate that a sitting Rajya Sabha member of the Congress led the attack along with his supporters.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Rama Rao demanded that the government own the responsibility for the attack and take action against all those who were responsible for the attack.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 KTR condemns Congress supporters’ attack on BRS leaders at hotel in Hyderabad’s RTC X roads

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 01:28:21 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: BRS working president sought to know how arranging a dinner to commemorate Rahul Gandhi’s promise was a crime

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Working president of the Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) K.T. Rama Rao has condemned the attack on party leaders Manne Krishank, M. Jaisimha, Jagan Patimeedi, Dinesh Chowdary, Vishnuvardhan Reddy and Harish Reddy, allegedly by the Congress “goons”. In a statement, he said resorting to physical attacks on questioning about jobs was the height of tyranny by the Congress Government and stifling voices of questioning. It was irony that the attack and youth leaders of BRS had taken place on the constitutional day itself, rekindling the days of emergency during Indira Gandhi’s rule in the country. It was heinous to attack BRS leaders led by Mr. Krishank who were holding a protest programme in a hotel at RTC crossroads, which was visited by AICC leader Rahul Gandhi in 2023, had a meeting with youth and promised them 2 lakh jobs a year in Telangana. Mr. Rama Rao sought to know how arranging a dinner to commemorate Rahul Gandhi’s promise was a crime. Further, he asked the Congress leaders whether the opposition parties had no freedom to question the government failures and whether physical attacks were its response for asking about promised jobs. It was unfortunate that a sitting Rajya Sabha member of the Congress led the attack along with his supporters.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Rama Rao demanded that the government own the responsibility for the attack and take action against all those who were responsible for the attack.

articles.title: Telangana Waqf Board set to convene meeting after two years; discussion on properties likely
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: With the Telangana government giving the green signal, the Telangana State Waqf Board (TGWB) is set to convene a formal meeting after a gap of about two years. The State government’s plans to acquire waqf properties likely to dominate the deliberations.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The last TGWB meeting was held in 2024. Since then, members have expressed concern over the reasons for the delay in convening a meeting. According to sources, the State government had put board meetings on hold, while the introduction of the new waqf laws had also led to confusion over the next course of action. Sources in the TGWB said the proposed acquisition of waqf land, particularly around 1,248 acres spread across several survey numbers and endowed to Dargah Hazrat Makhdoom Biyabani in Aloor, Ranga Reddy district, is likely to figure on the agenda. The land is proposed to be acquired in favour of the Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation. “The land acquisition will most likely be listed as an important item on the agenda of the board meeting. Whether to approve it or not is solely the decision of the board members. The date of the board meeting is to finalised, but it will happen soon,” a senior TGWB official told The Hindu . The official added that a fresh memo issued by the State government had given the go-ahead for convening the meeting, superseding an previous memo. The board currently has two elected members, Syed Akbar Nizamuddin Hussaini Saberi and Syed Abul Fatah Bandagi Badesha Quadri, ex-officio member Ayesha Khanum, a civil servant, Syed Nisar Hussain Hyder Aga, Malik Moatasim Khan, parliamentarian Asaduddin Owaisi, and TGWB Chairman Syed Azmatullah Huseini. According to sources, some members had raised concerns over the prolonged delay in convening meetings. Comparisons were also drawn with Karnataka, another Congress-ruled State, where the Waqf Board had been holding meetings.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “There are several issues that need to be discussed. Property acquisition is one of them. Following this meeting, which is expected to be convened soon, there are plans to hold meetings more frequently. The issue of the Department of Archaeology [now known as the Department of Heritage Telangana] seeking custody of mosques and other Muslim places of worship in Hyderabad will be taken up for discussion at subsequent meetings,” a source said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 Telangana Waqf Board set to convene meeting after two years; discussion on properties likely

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 01:28:21 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: With the Telangana government giving the green signal, the Telangana State Waqf Board (TGWB) is set to convene a formal meeting after a gap of about two years. The State government’s plans to acquire waqf properties likely to dominate the deliberations.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The last TGWB meeting was held in 2024. Since then, members have expressed concern over the reasons for the delay in convening a meeting. According to sources, the State government had put board meetings on hold, while the introduction of the new waqf laws had also led to confusion over the next course of action. Sources in the TGWB said the proposed acquisition of waqf land, particularly around 1,248 acres spread across several survey numbers and endowed to Dargah Hazrat Makhdoom Biyabani in Aloor, Ranga Reddy district, is likely to figure on the agenda. The land is proposed to be acquired in favour of the Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation. “The land acquisition will most likely be listed as an important item on the agenda of the board meeting. Whether to approve it or not is solely the decision of the board members. The date of the board meeting is to finalised, but it will happen soon,” a senior TGWB official told The Hindu . The official added that a fresh memo issued by the State government had given the go-ahead for convening the meeting, superseding an previous memo. The board currently has two elected members, Syed Akbar Nizamuddin Hussaini Saberi and Syed Abul Fatah Bandagi Badesha Quadri, ex-officio member Ayesha Khanum, a civil servant, Syed Nisar Hussain Hyder Aga, Malik Moatasim Khan, parliamentarian Asaduddin Owaisi, and TGWB Chairman Syed Azmatullah Huseini. According to sources, some members had raised concerns over the prolonged delay in convening meetings. Comparisons were also drawn with Karnataka, another Congress-ruled State, where the Waqf Board had been holding meetings.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “There are several issues that need to be discussed. Property acquisition is one of them. Following this meeting, which is expected to be convened soon, there are plans to hold meetings more frequently. The issue of the Department of Archaeology [now known as the Department of Heritage Telangana] seeking custody of mosques and other Muslim places of worship in Hyderabad will be taken up for discussion at subsequent meetings,” a source said.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Corporation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Industrial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Telangana Waqf Board set to convene meeting after two years; discussion on properties likely", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. With the Telangana government giving the green signal, the Telangana State Waqf Board (TGWB) is set to convene a formal meeting after a gap of about...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Telangana Waqf Board set to convene meeting afte' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Telangana Waqf Board set to convene meeting a' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Telangana Waqf Board set to convene meeting a' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "With the Telangana government giving the green signal, the Telangana State Waqf Board (TGWB) is set to convene a formal meeting after a gap of about..." (Hinglish Arth: तेलंगाना सरकार की हरी झंडी मिलने के साथ, तेलंगाना राज्य वक्फ बोर्ड (टीजीडब्ल्यूबी) लगभग दो साल के अंतराल के बाद एक औपचारिक बैठक बुलाने के लिए तैयार है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Telangana Waqf Board set to convene meeting after two years; discussion on properties likely"?

B. The issue of the Department of Archaeology [now known as the Department of Heritage Telangana] seeking custody of mosques and other Muslim places of...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The issue of the Department of Archaeology [now known as the Department of Heritage Telangana] seeking custody of mosques and other Muslim places of..." (Hinglish Arth: पुरातत्व विभाग [जिसे अब तेलंगाना विरासत विभाग के नाम से जाना जाता है] द्वारा हैदराबाद में मस्जिदों और अन्य मुस्लिम पूजा स्थलों को अपने कब्जे में लेने की मांग का मुद्दा अगली बैठक में चर्चा के लिए उठाया जाएगा।)

articles.title: ‘SAD-BJP re-alliance is to rescue Punjab from collapse,’ says the State’s BJP chief
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Kewal Singh Dhillon said the BJP-SAD alliance has been forged not for the pursuit of power, but with a singular commitment to ‘Punjab First’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Punjab Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) president Kewal Singh Dhillon on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said the reunion with the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) is the need of the hour to rescue the State from administrative, economic and social collapse. He said the alliance has been forged not for the pursuit of power, but with a singular commitment to “Punjab First”. “When a national party that governs twenty-two states and forms the Union Government for a third consecutive term willingly steps into the role of a younger brother in Punjab, it makes it abundantly clear that its foremost priority is saving the state,” he said in a statement. Asserting that the NDA coalition’s key mission is to eradicate the drug menace, he said “An entire generation in Punjab stands on the verge of getting wiped out due to the unchecked drug menace. This narcotic crisis is not only claiming young lives every day, but it is also hollowing out Punjab’s productive workforce, pushing countless families into financial ruin, accelerating youth migration, and robbing the border state of its demographic strength and future leadership.” NDA-SAD reunion: Why the Akali Dal severed ties with BJP 6 years ago After six years apart, BJP and Akali Dal announce alliance for Punjab Assembly election Mr. Dhillon said that to revive agriculture and raise farmers’ living standards, the NDA government after assuming power will provide Minimum Support Price (MSP) on 25 crops and vegetables on the pattern of Haryana, alongside central schemes to upgrade rural roads and village infrastructure.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: bjp / Shiromani Akali Dal / Punjab / Punjab Assembly Elections 2022 / Punjab Assembly Elections 2027

Joseph Vijay on Friday (November 27, 2026) felicitated former Ministers V.V. Swaminathan and H.V. Hande on the occasion of their centenaries at the Secretariat in Chennai. Recalling his political career, he said he had served as a member of the Legislative Assembly and the Legislative Council for 22 years. He also recalled his tenure as a Minister in the cabinet headed by AIADMK founder and former Chief Minister M.G. Ramachandran. Welcoming the fact that several youngsters had been elected to the 17 th Legislative Assembly, Dr. Hande advised them to read and understand all issue thoroughly and present them properly. He also urged them not to indulge in corruption under any circumstances.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Dr. Hande also quoted a couplet from the Thirukkural, ‘ Idippaarai illaadha emaaraa mannan keduppaar ilaanum kedum ,’ underscoring the importance of having an Opposition which would offer constructive criticism to a ruler to effectively discharge their duties.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 CM Vijay honours former Ministers V.V. Swaminathan, H.V. Hande on their centenaries

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 01:26:31 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Dr. Hande said he considered it a matter of pride that he and Mr. Swaminathan had been invited and honoured by the Tamil Nadu government and the Legislative Assembly

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a gesture of respect to two veteran politicians, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay on Friday (November 27, 2026) felicitated former Ministers V.V. Swaminathan and H.V. Hande on the occasion of their centenaries at the Secretariat in Chennai. During the event, Mr. Vijay, along with Speaker J.C.D. Prabhakar, Minister for School Education Rajmohan, and officials felicitated the two former Ministers. Mr. Prabhakar told reporters that the two were honoured on behalf of the Assembly Secretariat on their centenaries. Dr. Hande said he considered it a matter of pride that he and Mr. Swaminathan had been invited and honoured by the Tamil Nadu government and the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly. Recalling his political career, he said he had served as a member of the Legislative Assembly and the Legislative Council for 22 years. articles.title: No change in DMK’s stand on delimitation, says Stalin; party to hold meeting of MPs on November 28
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: He brushed aside speculations about the party’s stand on delimitation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: DMK president M.K. Stalin on Friday (November 27, 2026) made it clear that there is no change in the position of his party and no question of any compromise on the issue of delimitation. “The DMK stands firm on its two demands that if the number of parliamentary constituencies is increased, under no circumstances should Tamil Nadu’s existing 7.18% share of seats in the lower house be reduced, and the existing proportion of parliamentary representation among States, as determined on the basis of the 1971 Census and frozen earlier, must remain frozen for another 25 years,” Mr. Stalin said in a post on X, brushing aside speculations about the party’s stand on delimitation. “The DMK was the first in India to raise its voice against the dangers of delimitation . It was only in Chennai that political leaders from across the country came together for the first time to demand fair delimitation…The DMK stands firm on its two demands and will continue to do so. There is no change in our position, and there is no question of any compromise,” he said. “Neither the speculations being circulated in the media nor the wails of backstabbers can shake our resolve. The shameless and ungrateful lot who abandoned their principles for positions of power must realise this. The DMK will never compromise on Tamil Nadu’s interests. Nor will it depart from its principles,” Mr. Stalin said. Meanwhile, DMK general secretary Duraimurugan announced on Friday that Mr. Stalin will chair a meeting of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha members of the DMK on Saturday (November 28) morning at Anna Arivalayam, the DMK headquarters.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / state politics / Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam / Delimitation

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 No change in DMK’s stand on delimitation, says Stalin; party to hold meeting of MPs on November 28

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 01:24:05 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: He brushed aside speculations about the party’s stand on delimitation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: DMK president M.K. Stalin on Friday (November 27, 2026) made it clear that there is no change in the position of his party and no question of any compromise on the issue of delimitation. “The DMK stands firm on its two demands that if the number of parliamentary constituencies is increased, under no circumstances should Tamil Nadu’s existing 7.18% share of seats in the lower house be reduced, and the existing proportion of parliamentary representation among States, as determined on the basis of the 1971 Census and frozen earlier, must remain frozen for another 25 years,” Mr. Stalin said in a post on X, brushing aside speculations about the party’s stand on delimitation. “The DMK was the first in India to raise its voice against the dangers of delimitation . It was only in Chennai that political leaders from across the country came together for the first time to demand fair delimitation…The DMK stands firm on its two demands and will continue to do so. There is no change in our position, and there is no question of any compromise,” he said. “Neither the speculations being circulated in the media nor the wails of backstabbers can shake our resolve. The shameless and ungrateful lot who abandoned their principles for positions of power must realise this. The DMK will never compromise on Tamil Nadu’s interests. Nor will it depart from its principles,” Mr. Stalin said. Meanwhile, DMK general secretary Duraimurugan announced on Friday that Mr. Stalin will chair a meeting of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha members of the DMK on Saturday (November 28) morning at Anna Arivalayam, the DMK headquarters.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / state politics / Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam / Delimitation

articles.title: 200-year-old Taj Mahal marble slab to be auctioned in U.K.
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The rectangular slab is estimated to fetch between 20,000 and 30,000 pounds (₹24-36 lakh approximately)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An intricate floral-bordered marble slab taken from the Taj Mahal in Agra by an officer of the East India Company is set to be auctioned in the U.K. next month. The rectangular slab, one of two that Colonel Pownoll Phipps collected in 1816 at the end of his tenure as superintendent of the repairs of the buildings in and around Agra, is estimated to fetch between 20,000 and 30,000 pounds (₹24-36 lakh approximately). It is being offered as part of the Islamic and Indian Art sale by Lyon and Turnbull auctioneers on December 9. “The marble slab is accompanied by a vintage black and white photograph of the Taj Mahal and two letters — one printed by the grandson of Colonel Pownoll and one handwritten by the Marquess of Bath,” the auction notes state. The colonel’s son's memoirs quote that his father found them in a ‘souterrain’, or underground area, at the Taj Mahal and that he thought they were intended for the repairs to the iconic Mughal-era monument. Colonel Pownoll Phipps was born in Devon, England, in 1780. Hailing from a line of soldiers since the early 17th century, he joined the East India Company as a cadet in the Bengal Army in 1799. After battling troops in Egypt, Phipps returned to India, where he quickly rose through the ranks, becoming Fort-Adjutant and Barrack-Master at Agra in 1809, where he remained for the next seven years. During the colonial era, he was responsible among other things for the care of the Taj Mahal and other historic buildings. “He took this job most seriously and was at times called upon to prevent damage by Europeans looking for keepsakes. As his son wrote, ‘he was once sent for to the Taj, where, in spite of the remonstrances of the sentry, an English lady was insisting on picking agates out of the marble with a steel fork’,” the auctioneers note.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 1816, the colonel was chosen by the Governor General of India to become Superintendent of Building in the Lower Provinces, which meant leaving Agra for Kolkata.

hinglishTracks.en: Hailing from a line of soldiers since the early 17th century, he joined the East India Company as a cadet in the Bengal Army in 1799.

hinglishTracks.en: “He took this job most seriously and was at times called upon to prevent damage by Europeans looking for keepsakes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — “उन्होंने इस काम को बहुत गंभीरता से लिया और कई बार यूरोपीय लोगों द्वारा स्मृतिचिह्नों की तलाश में उन्हें होने वाले नुकसान को रोकने के लिए कहा जाता था।।

hinglishTracks.en: As his son wrote, ‘he was once sent for to the Taj, where, in spite of the remonstrances of the sentry, an English lady was insisting on picking agates out of the marble with a steel fork’,” the auctioneers note.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जैसा कि उनके बेटे ने लिखा है, 'उन्हें एक बार ताज के लिए भेजा गया था, जहां, संतरी के विरोध के बावजूद, एक अंग्रेज महिला स्टील के कांटे से संगमरमर से सुलेमानी पत्थर निकालने पर जोर दे रही थी','' नीलामीकर्ताओं ने नोट किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 1816, the colonel was chosen by the Governor General of India to become Superintendent of Building in the Lower Provinces, which meant leaving Agra for Kolkata.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 1816 में, कर्नल को भारत के गवर्नर जनरल द्वारा निचले प्रांतों में भवन अधीक्षक बनने के लिए चुना गया था, जिसका अर्थ था आगरा छोड़कर कोलकाता जाना।।
