🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Bad weather postpones Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade for first time ever

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 07:04:38 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The postponement came as New York City is set to get slammed by a storm bringing intense winds and rain to the region

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade will also be a first: Organisers made an unprecedented decision to postpone the event to Saturday (November 28, 2026) because of bad weather. The annual parade, originally scheduled for Thursday (November 26, 2026), has been moved “out of an abundance of caution” and following consultation with city officials about the severe weather, Macy’s said in a statement Wednesday. “Our team is now working through the complex operational logistics required to bring the Parade to life on Saturday, and we will share additional details as they are finalized,” the company said. The postponement came as New York City is set to get slammed by a storm bringing intense winds and rain to the region, which had raised worries about how the parade’s massive balloons would fare while floating through the windswept canyons between Manhattan’s skyscrapers and over throngs of spectators lining the streets below. At a news conference, Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Thursday’s winds will be strong enough to snap tree limbs and down power lines, and he stressed that rescheduling the parade was the right call. “Now, I know that many New Yorkers, myself included, as well as millions around the world, were looking forward to the parade being held tomorrow,” he said. “Generation after generation has watched SpongeBob and Spider-Man soar down our streets and has taken in Garfield floating down Sixth Avenue. And I know that this change of plans will cause inconveniences, yet safety has to come first.” The National Weather Service has issued a high wind warning and a coastal flood warning for Thursday into Friday. The city’s emergency management agency has been warning residents about the possible storm, with officials banning empty tractor-trailers from bridges Thursday morning because of the wind. NBC , which airs the parade, said it will instead broadcast a rerun of the 2025 edition on Thursday (November 26, 2026). It was not immediately clear whether the event’s expansive lineup would also shift to the new date, though representatives for Broadway shows “Chicago” and “Hamilton” said their performers will make the switch to Saturday (November 28, 2026). The parade’s iconic balloons were well on the way to being inflated when the postponement was announced. Macy’s representatives had repeatedly put off interviews on-site, raising eyebrows among the city’s news media ahead of the official postponement.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Will Coss, a Macy’s executive, said organizers are working with bands and other performers and are “optimistic that we’re going to be able to maintain the parade that we set out to produce and to deliver to New York City on Thanksgiving.”

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Inflation (Noun)
महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए।
✓ Syn: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness  |  ✖ Ant: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession
Postponement (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Postponement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Consultation (Noun)
परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Operational (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Operational' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Bad weather postpones Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade for first time ever", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The postponement came as New York City is set to get slammed by a storm bringing intense winds and rain to the region.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Bad weather postpones Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Bad weather postpones Macy’s 100th Thanksgivi' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Bad weather postpones Macy’s 100th Thanksgivi' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The postponement came as New York City is set to get slammed by a storm bringing intense winds and rain to the region." (Hinglish Arth: यह स्थगन तब हुआ जब न्यूयॉर्क शहर एक तूफान की चपेट में आने वाला था, जिससे क्षेत्र में तेज हवाएं और बारिश होने वाली थी)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Bad weather postpones Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade for first time ever"?

B. Will Coss, a Macy’s executive, said organizers are working with bands and other performers and are “optimistic that we’re going to be able to...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Will Coss, a Macy’s executive, said organizers are working with bands and other performers and are “optimistic that we’re going to be able to..." (Hinglish Arth: मैसी के कार्यकारी विल कॉस ने कहा कि आयोजक बैंड और अन्य कलाकारों के साथ काम कर रहे हैं और "आशावादी हैं कि हम उस परेड को बनाए रखने में सक्षम होंगे जिसे हम तैयार करने और न्यूयॉर्क शहर में पहुंचाने के लिए निकले थे।")

articles.title: Country could face a ‘blood revolution’ unless the Constitution is saved: Prakash Ambedkar
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Prakash Ambedkar said it is “unfortunate” that the ideals of the Constitution were under threat as Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and the BJP is doing everything to be in power

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Vanchit Bahujan Aghadi (VBA) chief Prakash Ambedkar on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) warned that the country could face a “blood revolution” unless the Constitution is saved and people are allowed to choose their own representatives. Speaking at the Samvidhan Samman Sabha, held ahead of Constitution Day, Mr. Ambedkar said it is “unfortunate” that the ideals of the Constitution were under threat as Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and the BJP is doing everything to be in power. “They have this mindset of paying Pakistan and get bomb thrown at the country,” said Mr. Ambedkar, alleging that BJP and RSS were returning to communal politics to win elections, with an agenda built on being “anti-Muslim and anti-Pakistan.” Referring to the Pulwama attack, he asked whether any country had stood behind India, and said European nations had backed Iran. He also asked why Nepal’s Prime Minister had visited India and what happened in Sri Lanka meeting, urging people to “understand the game plan.” Mr. Ambedkar said India’s unity rested on a balance between North and South. He cautioned that RSS and BJP want to create the divide by increasing the dominance of North. Hinting on delimitation bill, he said, “A mechanism built over 70 years ensured there was a balance between northern and southern dominance. BJP and RSS are trying to break this arrangement out of greed. The day the South feels its dominance in Delhi is weakening, it won’t stay.” After Independence, he said, the country chose nation over religion. The BJP, he alleged, had instigated a North-South divide to break India into pieces, put religion at the centre once more, and run the country through corporates such as Adani and Ambani. He also criticised Shiv Sena (UBT) Chief Uddhav Thackeray and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for not asking questions on these issues. He also advised Shiv Sena chief Eknath Shinde to be alert as Mr. Thackeray wants to be in power. He called NCP-SP supremo Sharad Pawar’s friend of Dawood Ibrahim, saying “I know everything about these leaders and RSS has documented the history.” Questioning the government on defence, Mr. Ambedkar said India was reported to have taken delivery of 36 Rafale jets, but the count on the ground was 32. He demanded to know how many the country actually has, and, if a jet had been shot down in conflict, where the pilot was: “with them or in the country.”
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further claimed that the Prime Minister’s “56-inch” image had suddenly shrunk and that he had “taken refuge at America’s feet.”

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Vanchit Bahujan Aghadi (VBA) chief Prakash Ambedkar on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) warned that the country could face a “blood revolution” unless the Constitution is saved and people are allowed to choose their own representatives. Speaking at the Samvidhan Samman Sabha, held ahead of Constitution Day, Mr. Ambedkar said it is “unfortunate” that the ideals of the Constitution were under threat as Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and the BJP is doing everything to be in power. “They have this mindset of paying Pakistan and get bomb thrown at the country,” said Mr. Ambedkar, alleging that BJP and RSS were returning to communal politics to win elections, with an agenda built on being “anti-Muslim and anti-Pakistan.” Referring to the Pulwama attack, he asked whether any country had stood behind India, and said European nations had backed Iran. He also asked why Nepal’s Prime Minister had visited India and what happened in Sri Lanka meeting, urging people to “understand the game plan.” Mr. Ambedkar said India’s unity rested on a balance between North and South. He cautioned that RSS and BJP want to create the divide by increasing the dominance of North. Hinting on delimitation bill, he said, “A mechanism built over 70 years ensured there was a balance between northern and southern dominance. BJP and RSS are trying to break this arrangement out of greed. The day the South feels its dominance in Delhi is weakening, it won’t stay.” After Independence, he said, the country chose nation over religion. The BJP, he alleged, had instigated a North-South divide to break India into pieces, put religion at the centre once more, and run the country through corporates such as Adani and Ambani. He also criticised Shiv Sena (UBT) Chief Uddhav Thackeray and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for not asking questions on these issues. He also advised Shiv Sena chief Eknath Shinde to be alert as Mr. Thackeray wants to be in power. He called NCP-SP supremo Sharad Pawar’s friend of Dawood Ibrahim, saying “I know everything about these leaders and RSS has documented the history.” Questioning the government on defence, Mr. Ambedkar said India was reported to have taken delivery of 36 Rafale jets, but the count on the ground was 32. He demanded to know how many the country actually has, and, if a jet had been shot down in conflict, where the pilot was: “with them or in the country.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further claimed that the Prime Minister’s “56-inch” image had suddenly shrunk and that he had “taken refuge at America’s feet.”

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Country could face a ‘blood revolution’ unless the Constitution is saved: Prakash Ambedkar

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 09:24:20 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Prakash Ambedkar said it is “unfortunate” that the ideals of the Constitution were under threat as Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and the BJP is doing everything to be in power

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Vanchit Bahujan Aghadi (VBA) chief Prakash Ambedkar on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) warned that the country could face a “blood revolution” unless the Constitution is saved and people are allowed to choose their own representatives. Speaking at the Samvidhan Samman Sabha, held ahead of Constitution Day, Mr. Ambedkar said it is “unfortunate” that the ideals of the Constitution were under threat as Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and the BJP is doing everything to be in power. “They have this mindset of paying Pakistan and get bomb thrown at the country,” said Mr. Ambedkar, alleging that BJP and RSS were returning to communal politics to win elections, with an agenda built on being “anti-Muslim and anti-Pakistan.” Referring to the Pulwama attack, he asked whether any country had stood behind India, and said European nations had backed Iran. He also asked why Nepal’s Prime Minister had visited India and what happened in Sri Lanka meeting, urging people to “understand the game plan.” Mr. Ambedkar said India’s unity rested on a balance between North and South. He cautioned that RSS and BJP want to create the divide by increasing the dominance of North. Hinting on delimitation bill, he said, “A mechanism built over 70 years ensured there was a balance between northern and southern dominance. BJP and RSS are trying to break this arrangement out of greed. The day the South feels its dominance in Delhi is weakening, it won’t stay.” After Independence, he said, the country chose nation over religion. The BJP, he alleged, had instigated a North-South divide to break India into pieces, put religion at the centre once more, and run the country through corporates such as Adani and Ambani. He also criticised Shiv Sena (UBT) Chief Uddhav Thackeray and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for not asking questions on these issues. He also advised Shiv Sena chief Eknath Shinde to be alert as Mr. Thackeray wants to be in power. He called NCP-SP supremo Sharad Pawar’s friend of Dawood Ibrahim, saying “I know everything about these leaders and RSS has documented the history.” Questioning the government on defence, Mr. Ambedkar said India was reported to have taken delivery of 36 Rafale jets, but the count on the ground was 32. He demanded to know how many the country actually has, and, if a jet had been shot down in conflict, where the pilot was: “with them or in the country.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further claimed that the Prime Minister’s “56-inch” image had suddenly shrunk and that he had “taken refuge at America’s feet.”

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Delimitation (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Delimitation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Independence (Adjective / Verb)
आज़ादी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Independence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Arrangement (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Arrangement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Country could face a ‘blood revolution’ unless the Constitution is saved: Prakash Ambedkar", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Prakash Ambedkar said it is “unfortunate” that the ideals of the Constitution were under threat as Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and the BJP is...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Country could face a ‘blood revolution’ unless t' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Country could face a ‘blood revolution’ unles' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Country could face a ‘blood revolution’ unles' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Prakash Ambedkar said it is “unfortunate” that the ideals of the Constitution were under threat as Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and the BJP is..." (Hinglish Arth: प्रकाश अंबेडकर ने कहा कि यह "दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण" है कि संविधान के आदर्श खतरे में हैं क्योंकि राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ (आरएसएस) और भाजपा सत्ता में रहने के लिए सब कुछ कर रहे हैं।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Country could face a ‘blood revolution’ unless the Constitution is saved: Prakash Ambedkar"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He further claimed that the Prime Minister’s “56-inch” image had suddenly shrunk and that he had “taken refuge at America’s feet.”.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He further claimed that the Prime Minister’s “56-inch” image had suddenly shrunk and that he had “taken refuge at America’s feet.”." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने आगे दावा किया कि प्रधानमंत्री की "56 इंच" की छवि अचानक सिकुड़ गई है और उन्होंने "अमेरिका के चरणों में शरण ले ली है।")

articles.title: Keralam Minister announces ‘Speak up to stand up’ for woman survivors of violence
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Beneficiaries will be provided with safe accommodation, counselling, social and emotional support, free legal aid, opportunities for continuing their education, employment, and skill training

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Keralam Minister for Women and Child Development Bindhu Krishna on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) announced ‘Speak up to stand up,’ a scheme for ensuring comprehensive support and financial empowerment of woman survivors of violence to lead them towards independence. Inaugurating the State-level observance of International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women at Government College for Women, Vazhuthacaud, Thiruvananthapuram, the Minister said the objective of the scheme was to create a Keralam where each girl and woman could walk without fear, study, work, and choose the life she wanted. The initiative was a continuation of Kerala Police’s ‘Speak up’ scheme that aimed at rehabilitation and financial empowerment of woman survivors. Intended to help woman survivors rebuild their lives with confidence, ‘Speak up to stand up’ would be implemented with the support of the Women and Child Development (WCD) department, Kerala Women’s Commission, and Kerala State Women’s Development Corporation (KSWDC) Ltd. The needs, interests, and skills of each survivor of violence will be analysed and individual rehabilitation plans prepared with their consent. They will be provided with safe accommodation, counselling, social and emotional support, free legal aid, opportunities for continuing their education, employment, and skill training. Self-employment schemes of the KSWDC and Kudumbashree network mechanisms would also be tapped into to help women start own ventures and earn an income. The emergency protection for the survivors and further services will be provided through the WCD’s women protection officers, 181 Mitra help line, and Sakhi one-stop centres. The Minister took the occasion to remind the attendees that dowry was not a symbol of status or pride, but an illegal practice. Defamation through social media, misuse of private pictures and information, and cyber threats should also be taken seriously. “The youth should be ready to react to violence and question wrong practices,” Ms. Krishna said. An art wall with the message of ‘Not silence, but reply,’ mime, and flash mob by students kicked off the day’s events. An interaction between the Minister and the students was also held.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Kerala Women’s Commission chairperson P. Satheedevi presided over the programme.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Keralam Minister announces ‘Speak up to stand up’ for woman survivors of violence

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 09:11:54 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Beneficiaries will be provided with safe accommodation, counselling, social and emotional support, free legal aid, opportunities for continuing their education, employment, and skill training

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Keralam Minister for Women and Child Development Bindhu Krishna on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) announced ‘Speak up to stand up,’ a scheme for ensuring comprehensive support and financial empowerment of woman survivors of violence to lead them towards independence. Inaugurating the State-level observance of International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women at Government College for Women, Vazhuthacaud, Thiruvananthapuram, the Minister said the objective of the scheme was to create a Keralam where each girl and woman could walk without fear, study, work, and choose the life she wanted. The initiative was a continuation of Kerala Police’s ‘Speak up’ scheme that aimed at rehabilitation and financial empowerment of woman survivors. Intended to help woman survivors rebuild their lives with confidence, ‘Speak up to stand up’ would be implemented with the support of the Women and Child Development (WCD) department, Kerala Women’s Commission, and Kerala State Women’s Development Corporation (KSWDC) Ltd. The needs, interests, and skills of each survivor of violence will be analysed and individual rehabilitation plans prepared with their consent. They will be provided with safe accommodation, counselling, social and emotional support, free legal aid, opportunities for continuing their education, employment, and skill training. Self-employment schemes of the KSWDC and Kudumbashree network mechanisms would also be tapped into to help women start own ventures and earn an income. The emergency protection for the survivors and further services will be provided through the WCD’s women protection officers, 181 Mitra help line, and Sakhi one-stop centres. The Minister took the occasion to remind the attendees that dowry was not a symbol of status or pride, but an illegal practice. Defamation through social media, misuse of private pictures and information, and cyber threats should also be taken seriously. “The youth should be ready to react to violence and question wrong practices,” Ms. Krishna said. An art wall with the message of ‘Not silence, but reply,’ mime, and flash mob by students kicked off the day’s events. An interaction between the Minister and the students was also held.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Kerala Women’s Commission chairperson P. Satheedevi presided over the programme.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Rehabilitation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Accommodation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Accommodation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Comprehensive (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Comprehensive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Keralam Minister announces ‘Speak up to stand up’ for woman survivors of violence", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Beneficiaries will be provided with safe accommodation, counselling, social and emotional support, free legal aid, opportunities for continuing their...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Keralam Minister announces ‘Speak up to stand up' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Keralam Minister announces ‘Speak up to stand' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Keralam Minister announces ‘Speak up to stand' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Beneficiaries will be provided with safe accommodation, counselling, social and emotional support, free legal aid, opportunities for continuing their..." (Hinglish Arth: लाभार्थियों को सुरक्षित आवास, परामर्श, सामाजिक और भावनात्मक समर्थन, मुफ्त कानूनी सहायता, उनकी शिक्षा, रोजगार और कौशल प्रशिक्षण जारी रखने के अवसर प्रदान किए जाएंगे।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Keralam Minister announces ‘Speak up to stand up’ for woman survivors of violence"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Satheedevi presided over the programme.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Satheedevi presided over the programme." (Hinglish Arth: कार्यक्रम की अध्यक्षता सतीदेवी ने की।)

articles.title: India Pavilion bags Visitors’ Lion at Venice Biennale; PM Modi calls it ‘proud moment for country’

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The pavilion, under the theme ‘Geographies of Distance: Remembering Home’, explored memory and belonging in a rapidly transforming world

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The India Pavilion has won the Visitors’ Lion for Best National Participation at the prestigious Venice Art Biennale, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailing the award as a “proud moment” for India’s art and cultural world. The pavilion, under the theme ‘Geographies of Distance: Remembering Home’, explored memory and belonging in a rapidly transforming world. Earlier in the day, Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat described it on X as a “remarkable recognition” of the country’s growing cultural influence. A view of artist Skarma Sonam Tashi’s installation on display at India’s national pavilion at the 61st Venice Art Biennale, in Venice, Italy. Photo: X/@gssjodhpur via PTI. Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed the award as a “proud moment” for India’s art and cultural world. “Delighted that the India Pavilion at the Venice Art Biennale has won the prestigious Visitors’ Lion for Best National Pavilion. Our artists are bringing fresh perspectives to the world of art, drawing inspiration from India’s rich and diverse cultural heritage. May this feat inspire many more young Indians to pursue art and explore new creative horizons,” he posted on X, while sharing Mr. Shekhawat’s post. The biennale ran from May 9 to November 22, with previews from May 6-8. The India Pavilion returned to the Biennale Arte — one of the components of La Biennale di Venezia — after a gap of seven years. The pavilion was opened at the 61st International Art Exhibition at the Biennale, in Venice, in the presence of Shekhawat and other officials.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “A moment of immense pride! India wins the Best National Pavilion – Visitors’ Lion at the Venice Art Biennale, the Olympics of the art world. The honour, decided through votes by visitors from across the globe, is a remarkable recognition of India’s growing cultural influence,” Mr. Shekhawat said.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The India Pavilion has won the Visitors’ Lion for Best National Participation at the prestigious Venice Art Biennale, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailing the award as a “proud moment” for India’s art and cultural world. The pavilion, under the theme ‘Geographies of Distance: Remembering Home’, explored memory and belonging in a rapidly transforming world. Earlier in the day, Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat described it on X as a “remarkable recognition” of the country’s growing cultural influence. A view of artist Skarma Sonam Tashi’s installation on display at India’s national pavilion at the 61st Venice Art Biennale, in Venice, Italy. Photo: X/@gssjodhpur via PTI. Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed the award as a “proud moment” for India’s art and cultural world. “Delighted that the India Pavilion at the Venice Art Biennale has won the prestigious Visitors’ Lion for Best National Pavilion. Our artists are bringing fresh perspectives to the world of art, drawing inspiration from India’s rich and diverse cultural heritage. May this feat inspire many more young Indians to pursue art and explore new creative horizons,” he posted on X, while sharing Mr. Shekhawat’s post. The biennale ran from May 9 to November 22, with previews from May 6-8. The India Pavilion returned to the Biennale Arte — one of the components of La Biennale di Venezia — after a gap of seven years. The pavilion was opened at the 61st International Art Exhibition at the Biennale, in Venice, in the presence of Shekhawat and other officials.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “A moment of immense pride! India wins the Best National Pavilion – Visitors’ Lion at the Venice Art Biennale, the Olympics of the art world. The honour, decided through votes by visitors from across the globe, is a remarkable recognition of India’s growing cultural influence,” Mr. Shekhawat said.

articles.title: Kallakurichi police serve summons on TVK MLA Arul Vignesh
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: An Inspector attached to the All Women Police station visited the MLA’s house in Kallakurichi and handed the summons to him in person

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Kallakurichi All Women Police on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) served summons on Kallakurichi TVK MLA C. Arul Vignesh in connection with a case registered against him on a complaint lodged by a woman IAS officer. Inspector Bhuvaneshwari attached to the All Women Police station visited the MLA’s house in Kallakurichi and handed the summons to him in person. The police also questioned Mr. Arul Vignesh at the house. The woman IAS officer had submitted a formal complaint to the Kallakurichi district Superintendent of Police on Monday (November 23), accusing the MLA of making inappropriate advances and sending unwarranted messages. FIR registered against Kallakurichi TVK MLA for ‘misbehaving’ with woman IAS officer, Madras High Court told Udhayanidhi Stalin submits petition to Tamil Nadu DGP demanding arrest of Kallakurichi and Thuraiyur TVK MLAs Kallakurichi TVK MLA case: Internal Complaints Committee has been constituted, Madras High Court told The police have booked a case against the MLA under four sections including the POSH Act and Sections 75, 78 and 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita Police sources said that Tiruppur Superintendent of Police Shristi Singh, who has been appointed as the Investigating Officer in the criminal case registered at the Kallakurichi All Women Police station, began preliminary investigation into the incident on Wednesday (November 25). The National Commission for Women had earlier taken suo moto cognisance of the allegations and asked the Tamil Nadu Director General of Police to conduct an impartial inquiry.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, police personnel have been deployed in strength at the Kallakurichi All Women Police station and the MLA’s office in Kallakurichi.

articles.title: SC sets aside Allahabad HC order on CBI, ED enquiries into disproportionate assets complaint against Rahul Gandhi
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Three-judge bench led by CJI India Surya Kant directs the Opposition leader be impleaded as a party, while relegating the case back to the High Court to be heard from the very threshold in open court by a fresh Bench of judges

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) set aside orders passed by the Allahabad High Court directing inquiries by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and the Enforcement Directorate (ED) into a complaint related to disproportionate assets against the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi . Mr. Gandhi had challenged the interim orders as a green signal to conduct a “fishing” expedition against him . The Congress leader had submitted in his appeal to the Supreme Court that the interim orders were passed without making him a party or hearing him first. A three-judge bench led by the Chief Justice of India Surya Kant directed that Mr. Gandhi be impleaded as a party, while relegating the case back to the High Court to be heard from the very threshold in open court by a fresh Bench of judges. Mr. Gandhi, represented by senior advocate Kapil Sibal and advocate Prasanna S., had argued that the orders were passed by the High Court ex-parte . “We are on the basic fundamentals of hearing. We will not make any observations on the merits of the case,” Chief Justice Kant said. ALSO WATCH Rahul Gandhi asset case explained: What the Supreme Court actually said The complainant, Vignesh Shishir, who is the respondent before the Supreme Court in Mr. Gandhi’s appeal, said that an accused does not have an inherent right to be heard during the pre-First Information Report (FIR) stage. However, Justice Joymalya Bagchi pointed out that under the new law, the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), the scope for the accused to be heard has been expanded. Mr. Gandhi had termed the series of directions passed by the Lucknow Bench of the High Court in May and July, directing the CBI and the ED to probe the allegations against him as one of the rarest instances of a constitutional court acting contrary to several first principles or basic, fundamental legal rules all at once.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Opposition leader had termed these orders “outside the settled rules of law or erroneous, which would be a gross understatement”.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Three-judge bench led by CJI India Surya Kant directs the Opposition leader be impleaded as a party, while relegating the case back to the High Court to be heard from the very threshold in open court by a fresh Bench of judges
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) set aside orders passed by the Allahabad High Court directing inquiries by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and the Enforcement Directorate (ED) into a complaint related to disproportionate assets against the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi . Mr. Gandhi had challenged the interim orders as a green signal to conduct a “fishing” expedition against him . The Congress leader had submitted in his appeal to the Supreme Court that the interim orders were passed without making him a party or hearing him first. A three-judge bench led by the Chief Justice of India Surya Kant directed that Mr. Gandhi be impleaded as a party, while relegating the case back to the High Court to be heard from the very threshold in open court by a fresh Bench of judges. Mr. Gandhi, represented by senior advocate Kapil Sibal and advocate Prasanna S., had argued that the orders were passed by the High Court ex-parte . “We are on the basic fundamentals of hearing. We will not make any observations on the merits of the case,” Chief Justice Kant said. ALSO WATCH Rahul Gandhi asset case explained: What the Supreme Court actually said The complainant, Vignesh Shishir, who is the respondent before the Supreme Court in Mr. Gandhi’s appeal, said that an accused does not have an inherent right to be heard during the pre-First Information Report (FIR) stage. However, Justice Joymalya Bagchi pointed out that under the new law, the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), the scope for the accused to be heard has been expanded. Mr. Gandhi had termed the series of directions passed by the Lucknow Bench of the High Court in May and July, directing the CBI and the ED to probe the allegations against him as one of the rarest instances of a constitutional court acting contrary to several first principles or basic, fundamental legal rules all at once.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Opposition leader had termed these orders “outside the settled rules of law or erroneous, which would be a gross understatement”.

articles.title: U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, second-highest in the 14 countries against which action has been taken
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The order by the U.S. Trade Representative also opens the door for a lower 17% tariff if India and the U.S. sign a trade deal

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The U.S. government on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) announced a tariff of 25% on goods imported from India in response to India’s “unreasonable acts, policies, and practices” that “burden or restrict U.S. commerce”. This is the second-highest tariff among the 14 economies against which the latest action has been taken, second only to the 35% tariff levied on Vietnam. However, the order by the office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) also said that, should the U.S. and India reach an Agreement on Reciprocal Trade, the tariff imposed on India could drop to 17%. ALSO WATCH U.S. midterm results could accelerate India trade deal but raise tariff risks Further, while it says that the 25% tariffs would be net of existing tariffs levied on India, meaning they will not add to the 10% already in effect, the order also said that it remained for the USTR to decide whether these new tariffs would be adjusted keeping in mind those other tariffs. The Indian government said it has taken note of the actions by the USTR and that its notice is currently under examination. “India engaged constructively throughout this investigation,” the statement by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry said. “In response to the Notice of Initiation and in subsequent proceedings, the Department of Commerce stated that India does not have structural excess capacity in any sector.” “India and the United States are engaged in negotiations for a Bilateral Trade Agreement,” it added. “It has been India’s position that any trade-related concerns should be addressed within the framework of these negotiations. Government of India remains committed to working closely with the United States towards the early conclusion of the India-U.S. Bilateral Trade Agreement, as announced on 2nd February 2026 and in accordance with the Joint Statement issued on 7th February 2026.” The USTR had in March launched two separate investigations into American trade partners, including India, under Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act. The first investigation related to forced labour resulted in a tariff of 10% levied on India. The new tariffs announced on Wednesday are a result of the second investigation into structural excess capacity. Apart from this, the U.S. also levies a tariff of 50% on imports of aluminium and steel from all countries under Section 232 of its Trade Expansion Act. The new tariffs will not be added to these. Under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, the U.S. government is also empowered to levy a tariff of up to 100% on countries, including India, that import large quantities of Russian oil. This tariff has been temporarily paused by U.S. President Donald Trump.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In its report on India, the USTR concluded that India’s acts, policies, and practices “create, sustain, or contribute to structural excess capacity” that burden or restrict U.S. commerce by harming U.S. producers and exporters through unfair competition and reduced commercial opportunities; harm the U.S. economy due to lost exports, trade deficits, and a diminished manufacturing sector; and create economic security risks for the U.S.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, second-highest in the 14 countries against which action has been taken

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 12:50:09 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The order by the U.S. Trade Representative also opens the door for a lower 17% tariff if India and the U.S. sign a trade deal

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The U.S. government on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) announced a tariff of 25% on goods imported from India in response to India’s “unreasonable acts, policies, and practices” that “burden or restrict U.S. commerce”. This is the second-highest tariff among the 14 economies against which the latest action has been taken, second only to the 35% tariff levied on Vietnam. However, the order by the office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) also said that, should the U.S. and India reach an Agreement on Reciprocal Trade, the tariff imposed on India could drop to 17%. ALSO WATCH U.S. midterm results could accelerate India trade deal but raise tariff risks Further, while it says that the 25% tariffs would be net of existing tariffs levied on India, meaning they will not add to the 10% already in effect, the order also said that it remained for the USTR to decide whether these new tariffs would be adjusted keeping in mind those other tariffs. The Indian government said it has taken note of the actions by the USTR and that its notice is currently under examination. “India engaged constructively throughout this investigation,” the statement by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry said. “In response to the Notice of Initiation and in subsequent proceedings, the Department of Commerce stated that India does not have structural excess capacity in any sector.” “India and the United States are engaged in negotiations for a Bilateral Trade Agreement,” it added. “It has been India’s position that any trade-related concerns should be addressed within the framework of these negotiations. Government of India remains committed to working closely with the United States towards the early conclusion of the India-U.S. Bilateral Trade Agreement, as announced on 2nd February 2026 and in accordance with the Joint Statement issued on 7th February 2026.” The USTR had in March launched two separate investigations into American trade partners, including India, under Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act. The first investigation related to forced labour resulted in a tariff of 10% levied on India. The new tariffs announced on Wednesday are a result of the second investigation into structural excess capacity. Apart from this, the U.S. also levies a tariff of 50% on imports of aluminium and steel from all countries under Section 232 of its Trade Expansion Act. The new tariffs will not be added to these. Under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, the U.S. government is also empowered to levy a tariff of up to 100% on countries, including India, that import large quantities of Russian oil. This tariff has been temporarily paused by U.S. President Donald Trump.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In its report on India, the USTR concluded that India’s acts, policies, and practices “create, sustain, or contribute to structural excess capacity” that burden or restrict U.S. commerce by harming U.S. producers and exporters through unfair competition and reduced commercial opportunities; harm the U.S. economy due to lost exports, trade deficits, and a diminished manufacturing sector; and create economic security risks for the U.S.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Quantitative (Adjective)
आंकड़ों और संख्या पर आधारित — जिसे ठोस नंबरों और डेटा में मापा जा सके।
✓ Syn: Measurable, Numerical, Empirical  |  ✖ Ant: Qualitative, Subjective, Unmeasurable
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Representative (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Representative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, second-highest in the 14 countries against which action has been taken", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Trade Representative also opens the door for a lower 17% tariff if India and the U.S.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, second-' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, seco' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, seco' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Trade Representative also opens the door for a lower 17% tariff if India and the U.S." (Hinglish Arth: व्यापार प्रतिनिधि ने भारत और अमेरिका के बीच 17% कम टैरिफ का भी दरवाजा खोला है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, second-highest in the 14 countries against which action has been taken"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. economy due to lost exports, trade deficits, and a diminished manufacturing sector; and create economic security risks for the U.S.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "economy due to lost exports, trade deficits, and a diminished manufacturing sector; and create economic security risks for the U.S." (Hinglish Arth: निर्यात में कमी, व्यापार घाटे और घटते विनिर्माण क्षेत्र के कारण अर्थव्यवस्था; और अमेरिका के लिए आर्थिक सुरक्षा जोखिम पैदा करें।)

articles.title: MEA separates Sheikh Hasina’s plans to return to Bangladesh from issue of extradition
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘The case of a citizen willing to return voluntarily to her country on a travel document is a matter separate from the extradition request,’ MEA’s official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The return of the deposed former Prime Minister of Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina, using a “travel document” to her country and the process of her extradition from India to Bangladesh were two separate issues, India’s Ministry of External Affairs said on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). Speaking at the bi-weekly press briefing, the MEA’s official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal made the distinction, while expressing concern over the prevailing law and order situation in Bangladesh. Bangladesh’s request for Ms. Hasina’s extradition, made during the tenure of the interim government under Prof. Mohammed Yunus, is “being examined in line with our established processes”, Mr. Jaiswal said. Dhaka, in recent weeks, has talked about getting Ms. Hasina through an “acceptable prisoner exchange process”. Ms. Hasina had earlier this month requested the High Commission of Bangladesh, through a U.K.-based law firm, to issue her a fresh Bangladesh passport so that she could return home. Mr. Jaiswal said her plans to return to her country were separate from India extraditing her to Bangladesh. “The case of a citizen willing to return voluntarily to her country on a travel document is a matter separate from the extradition request,” Mr. Jaiswal said, adding that the issue of her return was a matter “between the former Prime Minister and the Bangladesh government”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ms. Hasina’s supporters from the Awami League have been agitating in her party’s strongholds in places, including Gopalganj and Narail, where the party’s workers have been targeted by law enforcement authorities. “We understandably are concerned at the incidents of violence against minorities in Bangladesh. We urge the government of Bangladesh to thoroughly investigate these incidents and bring the perpetrators to justice,” Mr. Jaiswal said.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 MEA separates Sheikh Hasina’s plans to return to Bangladesh from issue of extradition

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 08:22:12 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘The case of a citizen willing to return voluntarily to her country on a travel document is a matter separate from the extradition request,’ MEA’s official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The return of the deposed former Prime Minister of Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina, using a “travel document” to her country and the process of her extradition from India to Bangladesh were two separate issues, India’s Ministry of External Affairs said on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). Speaking at the bi-weekly press briefing, the MEA’s official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal made the distinction, while expressing concern over the prevailing law and order situation in Bangladesh. Bangladesh’s request for Ms. Hasina’s extradition, made during the tenure of the interim government under Prof. Mohammed Yunus, is “being examined in line with our established processes”, Mr. Jaiswal said. Dhaka, in recent weeks, has talked about getting Ms. Hasina through an “acceptable prisoner exchange process”. Ms. Hasina had earlier this month requested the High Commission of Bangladesh, through a U.K.-based law firm, to issue her a fresh Bangladesh passport so that she could return home. Mr. Jaiswal said her plans to return to her country were separate from India extraditing her to Bangladesh. “The case of a citizen willing to return voluntarily to her country on a travel document is a matter separate from the extradition request,” Mr. Jaiswal said, adding that the issue of her return was a matter “between the former Prime Minister and the Bangladesh government”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ms. Hasina’s supporters from the Awami League have been agitating in her party’s strongholds in places, including Gopalganj and Narail, where the party’s workers have been targeted by law enforcement authorities. “We understandably are concerned at the incidents of violence against minorities in Bangladesh. We urge the government of Bangladesh to thoroughly investigate these incidents and bring the perpetrators to justice,” Mr. Jaiswal said.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: ‘The case of a citizen willing to return voluntarily to her country on a travel document is a matter separate from the extradition request,’ MEA’s official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The return of the deposed former Prime Minister of Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina, using a “travel document” to her country and the process of her extradition from India to Bangladesh were two separate issues, India’s Ministry of External Affairs said on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). Speaking at the bi-weekly press briefing, the MEA’s official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal made the distinction, while expressing concern over the prevailing law and order situation in Bangladesh. Bangladesh’s request for Ms. Hasina’s extradition, made during the tenure of the interim government under Prof. Mohammed Yunus, is “being examined in line with our established processes”, Mr. Jaiswal said. Dhaka, in recent weeks, has talked about getting Ms. Hasina through an “acceptable prisoner exchange process”. Ms. Hasina had earlier this month requested the High Commission of Bangladesh, through a U.K.-based law firm, to issue her a fresh Bangladesh passport so that she could return home. Mr. Jaiswal said her plans to return to her country were separate from India extraditing her to Bangladesh. “The case of a citizen willing to return voluntarily to her country on a travel document is a matter separate from the extradition request,” Mr. Jaiswal said, adding that the issue of her return was a matter “between the former Prime Minister and the Bangladesh government”.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ms. Hasina’s supporters from the Awami League have been agitating in her party’s strongholds in places, including Gopalganj and Narail, where the party’s workers have been targeted by law enforcement authorities. “We understandably are concerned at the incidents of violence against minorities in Bangladesh. We urge the government of Bangladesh to thoroughly investigate these incidents and bring the perpetrators to justice,” Mr. Jaiswal said.

articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Army and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said emission monitors detected zero levels of airborne lead in the surrounding region immediately after the explosion

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The U.S. Army conducted a controlled detonation of an ageing stockpile of lead-based explosives in rural Iowa on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), declaring the ‌operation a success at safely destroying the unstable material while minimising toxic fallout. Residents of the Iowa farm town of Middletown closest to ​the adjacent munitions depot were evacuated ahead of time as a precaution, while others hunkered down inside their homes to avoid exposure to ⁠lead dust emitted from the blast. The Army and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said emission monitors detected zero levels of airborne lead in the surrounding region immediately after the explosion. Still, residents were told to remain indoors until officials gave the all-clear, and some expressed doubts about official reassurances. The detonation followed days of public rancour and legal wrangling over the controversial disposal ‌plan, which authorities said was far safer than waiting for the deteriorating chemical drums to eventually blow up on their own. Environmental Protection Agency Supervisor Susan Fisher collects soil samples in Augusta, Iowa, on November 25, 2026. | Photo Credit: AP Shortly after 9 a.m. CST (1500 GMT), the Federal Emergency Management Agency posted a message on its X account confirming the detonation had been carried out and urging ‌nearby residents to remain indoors for the time being. “Following this morning’s controlled detonation in Middletown, Iowa, residents within 20 miles who have not evacuated should continue ‌to ⁠shelter in place and follow EPA safety guidance until given the all clear by officials. FEMA has provided safe lodging to those who ⁠evacuated,” the agency wrote. A short time later, Army Secretary Aaron Telle declared that the “controlled, mitigated detonation”, designed to dispose of nearly 5 tonnes (4,500 kg) of highly volatile lead azide stored in 68 degrading plastic barrels, had “exceeded all expectations and was a huge success”. “The threat of a spontaneous detonation has been eliminated,” he said on X.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In a videotaped public service message posted online afterward, Army Colonel Aaron ​Teller, a munitions specialist who oversaw the operation, said the demolition and ‌the array of safety measures to muffle the blast and emissions worked.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 U.S. Army declares success in detonation of lead-based explosives stockpile in Iowa

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 07:35:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Army and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said emission monitors detected zero levels of airborne lead in the surrounding region immediately after the explosion

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The U.S. Army conducted a controlled detonation of an ageing stockpile of lead-based explosives in rural Iowa on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), declaring the ‌operation a success at safely destroying the unstable material while minimising toxic fallout. Residents of the Iowa farm town of Middletown closest to ​the adjacent munitions depot were evacuated ahead of time as a precaution, while others hunkered down inside their homes to avoid exposure to ⁠lead dust emitted from the blast. The Army and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said emission monitors detected zero levels of airborne lead in the surrounding region immediately after the explosion. Still, residents were told to remain indoors until officials gave the all-clear, and some expressed doubts about official reassurances. The detonation followed days of public rancour and legal wrangling over the controversial disposal ‌plan, which authorities said was far safer than waiting for the deteriorating chemical drums to eventually blow up on their own. Environmental Protection Agency Supervisor Susan Fisher collects soil samples in Augusta, Iowa, on November 25, 2026. | Photo Credit: AP Shortly after 9 a.m. CST (1500 GMT), the Federal Emergency Management Agency posted a message on its X account confirming the detonation had been carried out and urging ‌nearby residents to remain indoors for the time being. “Following this morning’s controlled detonation in Middletown, Iowa, residents within 20 miles who have not evacuated should continue ‌to ⁠shelter in place and follow EPA safety guidance until given the all clear by officials. FEMA has provided safe lodging to those who ⁠evacuated,” the agency wrote. A short time later, Army Secretary Aaron Telle declared that the “controlled, mitigated detonation”, designed to dispose of nearly 5 tonnes (4,500 kg) of highly volatile lead azide stored in 68 degrading plastic barrels, had “exceeded all expectations and was a huge success”. “The threat of a spontaneous detonation has been eliminated,” he said on X.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In a videotaped public service message posted online afterward, Army Colonel Aaron ​Teller, a munitions specialist who oversaw the operation, said the demolition and ‌the array of safety measures to muffle the blast and emissions worked.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Controversial (Adjective)
विवादित — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Controversial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Spontaneous (Adjective)
अविरल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Spontaneous' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "U.S. Army declares success in detonation of lead-based explosives stockpile in Iowa", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Environmental Protection Agency said emission monitors detected zero levels of airborne lead in the surrounding region immediately after the explosion.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'U.S. Army declares success in detonation of lead' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'U.S. Army declares success in detonation of l' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'U.S. Army declares success in detonation of l' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Environmental Protection Agency said emission monitors detected zero levels of airborne lead in the surrounding region immediately after the explosion." (Hinglish Arth: पर्यावरण संरक्षण एजेंसी ने कहा कि उत्सर्जन मॉनिटरों ने विस्फोट के तुरंत बाद आसपास के क्षेत्र में वायुजनित सीसे का शून्य स्तर पाया)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "U.S. Army declares success in detonation of lead-based explosives stockpile in Iowa"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. In a videotaped public service message posted online afterward, Army Colonel Aaron ​Teller, a munitions specialist who oversaw the operation, said...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "In a videotaped public service message posted online afterward, Army Colonel Aaron ​Teller, a munitions specialist who oversaw the operation, said..." (Hinglish Arth: बाद में ऑनलाइन पोस्ट किए गए एक वीडियोटेप किए गए सार्वजनिक सेवा संदेश में, सेना के कर्नल आरोन टेलर, एक युद्ध सामग्री विशेषज्ञ, जिन्होंने ऑपरेशन की देखरेख की, ने विस्फोट को कम करने के लिए विध्वंस और सुरक्षा उपायों की श्रृंखला के बारे में बताया।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Around 25 lakh voters to exercise their franchise in 964 wards; 2,968 candidates are in the fray; the count of votes scheduled for November 30

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: State Election Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha and NTR District Collector G. Lakshmisha speak to voters at a polling station in Enikepadu on Thursday. Photo: K.V.S. Giri By 9 a.m., 13.26% of voters in the urban local bodies and 16.25% in the gram panchayats had cast their votes, the State Election Commission said. Polling began at 7 a.m., and 3,240 gram panchayats are voting in the first phase. The municipal corporations going to the polls are Kakinada, Mangalagiri-Tadepalli, Rajamahendravaram and Srikakulam. The municipalities and nagar panchayats are Amadalavalasa, Rajam, Palacole, Gudur, Bhimavaram, Tanuku, Tadepalligudem, Chinthalapudi, Gudivada, Tadigadapa, Ponnur, Narasaraopeta, Bapatla, Kandukur, Podili, Kavali, Alluru, Srikalahasti and B. Kothakota.- V. Raghavendra Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu and his family cast their votes at a polling station at Undavalli, in the Mangalagiri-Tadepalli Municipal Corporation, on Thursday. Speaking to reporters afterwards, he appealed to people to come out and vote in large numbers.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Andhra Pradesh / election / politics / Live news / Andhra Pradesh Local Body Elections 2026

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Ten LeT terrorists from Pakistan arrived by sea on November 26, 2008, and killed 166 people, including 18 security personnel, during a 60-hour siege of Mumbai

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma and Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Thursday (November 26, 2026) paid floral tributes at the city police headquarters to those who made the ultimate sacrifice while fighting terrorists during the Mumbai terror attacks 18 years ago . Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar, Director General of Police Sadanand Date, Mumbai Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and other officials were present. Mr. Varma and Mr. Fadnavis also met the family members of the policemen who sacrificed their lives during the 26/11 attacks. “Humble tributes to the brave heroes who laid down their lives defending Mumbai against the 26/11 terror attacks and to the innocent civilians who lost their lives,” Mr*. Fadnavis said in a post on X. The November 26, 2008, attacks, carried out by 10 heavily armed Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terrorists who sailed into Mumbai from Pakistan, left 166 people, including foreigners, dead and more than 300 injured, making them one of the deadliest terror strikes in an Indian city. An exterior view of the Trident hotel at Nariman Point on the eve of the 18th anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, in Mumbai. | Photo Credit: PTI The attacks prompted global condemnation and led to significant changes in India’s counter-terrorism measures. The attack, which continued until the morning of November 29, targeted several iconic locations bustling with people, including the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, the Trident Hotel, Nariman House (Chabad House), Leopold Cafe and Cama and Albless Hospital. President Droupadi Murmu saluted the courage of brave security personnel and all those who stood fearlessly against the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks and said that “terrorism may shatter lives, but it can never break the spirit of a nation united in courage, compassion, and resilience.”
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Their sacrifice and selfless service will forever remain etched in our nation's soul,” she said in a post on X.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 2008 Mumbai terror attacks: Tributes paid to martyrs on 18th anniversary

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 11:15:20 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Ten LeT terrorists from Pakistan arrived by sea on November 26, 2008, and killed 166 people, including 18 security personnel, during a 60-hour siege of Mumbai

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma and Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Thursday (November 26, 2026) paid floral tributes at the city police headquarters to those who made the ultimate sacrifice while fighting terrorists during the Mumbai terror attacks 18 years ago . Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar, Director General of Police Sadanand Date, Mumbai Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and other officials were present. Mr. Varma and Mr. Fadnavis also met the family members of the policemen who sacrificed their lives during the 26/11 attacks. “Humble tributes to the brave heroes who laid down their lives defending Mumbai against the 26/11 terror attacks and to the innocent civilians who lost their lives,” Mr*. Fadnavis said in a post on X. The November 26, 2008, attacks, carried out by 10 heavily armed Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terrorists who sailed into Mumbai from Pakistan, left 166 people, including foreigners, dead and more than 300 injured, making them one of the deadliest terror strikes in an Indian city. An exterior view of the Trident hotel at Nariman Point on the eve of the 18th anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, in Mumbai. | Photo Credit: PTI The attacks prompted global condemnation and led to significant changes in India’s counter-terrorism measures. The attack, which continued until the morning of November 29, targeted several iconic locations bustling with people, including the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, the Trident Hotel, Nariman House (Chabad House), Leopold Cafe and Cama and Albless Hospital. President Droupadi Murmu saluted the courage of brave security personnel and all those who stood fearlessly against the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks and said that “terrorism may shatter lives, but it can never break the spirit of a nation united in courage, compassion, and resilience.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Their sacrifice and selfless service will forever remain etched in our nation's soul,” she said in a post on X.

articles.title: How should the Census count caste?
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The 2027 Census will enumerate caste through an open-entry question, risking a repeat of the 2011 Socio-Economic and Caste Census, which returned about 46.7 lakh caste names; recording the administrative category alongside the caste name would give India reliable caste-wise information on education, occupation and assets

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The 2027 Census will ask every household in India about caste for the first time since 1931, through an open-entry question with no pre-coded list for communities outside the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe categories. The choice risks repeating the failure of 2011 and reviving an argument over categories that B.R. Ambedkar addressed in 1932. We argue that both can be avoided if the enumerator also records, next to the caste name, the administrative category under which the respondent’s community is classified: SC, ST, Other Backward Classes (OBC) or General. The population enumeration begins across most of the country in February 2027. Question 10 of the schedule reads “SC/ST/Caste”. SCs and STs are recorded against notified lists, as in every Census exercise since 1951. Everyone else names a caste, and the enumerator enters it as spoken. There is no drop-down menu and no State-wise schedule. Officials say that a code directory and validation checks will reconcile spellings, sub-castes and regional names once the count is done. On October 28, 2026, the Supreme Court declined to hear a plea for an OBC drop-down menu, calling it a matter of policy. India has tried open entry before. The Socio-Economic and Caste Census of 2011 returned about 46.7 lakh distinct caste names, against the 4,147 castes recorded in 1931. Yadav, Yadava, and Yaduvanshi became separate entries; so did Verma and Varma, and so did a jati name and a surname, both offered by members of the same community. The caste tables were never released. A better code directory may manage what the 2011 exercise could not. Even so, it will be sorting the data after the count. Three States have used the other method. Bihar, Karnataka and Telangana conducted surveys using pre-coded caste lists and found backward classes at 63%, about 70% and 56.33% of their populations, respectively. The Congress, which oversaw the 2011 exercise, now cites them to ask why the Centre cannot do the same. The government’s reason is that the central and State OBC lists, covering nearly 3,000 communities between them, are, in the official phrase, “a list of classes and not a list of castes”. They include entries such as “local borns” in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and tea garden workers in Assam. Loaded onto an enumerator’s tablet as a caste menu, they would not work. Membership of a list can, however, be recorded in a separate field next to the caste name.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Text and Context / The Hindu Explains / Census 2027 / Socio Economic And Caste Census

They include entries such as “local borns” in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and tea garden workers in Assam. Loaded onto an enumerator’s tablet as a caste menu, they would not work. Membership of a list can, however, be recorded in a separate field next to the caste name.

hinglishTracks.en: The 2027 Census will enumerate caste through an open-entry question, risking a repeat of the 2011 Socio-Economic and Caste Census, which returned about 46.7 lakh caste names; recording the administrative category alongside the caste name would give India reliable caste-wise information on education, occupation and assets
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 2027 की जनगणना एक खुले प्रवेश प्रश्न के माध्यम से जाति की गणना करेगी, जिससे 2011 की सामाजिक-आर्थिक और जाति जनगणना की पुनरावृत्ति का खतरा होगा, जिसमें लगभग 46.7 लाख जाति के नाम वापस आए थे; जाति के नाम के साथ प्रशासनिक श्रेणी दर्ज करने से भारत को शिक्षा, व्यवसाय और संपत्ति पर जाति-वार विश्वसनीय जानकारी मिलेगी। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Administrative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administrative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The 2027 Census will ask every household in India about caste for the first time since 1931, through an open-entry question with no pre-coded list for communities outside the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe categories.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — 2027 की जनगणना में 1931 के बाद पहली बार भारत के हर घर से एक ओपन-एंट्री प्रश्न के माध्यम से जाति के बारे में पूछा जाएगा, जिसमें अनुसूचित जाति और अनुसूचित जनजाति श्रेणियों के बाहर के समुदायों के लिए कोई पूर्व-कोडित सूची नहीं होगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The choice risks repeating the failure of 2011 and reviving an argument over categories that B.R.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस विकल्प में 2011 की विफलता को दोहराने और बी.आर. की श्रेणियों पर एक तर्क को पुनर्जीवित करने का जोखिम है।।

hinglishTracks.en: We argue that both can be avoided if the enumerator also records, next to the caste name, the administrative category under which the respondent’s community is classified: SC, ST, Other Backward Classes (OBC) or General.
