articles.title: Special Parliament sitting from November 30 likely to take up amended Delimitation Bill
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Union Cabinet will meet on November 27 to clear the amended legislation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The government has called for a special sitting of Parliament beginning Monday (November 30, 2026), where it is likely to table an amended Delimitation Bill. The two Houses will meet on separate dates, Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju announced on Thursday (November 26, 2026), which is the 104th day since the Monsoon Session adjourned indefinitely on August 13. Lok Sabha sittings will begin on November 30 and Rajya Sabha sittings on December 2. Both Houses will conclude on December 3. The last record of a session of Parliament continuing unprorogued was in 2008 , when it went on for 87 days. The Union Cabinet will meet on Friday (November 27, 2026) to clear the amended legislation. According to sources, three crucial changes are being introduced: a uniform 50% increase in the share of Lok Sabha seats; extending the freeze for 25 years on using the 1971 Census as the basis to determine the proportional strength of each State in the Lok Sabha; and third, using the 2011 Census for redrawing constituencies within each State. This replicates the formula brought by the Atal Bihari Vajpayee government in the Constitution (Eighty-fourth Amendment) Act, 2001. Since April, when the legislative package, including the Delimitation Bill, was defeated by a united Opposition in the Lok Sabha, the seat arithmetic in the House has changed. Twenty TMC MPs broke away and merged with the Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI), pledging support to the NDA. TMC challenged the split, which is currently under Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla’s review. The NCPI faction, on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), 84 days after TMC’s challenge, submitted replies to Mr. Birla, defending its decision and asserting that the move did not violate any parliamentary or constitutional provisions. Six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs joined the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena. Following the recent alliance between the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), the lone SAD MP is also expected to vote with the government. It is also learnt that the YSR Congress, which has four MPs in the Lok Sabha, will extend support to the government on the Bill. In this evolving situation, all eyes are on the DMK, with 22 Lok Sabha MPs, and the NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar), with eight. Senior NCP (SP) leader Supriya Sule, on Thursday (November 26, 2026), told reporters that pre-emptively opposing the law before its draft was made public was not a good move. “First let the bill come. Let the entire bill come into our hands. When the bill is in our hands, then we will all talk about it, and if the bill is good for the nation, we might support it,” she said. She further added that there have been instances in the past when the Opposition has supported the government on matters of national importance and key reforms. The DMK, meanwhile, has not made any public remarks on the issue. Though, as per sources, the government has reached out to the party informally. A dominant section of the DMK is leaning towards the argument that not supporting the present constitutional amendment could mean further reduced representation for Tamil Nadu. “The freeze under Articles 81 and 82, which prevents the readjustment of seats allotted to each State in the Lok Sabha, has an inbuilt sunset clause. It provides that the freeze shall cease to operate once the relevant figures of the first Census undertaken after 2026 are published. If a constitutional amendment is not brought, the freeze will automatically lapse,” Swapnil Tripathi, who leads Charkha, Centre for Constitutional Law at the Vidhi Centre for Legal Policy, explained.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: If the post-2026 Census figures are taken into consideration, a top DMK leader argued, the State could end up losing as many as 12 seats in the Lok Sabha. “We are for a fair delimitation,” a top DMK leader said.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सरकार ने सोमवार (नवंबर 30, 2026) से संसद की विशेष बैठक बुलाई है, जहां वह संशोधित परिसीमन विधेयक पेश कर सकती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Delimitation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: हदबंदी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Delimitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The two Houses will meet on separate dates, Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju announced on Thursday (November 26, 2026), which is the 104th day since the Monsoon Session adjourned indefinitely on August 13.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — केंद्रीय संसदीय कार्य मंत्री किरेन रिजिजू ने गुरुवार (26 नवंबर, 2026) को घोषणा की कि दोनों सदन अलग-अलग तारीखों पर मिलेंगे, जो 13 अगस्त को मानसून सत्र अनिश्चित काल के लिए स्थगित होने के बाद से 104 वां दिन है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Lok Sabha sittings will begin on November 30 and Rajya Sabha sittings on December 2.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लोकसभा की बैठकें 30 नवंबर और राज्यसभा की बैठकें 2 दिसंबर से शुरू होंगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Both Houses will conclude on December 3.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — दोनों सदन 3 दिसंबर को समाप्त होंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: The last record of a session of Parliament continuing unprorogued was in 2008 , when it went on for 87 days.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — संसद के किसी सत्र के बिना सत्रावसान के जारी रहने का पिछला रिकॉर्ड 2008 का था, जब यह 87 दिनों तक चला था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Union Cabinet will meet on Friday (November 27, 2026) to clear the amended legislation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — संशोधित कानून को मंजूरी देने के लिए केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल शुक्रवार (नवंबर 27, 2026) को बैठक करेगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: According to sources, three crucial changes are being introduced: a uniform 50% increase in the share of Lok Sabha seats; extending the freeze for 25 years on using the 1971 Census as the basis to determine the proportional strength of each State in the Lok Sabha; and third, using the 2011 Census for redrawing constituencies within each State.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सूत्रों के अनुसार, तीन महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव पेश किए जा रहे हैं: लोकसभा सीटों की हिस्सेदारी में एक समान 50% की वृद्धि; लोकसभा में प्रत्येक राज्य की आनुपातिक ताकत निर्धारित करने के लिए 1971 की जनगणना को आधार के रूप में उपयोग करने पर रोक को 25 वर्षों के लिए बढ़ाना; और तीसरा, प्रत्येक राज्य के भीतर निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों को फिर से तैयार करने के लिए 2011 की जनगणना का उपयोग करना।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: This replicates the formula brought by the Atal Bihari Vajpayee government in the Constitution (Eighty-fourth Amendment) Act, 2001.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी सरकार द्वारा संविधान (चौरासीवां संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2001 में लाए गए फॉर्मूले को दोहराता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Since April, when the legislative package, including the Delimitation Bill, was defeated by a united Opposition in the Lok Sabha, the seat arithmetic in the House has changed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अप्रैल के बाद से, जब परिसीमन विधेयक सहित विधायी पैकेज, लोकसभा में एकजुट विपक्ष द्वारा पराजित हो गया, सदन में सीट अंकगणित बदल गया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Delimitation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: हदबंदी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Delimitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Twenty TMC MPs broke away and merged with the Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI), pledging support to the NDA.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — टीएमसी के बीस सांसद एनडीए को समर्थन देने का वादा करते हुए अलग हो गए और नेशनलिस्ट सिटीजन्स पार्टी ऑफ इंडिया (एनसीपीआई) में विलय कर लिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: TMC challenged the split, which is currently under Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla’s review.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — टीएमसी ने विभाजन को चुनौती दी, जो वर्तमान में लोकसभा अध्यक्ष ओम बिरला की समीक्षा के अधीन है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The NCPI faction, on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), 84 days after TMC’s challenge, submitted replies to Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — टीएमसी की चुनौती के 84 दिन बाद मंगलवार (24 नवंबर, 2026) को एनसीपीआई गुट ने श्री को जवाब सौंप दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Birla, defending its decision and asserting that the move did not violate any parliamentary or constitutional provisions.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बिड़ला ने अपने फैसले का बचाव करते हुए कहा कि इस कदम ने किसी भी संसदीय या संवैधानिक प्रावधानों का उल्लंघन नहीं किया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs joined the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — शिव सेना (यूबीटी) के छह सांसद एकनाथ शिंदे के नेतृत्व वाली शिव सेना में शामिल हो गए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Following the recent alliance between the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), the lone SAD MP is also expected to vote with the government.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भाजपा और शिरोमणि अकाली दल (शिअद) के बीच हालिया गठबंधन के बाद, एकमात्र शिअद सांसद के भी सरकार के साथ मतदान करने की उम्मीद है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is also learnt that the YSR Congress, which has four MPs in the Lok Sabha, will extend support to the government on the Bill.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यह भी पता चला है कि वाईएसआर कांग्रेस, जिसके लोकसभा में चार सांसद हैं, विधेयक पर सरकार को समर्थन देगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: In this evolving situation, all eyes are on the DMK, with 22 Lok Sabha MPs, and the NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar), with eight.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस उभरती स्थिति में, सभी की निगाहें 22 लोकसभा सांसदों वाली डीएमके और आठ सांसदों वाली एनसीपी (शरदचंद्र पवार) पर हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Senior NCP (SP) leader Supriya Sule, on Thursday (November 26, 2026), told reporters that pre-emptively opposing the law before its draft was made public was not a good move.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एनसीपी (एसपी) की वरिष्ठ नेता सुप्रिया सुले ने गुरुवार (नवंबर 26, 2026) को संवाददाताओं से कहा कि कानून का मसौदा सार्वजनिक होने से पहले ही उसका विरोध करना अच्छा कदम नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “First let the bill come.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “पहले बिल आने दो।।

hinglishTracks.en: Let the entire bill come into our hands.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पूरा बिल हमारे हाथ में आ जाए.।

hinglishTracks.en: When the bill is in our hands, then we will all talk about it, and if the bill is good for the nation, we might support it,” she said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जब बिल हमारे हाथ में होगा, तब हम सब इस पर बात करेंगे और अगर बिल देश के लिए अच्छा है, तो हम इसका समर्थन कर सकते हैं,'' उन्होंने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: She further added that there have been instances in the past when the Opposition has supported the government on matters of national importance and key reforms.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने आगे कहा कि अतीत में ऐसे उदाहरण हैं जब विपक्ष ने राष्ट्रीय महत्व और प्रमुख सुधारों के मामलों पर सरकार का समर्थन किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The DMK, meanwhile, has not made any public remarks on the issue.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इस बीच, द्रमुक ने इस मुद्दे पर कोई सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी नहीं की है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Though, as per sources, the government has reached out to the party informally.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हालांकि सूत्रों के मुताबिक सरकार ने अनौपचारिक तौर पर पार्टी से संपर्क किया है.।

hinglishTracks.en: A dominant section of the DMK is leaning towards the argument that not supporting the present constitutional amendment could mean further reduced representation for Tamil Nadu.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — द्रमुक का एक प्रमुख वर्ग इस तर्क की ओर झुक रहा है कि वर्तमान संवैधानिक संशोधन का समर्थन नहीं करने का मतलब तमिलनाडु के लिए प्रतिनिधित्व में और कमी हो सकती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: “The freeze under Articles 81 and 82, which prevents the readjustment of seats allotted to each State in the Lok Sabha, has an inbuilt sunset clause.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “अनुच्छेद 81 और 82 के तहत रोक, जो लोकसभा में प्रत्येक राज्य को आवंटित सीटों के पुन: समायोजन को रोकती है, में एक अंतर्निहित सूर्यास्त खंड है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It provides that the freeze shall cease to operate once the relevant figures of the first Census undertaken after 2026 are published.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसमें प्रावधान है कि 2026 के बाद की गई पहली जनगणना के प्रासंगिक आंकड़े प्रकाशित होने के बाद फ्रीज का संचालन बंद हो जाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: If a constitutional amendment is not brought, the freeze will automatically lapse,” Swapnil Tripathi, who leads Charkha, Centre for Constitutional Law at the Vidhi Centre for Legal Policy, explained.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यदि कोई संवैधानिक संशोधन नहीं लाया जाता है, तो रोक स्वतः समाप्त हो जाएगी, ”विधि सेंटर फॉर लीगल पॉलिसी में संवैधानिक कानून केंद्र, चरखा का नेतृत्व करने वाले स्वप्निल त्रिपाठी ने समझाया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: If the post-2026 Census figures are taken into consideration, a top DMK leader argued, the State could end up losing as many as 12 seats in the Lok Sabha.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — डीएमके के एक शीर्ष नेता ने तर्क दिया कि यदि 2026 के बाद की जनगणना के आंकड़ों को ध्यान में रखा जाए, तो राज्य को लोकसभा में 12 सीटों का नुकसान हो सकता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Consideration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सोच-विचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consideration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Special Parliament sitting from November 30 likely to take up amended Delimitation Bill

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 09:24:22 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Union Cabinet will meet on November 27 to clear the amended legislation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The government has called for a special sitting of Parliament beginning Monday (November 30, 2026), where it is likely to table an amended Delimitation Bill. The two Houses will meet on separate dates, Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju announced on Thursday (November 26, 2026), which is the 104th day since the Monsoon Session adjourned indefinitely on August 13. Lok Sabha sittings will begin on November 30 and Rajya Sabha sittings on December 2. Both Houses will conclude on December 3. The last record of a session of Parliament continuing unprorogued was in 2008 , when it went on for 87 days. The Union Cabinet will meet on Friday (November 27, 2026) to clear the amended legislation. According to sources, three crucial changes are being introduced: a uniform 50% increase in the share of Lok Sabha seats; extending the freeze for 25 years on using the 1971 Census as the basis to determine the proportional strength of each State in the Lok Sabha; and third, using the 2011 Census for redrawing constituencies within each State. This replicates the formula brought by the Atal Bihari Vajpayee government in the Constitution (Eighty-fourth Amendment) Act, 2001. Since April, when the legislative package, including the Delimitation Bill, was defeated by a united Opposition in the Lok Sabha, the seat arithmetic in the House has changed. Twenty TMC MPs broke away and merged with the Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI), pledging support to the NDA. TMC challenged the split, which is currently under Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla’s review. The NCPI faction, on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), 84 days after TMC’s challenge, submitted replies to Mr. Birla, defending its decision and asserting that the move did not violate any parliamentary or constitutional provisions. Six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs joined the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena. Following the recent alliance between the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), the lone SAD MP is also expected to vote with the government. It is also learnt that the YSR Congress, which has four MPs in the Lok Sabha, will extend support to the government on the Bill. In this evolving situation, all eyes are on the DMK, with 22 Lok Sabha MPs, and the NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar), with eight. Senior NCP (SP) leader Supriya Sule, on Thursday (November 26, 2026), told reporters that pre-emptively opposing the law before its draft was made public was not a good move. “First let the bill come. Let the entire bill come into our hands. When the bill is in our hands, then we will all talk about it, and if the bill is good for the nation, we might support it,” she said. She further added that there have been instances in the past when the Opposition has supported the government on matters of national importance and key reforms. The DMK, meanwhile, has not made any public remarks on the issue. Though, as per sources, the government has reached out to the party informally. A dominant section of the DMK is leaning towards the argument that not supporting the present constitutional amendment could mean further reduced representation for Tamil Nadu. “The freeze under Articles 81 and 82, which prevents the readjustment of seats allotted to each State in the Lok Sabha, has an inbuilt sunset clause. It provides that the freeze shall cease to operate once the relevant figures of the first Census undertaken after 2026 are published. If a constitutional amendment is not brought, the freeze will automatically lapse,” Swapnil Tripathi, who leads Charkha, Centre for Constitutional Law at the Vidhi Centre for Legal Policy, explained.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: If the post-2026 Census figures are taken into consideration, a top DMK leader argued, the State could end up losing as many as 12 seats in the Lok Sabha. “We are for a fair delimitation,” a top DMK leader said.

Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Representation (Noun)
प्रतिनिधित्व — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Representation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Consideration (Noun)
सोच-विचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consideration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Delimitation (Adjective / Verb)
हदबंदी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Delimitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Special Parliament sitting from November 30 likely to take up amended Delimitation Bill", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Union Cabinet will meet on November 27 to clear the amended legislation.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Special Parliament sitting from November 30 like' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Special Parliament sitting from November 30 l' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Special Parliament sitting from November 30 l' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Union Cabinet will meet on November 27 to clear the amended legislation." (Hinglish Arth: संशोधित कानून को मंजूरी देने के लिए केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल 27 नवंबर को बैठक करेगा)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Special Parliament sitting from November 30 likely to take up amended Delimitation Bill"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “We are for a fair delimitation,” a top DMK leader said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“We are for a fair delimitation,” a top DMK leader said." (Hinglish Arth: द्रमुक के एक शीर्ष नेता ने कहा, ''हम निष्पक्ष परिसीमन के पक्ष में हैं।'')

articles.title: Infectious diseases from free-ranging domestic animals threaten Nilgiris wildlife
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Five of the 12 reported instances of wildlife deaths since 2005 likely due to infections contracted from feral animals were recorded in the Nilgiris district, shows report by Forest Department

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Frequent interactions between wildlife and free-ranging domestic animals raise concerns about disease transmission to wildlife in the Nilgiris. According to a report submitted by the Forest Department to the Madras High Court, five of the 12 reported instances of infections that caused wildlife deaths, likely due to interactions with feral animals, since 2005 were recorded in the Nilgiris district. Necropsy on wildlife carcasses had found canine distemper and rabies as the cause of deaths, which had been reported in the Nilgiris, Gudalur and Mudumalai Tiger Reserve (MTR) forest divisions. S. Muralidharan, who is appearing as the party-in-person before the High Court, has sought judicial intervention to address the threat to wildlife. He told The Hindu that there have been instances of diseases such as canine distemper and rabies spreading to wildlife from free-ranging domestic animals, particularly dogs. He pointed out that such diseases had threatened the survival of vulnerable wildlife populations, citing outbreaks of canine distemper among Asiatic lions in Gujarat as an example of the potential consequences. “This is a very serious concern, especially in areas where there is a very high interface between wildlife and human communities, which feed and maintain free-ranging dog populations, like in the Nilgiris” he said. Mr. Muralidharan called on the government to take measures to manage free-ranging dogs and cats in areas bordering tiger reserves and reserve forests across the State, including their removal from these areas to protect wildlife. “These animals also hunt small game such as birds and even deer and can be extremely aggressive,” he said. According to the report filed by the Forest Department, the deaths of the 12 animals reported due to transmission of disease from domestic animals include those of leopards (canine distemper), Nilgiri langur (rabies), Indian gaur (rabies), sloth bear (rabies and ehrlichiosis) and golden jackals (canine distemper and parvovirus infection). Conservationists said that the number of animals dying from diseases transmitted to wildlife from feral animals could be much higher as not all wildlife deaths are reported or are noticed if they occur inside reserve forests.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The deaths had been reported in Kodaikanal, Kalakkad Mundanthurai Tiger Reserve (KMTR), Sivaganga, Theni, Kanniyakumari and Tirunelveli, but the Nilgiris had the highest number of the reported deaths.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Infectious diseases from free-ranging domestic animals threaten Nilgiris wildlife

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 09:24:03 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Five of the 12 reported instances of wildlife deaths since 2005 likely due to infections contracted from feral animals were recorded in the Nilgiris district, shows report by Forest Department

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Frequent interactions between wildlife and free-ranging domestic animals raise concerns about disease transmission to wildlife in the Nilgiris. According to a report submitted by the Forest Department to the Madras High Court, five of the 12 reported instances of infections that caused wildlife deaths, likely due to interactions with feral animals, since 2005 were recorded in the Nilgiris district. Necropsy on wildlife carcasses had found canine distemper and rabies as the cause of deaths, which had been reported in the Nilgiris, Gudalur and Mudumalai Tiger Reserve (MTR) forest divisions. S. Muralidharan, who is appearing as the party-in-person before the High Court, has sought judicial intervention to address the threat to wildlife. He told The Hindu that there have been instances of diseases such as canine distemper and rabies spreading to wildlife from free-ranging domestic animals, particularly dogs. He pointed out that such diseases had threatened the survival of vulnerable wildlife populations, citing outbreaks of canine distemper among Asiatic lions in Gujarat as an example of the potential consequences. “This is a very serious concern, especially in areas where there is a very high interface between wildlife and human communities, which feed and maintain free-ranging dog populations, like in the Nilgiris” he said. Mr. Muralidharan called on the government to take measures to manage free-ranging dogs and cats in areas bordering tiger reserves and reserve forests across the State, including their removal from these areas to protect wildlife. “These animals also hunt small game such as birds and even deer and can be extremely aggressive,” he said. According to the report filed by the Forest Department, the deaths of the 12 animals reported due to transmission of disease from domestic animals include those of leopards (canine distemper), Nilgiri langur (rabies), Indian gaur (rabies), sloth bear (rabies and ehrlichiosis) and golden jackals (canine distemper and parvovirus infection). Conservationists said that the number of animals dying from diseases transmitted to wildlife from feral animals could be much higher as not all wildlife deaths are reported or are noticed if they occur inside reserve forests.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The deaths had been reported in Kodaikanal, Kalakkad Mundanthurai Tiger Reserve (KMTR), Sivaganga, Theni, Kanniyakumari and Tirunelveli, but the Nilgiris had the highest number of the reported deaths.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Transmission (Noun)
संचरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transmission' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Intervention (Adjective / Verb)
हस्तक्षेप — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intervention' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Department (Adjective)
विभाग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Department' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Aggressive (Adjective)
आक्रामक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Aggressive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Infectious diseases from free-ranging domestic animals threaten Nilgiris wildlife", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Five of the 12 reported instances of wildlife deaths since 2005 likely due to infections contracted from feral animals were recorded in the Nilgiris...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Infectious diseases from free-ranging domestic a' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Infectious diseases from free-ranging domesti' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Infectious diseases from free-ranging domesti' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Five of the 12 reported instances of wildlife deaths since 2005 likely due to infections contracted from feral animals were recorded in the Nilgiris..." (Hinglish Arth: वन विभाग की रिपोर्ट से पता चलता है कि 2005 के बाद से जंगली जानवरों से संक्रमित संक्रमण के कारण वन्यजीवों की मौत के 12 मामलों में से पांच नीलगिरी जिले में दर्ज किए गए थे।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Infectious diseases from free-ranging domestic animals threaten Nilgiris wildlife"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The deaths had been reported in Kodaikanal, Kalakkad Mundanthurai Tiger Reserve (KMTR), Sivaganga, Theni, Kanniyakumari and Tirunelveli, but the...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The deaths had been reported in Kodaikanal, Kalakkad Mundanthurai Tiger Reserve (KMTR), Sivaganga, Theni, Kanniyakumari and Tirunelveli, but the..." (Hinglish Arth: कोडईकनाल, कलक्कड़ मुंडनथुराई टाइगर रिजर्व (केएमटीआर), शिवगंगा, थेनी, कन्नियाकुमारी और तिरुनेलवेली में मौतें दर्ज की गई थीं, लेकिन नीलगिरी में सबसे ज्यादा मौतें हुईं।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Telangana High Court will pronounce orders today (Friday) in a couple of PIL petitions challenging the e-auction of 3.15 acres of government land at Kukatpally. The e-auction was slated to be held today.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The bench of Acting Chief Justice P. Sam Koshy and Justice Suddala Chlapathi Rao reserved the orders on Thursday after hearing contentions of the Additional Advocate General and the senior counsels for the petitioners B. Mayur Reddy and Gandra Mohan Rao in the two petitions. While one plea was filed by Madhavaram Kantha Rao, the other was by Madhavaram Sivaiah Gari Krishna Rao. Kantha Rao contested from Kukatpally as BJP nominee in 2018 Assembly polls while Krishna Rao of BRS party is MLA from Kukatpally. The Additional AG informed the bench that the State government acquired 33.22 acres of government land in 1981 to create parking lots for truckers. The original land owners were paid compensation by the government. The truck terminals were established to ensure heavy vehicles did not enter city during peak traffic hours. Out of the acquired land, the government decided to sell 3.15 acres of land and spend the revenue accrued for public purpose, he contended. As the arguments progressed, the Acting CJ sought to know from the petitioners’ counsels as to why the truck owners did not approach the court since they would be the aggrieved parties due to sale of land meant for parking lots.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The bench also wanted to know why the original land owners from whom the land acquired did not also seem to be having any grievance over the government move. The Additional AG argued that there was no public interest involved in the matter going by the fact that the two petitioners were in active politics. The senior counsels contended that the government’s decision was in violation of the Supreme Court verdicts. The apex court earlier held that lands acquired for public purpose cannot be sold except being used for the specific purpose, they said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 HC reserves orders over e-auction of truck parking land at Kukatpally

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 09:23:44 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Telangana High Court will pronounce orders today (Friday) in a couple of PIL petitions challenging the e-auction of 3.15 acres of government land at Kukatpally. The e-auction was slated to be held today.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The bench of Acting Chief Justice P. Sam Koshy and Justice Suddala Chlapathi Rao reserved the orders on Thursday after hearing contentions of the Additional Advocate General and the senior counsels for the petitioners B. Mayur Reddy and Gandra Mohan Rao in the two petitions. While one plea was filed by Madhavaram Kantha Rao, the other was by Madhavaram Sivaiah Gari Krishna Rao. Kantha Rao contested from Kukatpally as BJP nominee in 2018 Assembly polls while Krishna Rao of BRS party is MLA from Kukatpally. The Additional AG informed the bench that the State government acquired 33.22 acres of government land in 1981 to create parking lots for truckers. The original land owners were paid compensation by the government. The truck terminals were established to ensure heavy vehicles did not enter city during peak traffic hours. Out of the acquired land, the government decided to sell 3.15 acres of land and spend the revenue accrued for public purpose, he contended. As the arguments progressed, the Acting CJ sought to know from the petitioners’ counsels as to why the truck owners did not approach the court since they would be the aggrieved parties due to sale of land meant for parking lots.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The bench also wanted to know why the original land owners from whom the land acquired did not also seem to be having any grievance over the government move. The Additional AG argued that there was no public interest involved in the matter going by the fact that the two petitioners were in active politics. The original land owners were paid compensation by the government. The truck terminals were established to ensure heavy vehicles did not enter city during peak traffic hours. Out of the acquired land, the government decided to sell 3.15 acres of land and spend the revenue accrued for public purpose, he contended. The senior counsels contended that the government’s decision was in violation of the Supreme Court verdicts. articles.title: Enumerate Telangana tenant farmers in crop loss survey; support financially distressed farmers: Committee
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Telangana Tenant Farmers Recognition Struggle Committee has demanded the State government to include tenant farmers — who make up around 36% of farmers community — too to be enumerated in the ongoing Agriculture Department’s survey of farmers who suffered crop loss due to El Nino induced drought.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Highlighting the financial distress they are undergoing due to land lease payments and loss of crops due to the drought, they sought government to issue clear written guidelines to Agriculture Extension Officers (AEO) on enumerating tenant farmers and process to be followed for this. On a larger note, the Committee demanded recognition cards for the tenant farmers which would help them to get compensation in such distressing weather situations, avail welfare scheme and sell farm produce at Minimum Support Price (MSP). At a press conference held in Hyderabad on Thursday, the Committee members along with farmers, released findings of a field study on the ongoing crop loss survey, explained how they are strained financially and need for support from the government. The members said that distress among farmers would increase narrowing their options if the support is not provided. A team from Rythu Swarajya Vedika conducted field study on the government’s crop loss survey by speaking to 145 farmers in 10 villages of Adilabad and Vikarabad. Out of these, 89 were tenant farmers who were not recorded in the enumeration though all of them suffered more than 33% crop damage, as per a claim in a press release. Many farmers were unaware of the survey. Maize, soybean, green gram and black gram harvested before the survey were left out of the survey, despite farmers reporting crop losses averaging 65%. Besides, farmers were unaware on whether their names were included or excluded in the enumeration, the Committee stated. K. Yadamma, a woman farmer from Kodur mandal in Vikarabad, said that she has returned to her village after her brother cleared around ₹28 lakh loan - which was ₹6 lakh ten years ago when her husband was alive - and returned to farming this monsoon. “I took four acres on lease paying ₹15,000 per acre per annum and sowed kandi (red gram) and makka (corn). I invested some more money on ploughing, labour and fertilizers. The crop is yet to be harvested but it has suffered damage,” said Ms. Yadamma. Kanneganti Ravi of the Committee said that the issue pertains to 22 lakh tenant farmers and clear guidelines have to be given to the Agriculture department officers on how they have to be enumerated. He also demanded a published list of farmers included in the survey to be displayed at gram panchayat offices, so that those left out can flag and request their details to be added. The members have also demanded Cabinet sub-committee formed for the tenant farmers recognition to soon hold a meeting with representatives of farmer organisations, tenant farmers and the Committee.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On the sidelines of the press conference, Kiran Vissa, a member of the committee, cited provisions under Telangana Land Licensed Cultivators Act, 2011, and said that providing recognition cards for tenant farmers will help them get bank loans rather than rely on money lenders who give loans at high interest, access government welfare schemes for farmers, sell farm produce at procurement centres for MSP and stand eligible for compensation during similar government surveys.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Enumerate Telangana tenant farmers in crop loss survey; support financially distressed farmers: Committee

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 09:22:47 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Telangana Tenant Farmers Recognition Struggle Committee has demanded the State government to include tenant farmers — who make up around 36% of farmers community — too to be enumerated in the ongoing Agriculture Department’s survey of farmers who suffered crop loss due to El Nino induced drought.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Highlighting the financial distress they are undergoing due to land lease payments and loss of crops due to the drought, they sought government to issue clear written guidelines to Agriculture Extension Officers (AEO) on enumerating tenant farmers and process to be followed for this. On a larger note, the Committee demanded recognition cards for the tenant farmers which would help them to get compensation in such distressing weather situations, avail welfare scheme and sell farm produce at Minimum Support Price (MSP). At a press conference held in Hyderabad on Thursday, the Committee members along with farmers, released findings of a field study on the ongoing crop loss survey, explained how they are strained financially and need for support from the government. The members said that distress among farmers would increase narrowing their options if the support is not provided. A team from Rythu Swarajya Vedika conducted field study on the government’s crop loss survey by speaking to 145 farmers in 10 villages of Adilabad and Vikarabad. Out of these, 89 were tenant farmers who were not recorded in the enumeration though all of them suffered more than 33% crop damage, as per a claim in a press release. Many farmers were unaware of the survey. Maize, soybean, green gram and black gram harvested before the survey were left out of the survey, despite farmers reporting crop losses averaging 65%. Besides, farmers were unaware on whether their names were included or excluded in the enumeration, the Committee stated. K. Yadamma, a woman farmer from Kodur mandal in Vikarabad, said that she has returned to her village after her brother cleared around ₹28 lakh loan - which was ₹6 lakh ten years ago when her husband was alive - and returned to farming this monsoon. “I took four acres on lease paying ₹15,000 per acre per annum and sowed kandi (red gram) and makka (corn). I invested some more money on ploughing, labour and fertilizers. The crop is yet to be harvested but it has suffered damage,” said Ms. Yadamma. Kanneganti Ravi of the Committee said that the issue pertains to 22 lakh tenant farmers and clear guidelines have to be given to the Agriculture department officers on how they have to be enumerated. He also demanded a published list of farmers included in the survey to be displayed at gram panchayat offices, so that those left out can flag and request their details to be added. The members have also demanded Cabinet sub-committee formed for the tenant farmers recognition to soon hold a meeting with representatives of farmer organisations, tenant farmers and the Committee.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On the sidelines of the press conference, Kiran Vissa, a member of the committee, cited provisions under Telangana Land Licensed Cultivators Act, 2011, and said that providing recognition cards for tenant farmers will help them get bank loans rather than rely on money lenders who give loans at high interest, access government welfare schemes for farmers, sell farm produce at procurement centres for MSP and stand eligible for compensation during similar government surveys.

Compensation (Noun)
मुआवज़ा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Compensation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Recognition (Noun)
मान्यता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Recognition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Enumeration (Noun)
गणना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Enumeration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Procurement (Adjective)
खरीद — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Procurement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Enumerate Telangana tenant farmers in crop loss survey; support financially distressed farmers: Committee", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Telangana Tenant Farmers Recognition Struggle Committee has demanded the State government to include tenant farmers — who make up around 36% of...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Enumerate Telangana tenant farmers in crop loss ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Enumerate Telangana tenant farmers in crop lo' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Enumerate Telangana tenant farmers in crop lo' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Telangana Tenant Farmers Recognition Struggle Committee has demanded the State government to include tenant farmers — who make up around 36% of..." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Enumerate Telangana tenant farmers in crop loss survey; support financially distressed farmers: Committee"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. On the sidelines of the press conference, Kiran Vissa, a member of the committee, cited provisions under Telangana Land Licensed Cultivators Act,...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "On the sidelines of the press conference, Kiran Vissa, a member of the committee, cited provisions under Telangana Land Licensed Cultivators Act,..." articles.title: China's Defence Ministry urges Japan to stop 'stirring up' South China Sea disputes
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The comments were in response to an ⁠announcement earlier this month that Japan will provide the Philippines with radars and drones to boost its coastal surveillance capabilities

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China's Defence Ministry urged Japan on Thursday (November 26, 2026) to stop "stirring up ​trouble" over the South China Sea after a spokesperson was asked about ‌deepening cooperation between Tokyo and the Philippines, both formal ​U.S. military allies. Chinese and Philippine coastguard vessels ‌frequently clash near disputed shoals and reefs as part of long-simmering tensions over the vital trade waterway. Defence Ministry ‌spokesperson Chen Xi told a regular press briefing in Beijing ‌that ⁠Japan was not party to the disputes and had ⁠no right to comment on them. "We demand that Japan stop stirring up trouble over the South China Sea issue," Mr. Chen Xi said. Japan had used "so-called external threats" ​to deepen regional anxieties, form military ‌cliques and attempt to strengthen its military presence in the South China Sea, he added. The U.S. and its allies and partners have repeatedly expressed concern over the situation in the South ‌China Sea as China asserts its sovereignty through growing deployments ​of naval, coastguard and militia vessels. China claims nearly all of the South China Sea, overlapping maritime claims of ⁠the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Brunei and Taiwan. In 2016, a Hague-based tribunal said China's claims had no legal basis, a decision Beijing ‌has rejected. China's Military is also operating further out into the Pacific and is present on a daily basis around Taiwan, which Beijing views as its own territory. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China's Defence Ministry urged Japan on Thursday (November 26, 2026) to stop "stirring up ​trouble" over the South China Sea after a spokesperson was asked about ‌deepening cooperation between Tokyo and the Philippines, both formal ​U.S. military allies. Defence Ministry ‌spokesperson Chen Xi told a regular press briefing in Beijing ‌that ⁠Japan was not party to the disputes and had ⁠no right to comment on them. In 2016, a Hague-based tribunal said China's claims had no legal basis, a decision Beijing ‌has rejected. China's Military is also operating further out into the Pacific and is present on a daily basis around Taiwan, which Beijing views as its own territory. articles.title: Delhi tops list of most polluted NCR cities for PM2.5, PM10 despite no severe AQI days
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The city's air quality remained in the poor or very poor categories for 30 days

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Delhi topped the list of the 10 most polluted cities in the National Capital Region for both PM2.5 and PM10 during the October 1-November 25 period this year, moving up from third and fourth positions in the corresponding period last year. According to an analysis of India Air Quality Portal by EnviroCatalysts, Delhi recorded an average PM2.5 concentration of 113 micrograms per cubic metre during the period, followed by Gurugram at 109, Noida at 105, Ghaziabad at 103, Meerut at 96, Baghpat and Greater Noida at 95, Panipat at 90, Bulandshahr at 82, and Faridabad at 69. For PM10, Delhi again topped the list with an average concentration of 221 micrograms per cubic metre. Gurugram recorded 207, followed by Bulandshahr at 201, Noida at 200, Ghaziabad at 197, Baghpat at 193, Greater Noida at 192, Meerut at 178, and Panipat and Faridabad at 173 each. In the corresponding period last year, Delhi recorded an average PM2.5 concentration of 158 micrograms per cubic metre, ranking third behind Ghaziabad and Noida. Its average PM10 concentration stood at 287 micrograms per cubic metre, placing it fourth behind Ghaziabad, Noida and Greater Noida. Ghaziabad topped both lists in 2025. A comparison of the same period over the last six years, from 2021 to 2026, shows that Delhi topped the PM2.5 list three times, in 2022, 2024 and 2026, while it recorded the highest average PM10 concentration twice, in 2024 and 2026. Despite topping both pollution charts, Delhi did not record a single day in the severe air quality category during the 56 days. It recorded three days in the satisfactory category, 23 in moderate, 18 in poor and 12 in very poor. "Air across the NCR has been clearly better this season, helped by good October rain and less pollution reaching Delhi from spread-out and fewer farm fires. The next step is to cut year-round sources such as vehicles, dust and waste burning across the whole region, so this improvement becomes the new normal," Sunil Dahiya, founder and lead analyst at EnviroCatalyst, told PTI. The city's air quality remained in the poor or very poor categories for 30 days.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2025, Delhi recorded four satisfactory days, nine moderate days, 13 poor days, 27 very poor days and three severe days. The previous year, air quality remained in the moderate category for 13 days, poor for 10 days, very poor for 25 days and severe for eight days.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Delhi tops list of most polluted NCR cities for PM2.5, PM10 despite no severe AQI days

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 10:07:48 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The city's air quality remained in the poor or very poor categories for 30 days

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Delhi topped the list of the 10 most polluted cities in the National Capital Region for both PM2.5 and PM10 during the October 1-November 25 period this year, moving up from third and fourth positions in the corresponding period last year. According to an analysis of India Air Quality Portal by EnviroCatalysts, Delhi recorded an average PM2.5 concentration of 113 micrograms per cubic metre during the period, followed by Gurugram at 109, Noida at 105, Ghaziabad at 103, Meerut at 96, Baghpat and Greater Noida at 95, Panipat at 90, Bulandshahr at 82, and Faridabad at 69. For PM10, Delhi again topped the list with an average concentration of 221 micrograms per cubic metre. Gurugram recorded 207, followed by Bulandshahr at 201, Noida at 200, Ghaziabad at 197, Baghpat at 193, Greater Noida at 192, Meerut at 178, and Panipat and Faridabad at 173 each. In the corresponding period last year, Delhi recorded an average PM2.5 concentration of 158 micrograms per cubic metre, ranking third behind Ghaziabad and Noida. Its average PM10 concentration stood at 287 micrograms per cubic metre, placing it fourth behind Ghaziabad, Noida and Greater Noida. Ghaziabad topped both lists in 2025. A comparison of the same period over the last six years, from 2021 to 2026, shows that Delhi topped the PM2.5 list three times, in 2022, 2024 and 2026, while it recorded the highest average PM10 concentration twice, in 2024 and 2026. Despite topping both pollution charts, Delhi did not record a single day in the severe air quality category during the 56 days. It recorded three days in the satisfactory category, 23 in moderate, 18 in poor and 12 in very poor. "Air across the NCR has been clearly better this season, helped by good October rain and less pollution reaching Delhi from spread-out and fewer farm fires. The next step is to cut year-round sources such as vehicles, dust and waste burning across the whole region, so this improvement becomes the new normal," Sunil Dahiya, founder and lead analyst at EnviroCatalyst, told PTI. The city's air quality remained in the poor or very poor categories for 30 days.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2025, Delhi recorded four satisfactory days, nine moderate days, 13 poor days, 27 very poor days and three severe days. The previous year, air quality remained in the moderate category for 13 days, poor for 10 days, very poor for 25 days and severe for eight days.

Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Improvement (Adjective)
सुधार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Improvement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Pollution (Noun)
प्रदूषण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Pollution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Delhi tops list of most polluted NCR cities for PM2.5, PM10 despite no severe AQI days", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The city's air quality remained in the poor or very poor categories for 30 days.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Delhi tops list of most polluted NCR cities for ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Delhi tops list of most polluted NCR cities f' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Delhi tops list of most polluted NCR cities f' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The city's air quality remained in the poor or very poor categories for 30 days." (Hinglish Arth: शहर की वायु गुणवत्ता 30 दिनों तक खराब या बहुत खराब श्रेणी में रही)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Delhi tops list of most polluted NCR cities for PM2.5, PM10 despite no severe AQI days"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The previous year, air quality remained in the moderate category for 13 days, poor for 10 days, very poor for 25 days and severe for eight days.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The previous year, air quality remained in the moderate category for 13 days, poor for 10 days, very poor for 25 days and severe for eight days." (Hinglish Arth: पिछले वर्ष वायु गुणवत्ता 13 दिन मध्यम, 10 दिन खराब, 25 दिन बहुत खराब और आठ दिन गंभीर श्रेणी में रही थी।)

articles.title: Mindfulness linked to healthier social media use, better mental health: study
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The findings showed that higher levels of mindfulness were associated with lower levels of depression, anxiety, stress, loneliness and fear of missing out (FoMO)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: People with higher levels of mindfulness are more likely to have healthier social media habits and better mental health outcomes, according to a review of 43 studies involving more than 28,000 participants. Mindfulness involves observing one’s thoughts and feelings without judgement. Researchers led by University College London analysed the studies and found that people who reported being more mindful in their daily lives were more likely to report healthier patterns of social media use. The findings, published in the journal PLOS One , also showed that higher levels of mindfulness were associated with lower levels of depression, anxiety, stress, loneliness and fear of missing out (FoMO). Previous studies have shown that cultivating mindfulness through practices such as meditation or mindfulness-based therapy can help reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety and depression. The review contributes to the debate over whether social media use poses a risk to mental health or aggravates existing mental health problems, the researchers said. Lead author Dr Marc S Tibber from University College London’s Division of Psychology and Language Sciences said the findings supported a shift away from simplistic questions about whether social media was inherently good or bad. “Our findings support a move away from reductive questions about whether social media is inherently good or bad, towards an exploration of how complex interactions between individuals, technologies, and the broader social contexts in which they are embedded shape both the potential benefits and harms of social media for mental health,” Tibber said. The review suggested that mindfulness may play a protective role, he said, adding that it could be a potential target for interventions aimed at promoting healthier digital engagement, although further research was needed.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The studies included participants aged 10 to 92, with university students accounting for the largest group at 46.5 %.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Mindfulness linked to healthier social media use, better mental health: study

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 10:05:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The findings showed that higher levels of mindfulness were associated with lower levels of depression, anxiety, stress, loneliness and fear of missing out (FoMO)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: People with higher levels of mindfulness are more likely to have healthier social media habits and better mental health outcomes, according to a review of 43 studies involving more than 28,000 participants. Mindfulness involves observing one’s thoughts and feelings without judgement. Researchers led by University College London analysed the studies and found that people who reported being more mindful in their daily lives were more likely to report healthier patterns of social media use. The findings, published in the journal PLOS One , also showed that higher levels of mindfulness were associated with lower levels of depression, anxiety, stress, loneliness and fear of missing out (FoMO). Previous studies have shown that cultivating mindfulness through practices such as meditation or mindfulness-based therapy can help reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety and depression. The review contributes to the debate over whether social media use poses a risk to mental health or aggravates existing mental health problems, the researchers said. Lead author Dr Marc S Tibber from University College London’s Division of Psychology and Language Sciences said the findings supported a shift away from simplistic questions about whether social media was inherently good or bad. “Our findings support a move away from reductive questions about whether social media is inherently good or bad, towards an exploration of how complex interactions between individuals, technologies, and the broader social contexts in which they are embedded shape both the potential benefits and harms of social media for mental health,” Tibber said. The review suggested that mindfulness may play a protective role, he said, adding that it could be a potential target for interventions aimed at promoting healthier digital engagement, although further research was needed.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The studies included participants aged 10 to 92, with university students accounting for the largest group at 46.5 %.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Can India build an indigenous AI ecosystem while hosting models developed in China? What is Sarvam’s Token Factory? What does it mean for India’s AI ambitions?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Sarvam AI has so far been known for developing its own Artificial Intelligence (AI) models with support from the government’s IndiaAI Mission . On November 16, the Bengaluru-based startup added another part to its business with the launch of Token Factory, a commercial service that gives businesses access to its own models and those developed by other companies, including Chinese firms. The launch prompted a debate over whether offering Chinese-developed models through a commercial platform aligns with India’s ambition to build indigenous AI capabilities, particularly when a company has received government support. Hemant Mohapatra, partner at Lightspeed India and an investor in Sarvam, defended the commercial rationale. In a November 18 post on X, he said global AI companies were generating substantial revenue by hosting models, including Chinese ones, on infrastructure in India and serving customers worldwide. He attributed the opportunity to a global shortage of GPUs, which has made computing capacity in India attractive to companies seeking to run their models. On November 22, Sarvam co-founder Pratyush Kumar issued a clarification on X, addressing questions about the company’s government support, its decision to host foreign-developed models and its commitment to developing its own models. He said Sarvam had used subsidised computing access under the IndiaAI Mission to train its 105B model, while maintaining that its inference business did not conflict with its objective of developing its own models. The government has also defended Sarvam’s commercial strategy. IT Secretary S Krishnan told reporters that the Centre did not see any misuse of IndiaAI Mission support in the company’s decision to offer foreign-developed models through Token Factory. “Based on what Sarvam has told us, based on the experience that people have, we do not see any misuse of the support, which the IndiaAI Mission has provided to Sarvam in the service that they are now offering,” he said. Krishnan said there was no contradiction between developing indigenous models and offering foreign-developed ones commercially, adding that AI companies also needed a revenue model. Token Factory is an inference platform that allows developers and businesses to access several AI models through a single Application Programming Interface (API). An API allows one software application to communicate with another. Instead of setting up and managing the infrastructure needed to run a model, a business can connect its software to Sarvam’s API and send requests to the model it wants to use. The platform offers Sarvam’s 105-billion-parameter model, alongside open-weight models such as GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash from China’s Z.ai, DeepSeek V4 models from DeepSeek, Kimi models from Moonshot AI, and Google’s Gemma 4 31B. Open-weight models are those whose trained parameters, or weights, are made available for others to download and run. Businesses can use them without having to develop the models from scratch.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sarvam says Token Factory runs the models on GPU clusters located in India. Customers pay according to the number of tokens processed.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Sarvam AI has so far been known for developing its own Artificial Intelligence (AI) models with support from the government’s IndiaAI Mission . On November 16, the Bengaluru-based startup added another part to its business with the launch of Token Factory, a commercial service that gives businesses access to its own models and those developed by other companies, including Chinese firms. The launch prompted a debate over whether offering Chinese-developed models through a commercial platform aligns with India’s ambition to build indigenous AI capabilities, particularly when a company has received government support. Hemant Mohapatra, partner at Lightspeed India and an investor in Sarvam, defended the commercial rationale. In a November 18 post on X, he said global AI companies were generating substantial revenue by hosting models, including Chinese ones, on infrastructure in India and serving customers worldwide. He attributed the opportunity to a global shortage of GPUs, which has made computing capacity in India attractive to companies seeking to run their models. On November 22, Sarvam co-founder Pratyush Kumar issued a clarification on X, addressing questions about the company’s government support, its decision to host foreign-developed models and its commitment to developing its own models. He said Sarvam had used subsidised computing access under the IndiaAI Mission to train its 105B model, while maintaining that its inference business did not conflict with its objective of developing its own models. The government has also defended Sarvam’s commercial strategy. IT Secretary S Krishnan told reporters that the Centre did not see any misuse of IndiaAI Mission support in the company’s decision to offer foreign-developed models through Token Factory. “Based on what Sarvam has told us, based on the experience that people have, we do not see any misuse of the support, which the IndiaAI Mission has provided to Sarvam in the service that they are now offering,” he said. Krishnan said there was no contradiction between developing indigenous models and offering foreign-developed ones commercially, adding that AI companies also needed a revenue model. Token Factory is an inference platform that allows developers and businesses to access several AI models through a single Application Programming Interface (API). An API allows one software application to communicate with another. Instead of setting up and managing the infrastructure needed to run a model, a business can connect its software to Sarvam’s API and send requests to the model it wants to use. The platform offers Sarvam’s 105-billion-parameter model, alongside open-weight models such as GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash from China’s Z.ai, DeepSeek V4 models from DeepSeek, Kimi models from Moonshot AI, and Google’s Gemma 4 31B. Open-weight models are those whose trained parameters, or weights, are made available for others to download and run. Businesses can use them without having to develop the models from scratch.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sarvam says Token Factory runs the models on GPU clusters located in India. Customers pay according to the number of tokens processed.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Training vs inference: What’s the distinction at the heart of the Sarvam AI-China models controversy? | Explained

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 08:58:24 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Can India build an indigenous AI ecosystem while hosting models developed in China? What is Sarvam’s Token Factory? What does it mean for India’s AI ambitions?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Sarvam AI has so far been known for developing its own Artificial Intelligence (AI) models with support from the government’s IndiaAI Mission . On November 16, the Bengaluru-based startup added another part to its business with the launch of Token Factory, a commercial service that gives businesses access to its own models and those developed by other companies, including Chinese firms. The launch prompted a debate over whether offering Chinese-developed models through a commercial platform aligns with India’s ambition to build indigenous AI capabilities, particularly when a company has received government support. Hemant Mohapatra, partner at Lightspeed India and an investor in Sarvam, defended the commercial rationale. In a November 18 post on X, he said global AI companies were generating substantial revenue by hosting models, including Chinese ones, on infrastructure in India and serving customers worldwide. He attributed the opportunity to a global shortage of GPUs, which has made computing capacity in India attractive to companies seeking to run their models. On November 22, Sarvam co-founder Pratyush Kumar issued a clarification on X, addressing questions about the company’s government support, its decision to host foreign-developed models and its commitment to developing its own models. He said Sarvam had used subsidised computing access under the IndiaAI Mission to train its 105B model, while maintaining that its inference business did not conflict with its objective of developing its own models. The government has also defended Sarvam’s commercial strategy. IT Secretary S Krishnan told reporters that the Centre did not see any misuse of IndiaAI Mission support in the company’s decision to offer foreign-developed models through Token Factory. “Based on what Sarvam has told us, based on the experience that people have, we do not see any misuse of the support, which the IndiaAI Mission has provided to Sarvam in the service that they are now offering,” he said. Krishnan said there was no contradiction between developing indigenous models and offering foreign-developed ones commercially, adding that AI companies also needed a revenue model. Token Factory is an inference platform that allows developers and businesses to access several AI models through a single Application Programming Interface (API). An API allows one software application to communicate with another. Instead of setting up and managing the infrastructure needed to run a model, a business can connect its software to Sarvam’s API and send requests to the model it wants to use. The platform offers Sarvam’s 105-billion-parameter model, alongside open-weight models such as GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash from China’s Z.ai, DeepSeek V4 models from DeepSeek, Kimi models from Moonshot AI, and Google’s Gemma 4 31B. Open-weight models are those whose trained parameters, or weights, are made available for others to download and run. Businesses can use them without having to develop the models from scratch.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sarvam says Token Factory runs the models on GPU clusters located in India. Customers pay according to the number of tokens processed.

Indigenous (Adjective)
स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया।
✓ Syn: Domestic, Home-grown, Native  |  ✖ Ant: Imported, Foreign, Exotic
Clarification (Noun)
स्पष्टीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Clarification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Contradiction (Noun)
विरोधाभास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Contradiction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Intelligence (Adjective / Verb)
बुद्धिमत्ता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intelligence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Training vs inference: What’s the distinction at the heart of the Sarvam AI-China models controversy? | Explained", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Can India build an indigenous AI ecosystem while hosting models developed in China?.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Training vs inference: What’s the distinction at' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Training vs inference: What’s the distinction' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Training vs inference: What’s the distinction' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Can India build an indigenous AI ecosystem while hosting models developed in China?." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Training vs inference: What’s the distinction at the heart of the Sarvam AI-China models controversy? | Explained"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Customers pay according to the number of tokens processed." (Hinglish Arth: ग्राहक संसाधित टोकन की संख्या के अनुसार भुगतान करते हैं।)
